This position is established as part of the Quantera consortium Batir-le-chat, which brings together researchers from the Netherlands, Germany and France to work on the theoretical aspects of bosonic quantum computing. Requirements

jobs.description:
Bus driver Public Transport the Netherlands

Who are we 
The Toonen Reizen coaches have been well-known on the national and international road network for almost 100 years. The fleet now includes 35 luxury coaches in various sizes. They are multifunctional for company and crew transportation, day trips, international shuttles, school trips, vacation trips and national and international events. The fleet also includes buses for sports clubs and buses for partner Flixbus. Toonen Reizen works for a wide variety of target groups, from business to individuals, and from young people to the elderly. In recent years, the company has grown without losing its family-like work environment. We work with a team of almost 100 drivers who make sure customers arrive to their destinations pleasantly and safely. 

Job Description
Toonen Reizen has a partnership with Arriva and Transdev for public transport. A number of our drivers assist them due to staff shortages and carry out public transport lines. It involves operating fixed public transport routes, with shifts scheduled during the day, night, and weekends, using various buses, including articulated buses. The collaboration is for a minimum of six months, with the possibility of an extension.
With Toonen Reizen, you will have an employment contract for 164 hours per month. These are fixed hours and it is not a flexible contract. You will carry out all work for Arriva or Transdev and will be scheduled and managed by them. Cost of accommodation are covered and no deductions are made from your salary for this.
Should the collaboration be terminated or come to an end, then there is a possibility to work at the headquarters in the Netherlands and drive all kind of touring coach work. At that point, you will be responsible for your own accommodation, though we will certainly assist you with this. You will find more about our regular coach operations below.

Our offer
•    You will be considered for a contract for six-months with fixed hours (164 hours per month). With the prospect of extension and a permanent contract. 
•    You will be given a variety of clothing to wear during trips;
•    An independent and responsible position in a leading organization within the industry;
•    For salary, the collective bargaining agreement for Private Bus Transportation will be adhered to. This means that your basic CLA salary is between € 3,014.72 and € 3,630.42 per month (based on a full-time contract, before taxes and mandatory insurance). Your salary will be determined based on age and experience;
•    100% of hours (including breaks) are paid;
•    A commuting allowance is provided for distances between 10 and 45 kilometers, at €0.23 per kilometer. 
•    You are also eligible for the irregularity, night and weekend bonuses;
•    We will meet with you yearly to understand how satisfied you are in your job and which skills you would like to develop.
•    We cover the costs for refreshing Code 95.

What do you bring?
•    You hold a European nationality.
•    You have a You have a driver's license D and code 95. 
•    You should be able to submit a Certificate of Conduct 
•    You have a good proficiency of the English language. Speaking a little bit Dutch is a bonus. 
•    You are flexible and enjoy working on different hours. 
- Minimum of 1 year experience as a Busdriver

jobs.occupation: IT Support Technician – L1 Resident Engineer (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
Do you want to be the face of IT at an international airport site, in a demanding operational environment?

Joining SAL International at Liège Airport means ensuring, day in and day out, the continuity of IT services for a multilingual organisation at the heart of logistics and airport operations.

As part of its growth, SAL International is looking for an L1 IT Support Technician – Resident Engineer based in Liège.

WHY JOIN SAL INTERNATIONAL?

SAL International is an international player in airport handling and logistics. What you will find there:

• A dynamic, operational environment at the heart of Liège Airport
• An international and multilingual setting
• An autonomous role: you are the site's IT point of reference
• A solid structure, backed by central IT teams (L2/L3, infrastructure, network, security

Jobomschrijving

As L1 Resident Engineer, you are the first point of contact for all IT incidents and requests on site. You combine deskside support and helpdesk.

User support

• Provide Level 1 IT support, on site and remotely, to employees at the Liège site
• Diagnose and resolve common incidents: laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, printers, headsets and peripherals
• Support Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365 environments (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive), as well as basic application support
• Resolve basic connectivity issues (LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN)
• Support meeting rooms and videoconferencing equipment (Teams, cameras, microphones, screens)
Access and security

• Manage access: accounts, password resets, MFA and authentication, in line with security procedures
• Apply IT security policies and immediately report any suspicious incident (phishing, malware, unauthorised access)
Hardware and lifecycle

• Install, configure and prepare IT equipment (PCs, iOS/Android mobile devices, peripherals)
• Handle IT onboarding and offboarding of employees (workstation preparation, handover and collection of equipment, access rights)
• Keep the IT inventory up to date and coordinate replacements, warranties, repairs and disposals
• Tickets, escalation and coordination
• Log, prioritise, track and close tickets in the ITSM tool (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management…)
• Escalate complex incidents to L2/L3 teams with a full diagnosis, and follow them up in line with SLAs
• Act as the link with central IT teams, service providers and external suppliers
• Inform local management of major incidents or service interruptions
• Contribute to IT documentation (knowledge base, procedures, troubleshooting guides)
You are not just a ticket-taker: you are the local IT point of reference and help ensure the continuity of the site's IT services.

THE TEAM & THE MANAGER

Based at the Liège office, you report directly to the Station Manager, Pierre Jeurissen. You work closely with SAL International's IT teams in Belgium and Saudi Arabia.

Essential

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent technical qualification in IT
• At least 2 years' experience in helpdesk, service desk, desktop support or field support
• Fluent French and English, both spoken and written
• Strong command of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365; basic knowledge of Active Directory / Entra ID (Azure AD) and MFA
• Basic knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) and cybersecurity
Assets

• Knowledge of Arabic
• Experience as a Resident Engineer / Onsite Support Engineer
• Experience in the aviation or logistics sector, in an international environment
• IT certifications (CompTIA A , ITIL Foundation, Microsoft…)
Soft skills

• Customer focus and service mindset
• Autonomy and rigour in incident management
• Clear communication with non-technical users
• Hands-on, proactive attitude

  • Mainly covering pitched roofs, but occasionally also flat roofs;
  • Renovating existing roofs (no new-build projects);
  • Installing roofing materials;
  • Assessing the structural characteristics of existing roofs;
  • Installing and sealing carpentry elements in the roof;

As a ROOFER in BRUGES, you have the following qualities:

  • You have solid work experience as a roofer, with experience working on pitched roofs;

For our client located in Bredene, we are looking for a CNC TURNER.

As a CNC TURNER in the Bredene region, you will perform the following tasks:

  • You will sometimes produce small series of parts, while other times you will make unique, customer-specific pieces;
  • You will work on a wide range of components, from large rollers and large-diameter parts to wear sleeves for pumps and parts for combine harvesters;
  • You will start with smaller pieces and gradually grow into working on larger components;
  • To work efficiently, you can read and understand technical drawings;

  • You have experience as a conventional turner, milling machine operator or CNC turner? Great, we are looking for you!
  • We have approximately 25 machines. You will not have a fixed workstation but will learn to operate almost all of them. You will start on a standard lathe and gradually develop your skills;
  • You can read and understand technical drawings;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

For our client in the DIKSMUIDE area, we are looking for a SHEET METAL WORKER.

Our client is a company where employees are at the heart of the business and where everyone is given the opportunity to develop their skills and receive further training.

Since 1957, the company has been a leading metalworking company serving Belgium, the Netherlands, Luxembourg and Northern France.

As a PLATE WORKER in the DIKSMUIDE area, your responsibilities will include:

  • You will be flexibly deployed within the sheet metal department according to the needs of the planning;
  • You operate and set up machines for laser cutting, bending and rolling sheet metal;
  • You prepare the necessary programs and machine settings and check that the machines are functioning correctly;
  • You perform some basic administrative tasks, such as receiving incoming sheets, checking stock and entering the information into the system;
  • You ensure the proper finishing of the parts, including deburring and quality control;
  • You independently move sheets and finished parts using a forklift.
What does our client in the DIKSMUIDE area expect from a new SHEET METAL WORKER colleague?

  • You have experience in sheet metal processing and preferably have experience with several of the following techniques: laser cutting, bending, nesting and rolling;
  • You have a valid forklift certificate;
  • You can read technical drawings and work accurately;
  • You speak Dutch or English;
  • You have completed a technical education (A2 level), for example in mechanics or metalworking, or have equivalent experience.

jobs.description:
For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.
In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving.
 

 
• Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns. 
 
• Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved. 
 
• Maintain constant communication with both the customer and service partner, providing regular updates and reassurance. 
 
• Think on your feet and apply a proactive approach to problem-solving, often finding creative solutions under time pressure. 
 
• Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support. 
 
• Operate within a 24/7 environment, where teamwork and flexibility are essential to ensuring seamless customer experiences. 

- You speak and write fluently in English, German and at least one other European language. 

 
• Service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations. 
 
• Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts. 
 
• You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed. 
 
• Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends. 
 
• A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset. 
 
• Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.

jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers
You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the greater area of Oostkamp
Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not required, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC...

Take the lead in operations at Skechers and guide your teams toward excellence in a fully automated and fast-growing environment!

Skechers USA is a global leader in lifestyle and performance footwear, generating $9 billion in annual revenue. The company designs, develops, and markets over 3,000 styles for men, women, and children.

Why join Skechers?

• A fast-growing international company
• A warm, dynamic, and tech-forward work environment
• A culture that embraces diversity and inclusion
• A competitive salary package
• The extra perk? An on-site gym with a personal coach
To strengthen its operational team, our client Skechers is currently looking for an Operations Manager for its site in Herstal.

 

 

Jobomschrijving

As an Operations Manager at Skechers, you report directly to the Director of Operations and independently manage several departments.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Planning, organizing, and supervising daily operations to meet short- and long-term goals, while ensuring budget, deadlines, and safety standards are met in an automated environment.
• Promoting and maintaining a strong safety culture.
• Developing strategic business plans for the short, medium, and long term for your departments.
• Taking necessary actions to achieve performance objectives by defining and monitoring team KPIs, while effectively managing operational costs.
• Leading, coaching, evaluating, and developing your teams (approx. 150 people) in collaboration with Team Leaders and Leads. Communication is central to your role—both with your teams and social partners.
• Managing and optimizing automated processes with a continuous improvement mindset.
This role requires adaptability, versatility, and a proactive approach to overcoming daily challenges and driving operational excellence.

Education and technical skills:

• Minimum 3 years of proven experience in a similar role within an automated/production environment.
• Proficiency in WMS, WCS, and AS400 systems.
• Solid knowledge of Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, Outlook).
• Strong working knowledge of English.
Your personality and soft skills:

• Leadership – You are a driver of change and adapt easily to a constantly evolving environment.
• Communication – You adjust your communication to suit your audience and actively listen.
• Customer & results orientation – You go the extra mile to ensure customer satisfaction.
• Stress management – You remain positive and composed when facing day-to-day challenges.
• Conflict resolution & negotiation – You are assertive and diplomatic when managing tensions.
• Attention to detail – You are uncompromising when it comes to safety and adherence to procedures and workplace rules.

As a production worker, you will work together with a colleague every day to manufacture safety boots 👢. You will place components such as the steel toe cap, lining and sole into the mould. The machine automatically injects the plastic, after which you remove the finished boot. In between production runs, you clean the machine to ensure it is ready for the next production cycle.

After training, you will also be able to operate other machines. You will cut away larger excess pieces and trim fine seams ✂️. You will carry out quality checks and pay close attention to detail. Every boot must meet strict quality standards. With your keen eye for detail, you make sure that only top-quality products leave the facility.

Working together with your colleagues is important. You step in where needed and support each other in achieving the production targets. You work accurately and take pride in the end result. Are you eager to learn and quality-focused? Then this could be the opportunity for you! ✅

Sound like the job for you? Apply now and discover how you can make a difference!

Who are we looking for?

• You have some initial stable experience in a production environment ⚙️
• You speak English well; Dutch is a plus.
• You have your own means of transportation (public transport is not available).
• You are attentive and have an eye for detail. 👀
• You can work at a fast pace and are physically fit. 💪
• You are not afraid of physically demanding work.

Are you a student looking for a full-time assignment in Brussels for 3 weeks and eager to gain experience in an international office environment? Then this opportunity could be perfect for you!
 

 
• Location: Brussels
 
• Period: October 26th until November 13th
 
• Working hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM - 5:00 PM (4:30 PM on Fridays with a 30-minute lunch break)
 
• Full-time | 39.5 hours/week 
 

Your responsibilities
 

You will be the first point of contact at reception and support the Office Manager with various operational tasks.
 

 
• Welcome and assist visitors in a professional and friendly manner
 
• Answer incoming calls and redirect them to the appropriate contacts
 
• Handle incoming and outgoing parcels, letters, and deliveries
 
• Coordinate taxi bookings for employees and visitors
 
• Manage meeting room bookings and calendars
 
• Prepare meeting rooms for client meetings, including snacks and beverages
 
• Organize catering and lunches when required 

Who are we looking for?
 

 
•  
Available form October 26th until November 13th
 
 
• Proactive and independent, you don't wait for work to come to you
 
• Good command of English (working language)
 
• Strong organizational skills

• You will support in the launch of commercial actions

Our client is a well-established international organisation with a strong reputation for operational excellence and a people-focused culture. 

To strengthen its local IT presence in Belgium, our client is looking for a service-oriented IT professional who enjoys working in a collaborative and multicultural environment. The organisation promotes knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and professional development while offering employees the opportunity to work closely with both local and international teams.

Jobomschrijving

As a Service Desk Analyst / IT Support Engineer (L1/L2), your responsibilities will include:

• Providing first and second-line IT support to end users.
• Managing incidents, service requests, and technical queries in line with established processes and service level agreements.
• Troubleshooting hardware, software, network, and Microsoft 365-related issues.
• Acting as the primary local IT point of contact for employees based in Belgium.
• Logging, tracking, documenting, and resolving tickets using the company's IT Service Management platform.
• Collaborating with international IT teams, vendors, and specialist support teams to resolve complex issues.
• Monitoring IT systems and escalating recurring or critical issues when required.
• Supporting IT projects, deployments, upgrades, and infrastructure changes.
• Managing employee onboarding and offboarding activities, including hardware preparation, account setup, and access management.
• Supporting meeting room technology, printers, audiovisual equipment, and local IT infrastructure.
• Creating and maintaining user documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational procedures.
• Identifying opportunities to improve processes, enhance service quality, and optimise the overall user experience.

The successful candidate will have:

• At least 2/3 years of experience in an IT Support, Service Desk, or End User Support role.
• Fluency in English & Dutch. French is a plus. 
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows environments, end-user computing, networking fundamentals, and IT security best practices.
• Experience managing incidents, service requests, and change-related activities.
• Hands-on experience with Active Directory and Microsoft 365 user administration.
• Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to resolve technical issues independently.
• Strong customer service and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
• A structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach to work.
• The ability to prioritise tasks and manage multiple requests in a fast-paced environment.

ITIL, Microsoft, or other relevant certifications would be considered an advantage.

On a personal level, you are recognised for your customer-centric mindset, team spirit, adaptability, and willingness to continuously learn and improve. You enjoy taking ownership, driving improvements, and delivering an outstanding support experience to end users.

Are you looking for a varied job where you can both apply your technical knowledge and carry out practical tasks?

Then be sure to apply for this operator position!

You will be working in a food company specialized in the processing and storage of a wide range of food products.

As an operator, you are responsible for the smooth running of the production process and ensure that your machines continue to operate efficiently.
You do this by:

• Correctly setting machine parameters

• Monitoring quality and making adjustments to the machine when necessary

• Assisting with machine changeovers for new products

• Independently resolving minor technical malfunctions

• Correctly replenishing supplies

• Cleaning the machines

• Consulting with technicians, packaging staff, team leaders, and others

All of this takes place in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C), working in a three-shift system, while strictly adhering to hygiene and safety regulations.

You have relevant work experience and/or a technical background (e.g. through training or education).

You take pride in keeping your machine running smoothly and in resolving minor breakdowns or blockages quickly and efficiently.

You are flexible and willing to work shifts: early/late and night.

Working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C) does not deter you.

You are able to work independently, but you also regularly consult with colleagues to ensure a smooth production process.

You do not mind performing physical work.

You have a good command of Dutch and/or English and are able to commute independently to Dendermonde.

Do you enjoy precision shaping pipes and creating strong welds for technical installations? As a TIG or semi-automatic welder, you'll work on a variety of HVAC projects within the construction sector. You'll read plans, build custom installations, and weld pipes into perfect assemblies for heating and plumbing. Depending on the project, you'll work both on-site and in the workshop, preparing and assembling components. Thanks to the variety of high-end projects, your job remains technically challenging and educational. You'll be part of a large team where collaboration, quality, and safety are paramount.

What are your tasks?

• Reading and interpreting technical plans

• Bending, grinding, and welding pipes (TIG/semi-automatic)

• Preparing and assembling installations in the workshop and on-site

• Experience as a welder in a technical or construction environment

• Communicate in English or Romanian

• Possession of a driver's license

Are you looking to build your career as a Junior Controller in an international industrial environment? A growing manufacturing company based in Brussels is looking for a motivated finance professional to strengthen its controlling team.

 

As a Junior Controller, you will gain valuable exposure to industrial finance, production costs and business performance. Whether you have started your career in audit or controlling, this Junior Financial Controller opportunity offers the chance to develop your analytical skills, work closely with operational teams and contribute to important financial decisions.

What you'll do as a junior controller : 

As a Junior Controller, you will work alongside experienced finance professionals and support the company's financial performance through a variety of responsibilities.

• Analyse monthly financial results and investigate variances between actual performance, budgets and forecasts.
• Monitor production costs, operating expenses and profit margins to support effective cost control.
• Prepare financial reports and management dashboards to provide clear insights into business performance.
• Support monthly closing activities and ensure the accuracy of financial information.
• Contribute to budgeting and forecasting processes in collaboration with the finance and operations teams.
• Identify cost optimisation opportunities and investigate the financial drivers behind production performance.
• Develop and improve Excel reports and financial analysis tools.
• Assist the Senior Controller with ad hoc analyses, reporting improvements and business projects.

What we're Looking For as a Junior Controller : 

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field.
• A first professional experience in audit, financial controlling.
• A genuine interest in industrial controlling, cost accounting and financial performance analysis.
• Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and a structured approach to problem solving.
• Good knowledge of Excel. Experience with SAP or another ERP system is an advantage.
• The ability to communicate financial information clearly and collaborate with non-financial stakeholders.
• Professional proficiency in English, French and a good command of Dutch.

 Can you work from 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM on a weekly basis? Available every other week or every third week? That's possible too!

jobs.description:
Introduction
 

Volvo Action Service (VAS) takes care of our Volvo Group customers across Europe whenever one of their vehicles has a problem. Delivering great customer service is at the heart of our operation, as we take a proactive approach to get vehicles back on the road as quickly and smoothly as possible.
 

This is us, your new colleagues
 

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.
 

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.
 

This is the job
 
 

• Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind. 

• Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress. 

• A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box. 

• Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business 

Are you the one?
 
 

• You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers. 

• You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported. 

• You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset. 

• You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up. 

• You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills. 

• You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients. 

• You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, French, Dutch and German

Conforma is a Contract Manufacturing Organisation (CMO) specialising in the manufacturing of non-sterile liquid and semi-solid pharmaceutical and medical device products, including solutions, syrups, gels and creams.
 

As we expand internationally, we are looking for an Outbound Sales professional to identify new opportunities, build a qualified prospect pipeline and support our commercial visibility.
 

This is a 
 hands-on commercial role 
combining market research, lead generation, outbound sales and business development. You will identify companies whose products could potentially be manufactured by Conforma, assess whether they have internal manufacturing capabilities, and identify the right people to approach.
 

You will help us turn market intelligence into concrete commercial opportunities.
 

Your responsibilities
 

· Identify and map potential customers across Europe and, subsequently, international markets
 

· Research companies, product portfolios and manufacturing capabilities to identify potential outsourcing and contract manufacturing opportunities
 

· Build and maintain a structured, high-quality prospect database and prioritise opportunities based on commercial potential
 

· Identify relevant decision-makers and map professional contact details
 

· Use online research, professional networks, databases and direct telephone contact to obtain or verify information and establish the right point of contact
 

· Support targeted outbound campaigns and follow up qualified leads together with the Business Development team
 

· Support the organisation and commercial follow-up of relevant international trade fairs and industry events
 

· Help keep Conforma's LinkedIn company page professional, current and engaging by contributing to relevant posts and content

We are looking for someone who is curious, commercially minded, proactive and not afraid to pick up the phone. You enjoy investigating companies, finding information that is not immediately available and turning that information into actionable opportunities.
 

· A higher education degree or equivalent experience in business, marketing, life sciences, pharmaceutical sciences, international business or a related field
 

· Excellent written and spoken Dutch & English is essential
 

· Strong research, analytical and organisational skills
 

· Excellent communication skills and the confidence to speak with people you have never contacted before
 

· A commercial mindset and genuine interest in business development
 

· Persistence and the ability to professionally obtain information
 

· Good digital and online research skills
 

· The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with the Business Development team
 

What makes this role different?
 

This is not a traditional telesales position. You will not simply work through a predefined list of leads. You will help build our international market map from the ground up: identifying potential customers, understanding their products and manufacturing footprint, discovering where outsourcing opportunities may exist and determining who we should speak to.
 

Your work will directly contribute to Conforma's international growth and give you the opportunity to build a broad network within the pharmaceutical and medical device industries.

For one of our clients, we are looking for a Software Asset Management Officer to ensure the reliable, compliant, and cost-efficient management of their IT software licence portfolio.

The assignment combines administrative, analytical, and monitoring responsibilities, with close collaboration between IT, Procurement, and Finance.

The Software Asset Management Officer will contribute to licence compliance, cost optimisation, accurate reporting, and the continuous improvement of Software Asset Management (SAM) processes.

• Software licence management:

• Identify opportunities to optimise licence allocation and utilisation.

• Propose concrete actions to reduce software costs and avoid unnecessary renewals or purchases.

• Support the monitoring and optimisation of software renewals.

• Reporting & monitoring:

• Prepare analyses, reports, and dashboards to support management decision-making.

• Ensure SAM data remains accurate, reliable, and suitable for reporting purposes.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to improve the efficiency and reliability of licence-management activities.

Job Description:

As a Future Finance Talents Internship (FFTI) participant, you will be working alongside experienced finance professionals, contributing to various financial projects and gaining insights into the financial operations of a leading global brewing company. You will play a key role in delivering the main financial products of a Fast Moving Consumer Goods company that impact the company's performance. In 2025, FFTIs converted into full time hires and graduate trainees.

These work experiences will be located in Leuven.

Finance Areas You Could Be Matched With:

• Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A): Our Belgium, BNFL, and Zone Europe HQ hosts a high-performance FP&A team responsible for budgeting, forecasting, and enabling dynamic resource allocation to help deliver our operational and financial objectives.
• Accounting: We deliver a robust, timely set of financials on a monthly basis. Connect across our European Zone to help us manage by exception and automate our monthly and quarterly routines.
• Internal Audit: Jump into the beating heart of an on-going process or financial audit with our Global Risk Management team. Learn how the world's largest brewer runs from the inside out.
• Treasury: Work with our Global Treasury team based in Leuven to understand how we manage our derivatives, cash, and loan portfolio.
In all roles:

• Work-Experience Cohort: Our Future Finance Talent Internships are connected with one another to help create a strong network of young professionals. You will be integrated into operating teams and will therefore be able to leverage from operating team's experience.
• Weekly Masterclass: Regardless of your work-experience area, receive a master-class training from the functional lead of each area to ensure a broad-based understanding of Finance in a Fast Moving Consumer Goods company. (FP&A, Control, Tax, Sales Finance, M&A, Internal Audit, General Management)

Think of it as being the detective, the problem-solver, and the strategist all in one, working with teams across the bank to keep our data in top shape.

• Spot the gaps, fix the flaws. You’ll design and monitor data quality controls, using dashboards to track how well our systems are performing.

• Upgrading dashboards so they give clearer, more actionable insights.
• Documenting metadata so everyone understands what our data means and how to use it.
• Supporting data certification and joining key committees to ensure we’re meeting the highest standards.
• Sharing your know-how with the wider Data Quality team, so we all keep getting better.
• Be the bridge between data and real-world impact You’ll get to know our client data flows and applications inside out, becoming the go-to person. Your work will directly help us improve customer experiences, streamline processes, and stay ahead in a fast-changing industry.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

We’re looking for someone who:

•  Loves solving puzzles. You see data as more than numbers; it’s a story waiting to be uncovered. Experience in data quality analysis (especially in banking) is a big plus.
• Speaks “data” fluently. You understand data lifecycles, governance, and how data drives decisions. You’ve done analysis that shows real business impact and you’re passionate about digital transformation.
• Is tech-savvy (but not a coding genius). You’re comfortable with tools like Excel, MS Access, PowerPoint, and Business Objects. If you’ve worked with Collibra, Ab Initio, Tableau, SQL, or Python, even better, but what matters most is your curiosity and willingness to learn.

jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods

• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany

• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)

• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day

Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country

• Has a good level of English

• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes

• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

About Us: 
 

Zymofix is a dynamic and innovative scale-up dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high productivity. Positioned at the forefront of sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to grow healthy crops and improve yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027.
 

 
 

Job Description & Key Responsibilities:
 

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented Production Technician to join our microbial production team. In this role, you will play a key part in producing beneficial microorganisms used in biostimulant, biocontrol, and biofertilizer products that support healthy crop growth. Training will be provided, so prior microbiology experience is not required — though it's a plus. Curiosity and attention to detail matter most.
 

 
 

Your tasks:
 
 

• You independently carry out production tasks according to standard procedures: you prepare supplies, sterilize, inoculate, harvest and handle downstream processing. 

• You work under sterile conditions and strictly follow hygiene and sterility protocols, giving contamination no chance. 

• You safeguard product quality at every stage by performing in-process quality and sterility checks. 

• You help with downstream processing and carry out quantification checks as part of the final quality control. 

• You actively contribute to continuous improvement (TPM) and help find solutions when problems arise. 

You might be our perfect match if you meet the requirements below. But don't worry if you don't tick every box, we dare you to apply anyway. You never know if there’s another role at Zymofix that's a better fit for your skills.
 
 

• You have a technical or scientific background: a secondary school diploma, an associate degree (graduaat) or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.occupation: IT & Cyber Risk Specialist – HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
Your Job at a glance

Ready to Shape the Future of Cybersecurity in Banking?

At the heart of BNP Paribas Fortis, the Centre of Expertise Security (CoE Security) drives innovation in secure solutions, designing, implementing, and maintaining trusted, cutting-edge protections for our teams and clients.

As an IT Cyber Risk Manager, you will operate at the core of our cybersecurity strategy, connecting, influencing, and collaborating across the entire bank. Within our ‘Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC)’ team, you will work closely with IT and Business Units to redefine Operational Risk Management, with a sharp focus on IT and Cyber Security.

This is not just a risk management role - it’s an opportunity to:

• Engage diverse stakeholders, from technical teams to C-level executives, across all areas of BNP Paribas Fortis.
• Drive creative solutions, transforming complex cyber risks into practical, forward-thinking strategies.
• Shape a resilient future by proactively managing cyber risks to strengthen the bank’s defenses.
If you thrive in a dynamic, cross-functional environment where innovation and collaboration are key, this is your chance to make a tangible impact in banking cybersecurity

 

And in detail

Your Key Role as IT & Cyber Risk Specialist :

You serve as the critical link between technical risks, business priorities, and strategic decisions, ensuring IT and cybersecurity risks are proactively identified, analyzed, and translated into actionable strategies—fully aligned with the bank’s objectives.

Why this role stands out:

• Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Tribes, Functions, and Business Units, clearly articulating risks to both technical teams and leadership—enabling data-driven decision-making.
• Proactive risk intelligence: From Shadow IT exposures to operational vulnerabilities, you assess, prioritize, and drive mitigation, delivering practical solutions that balance security with business continuity.
• Strategic advisory: Provide targeted recommendations to IT and business stakeholders, ensuring risks are managed without compromising operational goals.
• Enterprise-wide alignment: Report risks, trends, and insights to Cyber Security, IT, and Business Management, while sharing best practices across the BNP Paribas Group—reinforcing a unified risk posture.
• Process optimization: Leverage your expertise to refine risk management methods and tools, ensuring they remain efficient, scalable, and future-ready."

Your talents and skills

• Risk-to-Solution Mindset: You break down complex IT and cybersecurity challenges, turning them into clear, actionable insights for leadership—viewing risks as solvable challenges, not just warnings.
• Bank-Specific Acumen: Deep understanding of BNP Paribas Fortis’ businesses, functions, and strategic goals, ensuring risk management aligns with our priorities.
• Technical + Risk Expertise: Hands-on experience in IT infrastructure, architecture, and security, blending technical knowledge with risk awareness to design practical solutions—not just identify risks.
• Multilingual Communication: Fluent in French or Dutch + professional English, with strong written and verbal persuasion skills. You adapt seamlessly between IT, business, and management discussions.
• Practical Framework Application: Proven ability to operationalize IT processes, Cyber Security Management Systems, and control frameworks—ensuring they deliver in practice.
• Certifications & Methodologies: CISSP, CISM, Operational Risk Management, or Agile experience are a plus, but not mandatory.

Job introduction

When was the last time you translated a business need into a technical solution that could change an entire organization? That’s exactly what you’ll do with us!

As a Senior SAP Development Lead at delaware, you truly understand what businesses need and how we can deliver it. You’re eager to take the lead in transforming ideas into innovative solutions, guide customers through their move to SAP S/4 HANA, and add value to their business processes.

If development is in your DNA and you’re ready to take on a leading role, then you may be the Senior SAP Development Lead we’re looking for.

Who are we?

Did you know delaware is Belgium’s biggest SAP integrator? This means we get to work with the latest SAP technologies, such as all S/4 HANA deployments, SAP Fiori, SAP Cloud Platform services like ABAP Environment, iRPA, HANA Cloud, API Management, and the SAP Business Technology Platform. Enough with the name-dropping though — you probably already know your way around these technologies! And if you don’t, we’ll happily guide you through them .

We are the SAP Development team. We’re a fun-loving and ambitious team with a strong group dynamic. Even though there are more than 60 of us, we’re still a very tight-knit bunch! We love going for drinks together and we organize the best team events. It’s in our nature to coach our teammates: seniors happily share knowledge with newer members of the team (and vice versa). So what’s it like to work with us? ‘Unique,’ ‘adventurous,’ and ‘challenging’ are just three of the words team members have used to describe their experience. Read our stories here.

We have a broad spectrum of projects and customers in a wide variety of sectors and across the entire range of SAP modules. We also offshore development work to our colleagues in Harbin (China), but it’s up to the development lead to decide which tasks stay with us and which are sent to China.

Just so you know: delaware has offices in Antwerp, Ghent, Kortrijk, Lummen, Liège, and Wavre, but we also spend a lot of time working with our customers on-site. We also offer the flexibility to work from home.

jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

You’ll be the go-to expert in Privileged Access Management (PAM) within our IAM Evolution Squad, driving the security and efficiency of access governance at BNP Paribas Fortis. 

Your mission? Design, implement, and optimize PAM solutions using CyberArk and SailPoint, ensuring compliance with strict banking regulations while collaborating with IT, security, and business teams.

This is your chance to shape the future of secure access in a global bank, working in a hybrid setup (50% remote, 50% on-site in Brussels) with a skilled, multicultural team of 10 specialists.

 

AND IN DETAIL

What You’ll Own:

• Lead PAM Strategy & Execution: As the Privileged Access Management (PAM) Subject Matter Expert (SME), you’ll own the design, implementation, and optimization of CyberArk-based solutions, ensuring they meet security, compliance, and operational needs.
• Strengthen Access Governance: Work closely with IAM, IT Security, Compliance, and Risk teams to align access policies with BNP Paribas Fortis standards and regulatory requirements.
• Drive Process Improvement: Use KPIs and data-driven insights to refine access management workflows, reducing risks and enhancing efficiency.
• Collaborate & Train: Partner with cross-functional teams to implement best practices and upskill colleagues on PAM and IAM protocols.
• Innovate with Cutting-Edge Tools: Leverage SailPoint, CyberArk, and ServiceNow to build a scalable, adaptive identity framework.
 

Why It Matters: 
 You’re not just managing access, you’re protecting critical banking systems, ensuring compliance, and enabling secure, seamless operations for thousands of users. 

Your work will directly impact how we mitigate risks, enforce policies, and future-proof our security infrastructure.

Your Team & Environment:

• A squad of 10 (Business Analysts, Security Officers, Product Owner, Scrum Master) based in Montagne-Du-Parc, Brussels.
• A hybrid work model (50% remote, 50% on-site) for flexibility and collaboration.
• A culture of innovation, where you’ll help transition access governance into a dynamic, compliance-first, AI-augmented capability.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

Non-Negotiables (Must-Haves)

• 10+ years in security technology, with deep expertise in:
• Identity & Access Management (IAM)
• Privileged Access Management (PAM), CyberArk experience mandatory
• Segregation of Duties (SoD) & Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) 
• Hands-on experience with:
• SailPoint, Cloud (IaaS/PaaS), ServiceNow, Process Management Tools
• Designing requirements, specifications, and use cases 
• CISSP Certification (or equivalent) 
• Languages:
• English (fluent, written & spoken)
• Dutch and/or French is an asset
 

What Sets You Apart

• Analytical & Conceptual Thinker: You break down complex problems and design practical, scalable solutions. 
• Strong Negotiator & Influencer : You align stakeholders, drive decisions, and get buy-in for critical security initiatives.

jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

Join BNP Paribas Fortis as an IT Operational Permanent Control (OPC) Specialist At BNP Paribas Fortis, our Cyber Security division unites the Centre of Excellence (CoE) Security and IT Filiere Production Security BE to design, implement, and maintain robust security solutions. 
Our mission? To foster a trustworthy, secure environment for both our colleagues and clients.

We’re seeking a proactive professional to join our IT Operational Permanent Control (OPC) team, a key function within Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC). Here, you’ll play a pivotal role in helping IT and Business Units navigate operational risks tied to IT and Cyber Security, while reinforcing an adaptive, resilient control framework across the bank.

 

AND IN DETAIL

• Identification and assessment of risks: You’ll analyse data from risk systems, reports, and governance bodies, turning complex information into practical, risk-based insights. Your conclusions will help leaders make informed decisions.
• Controls Execution & Reporting: You’ll interpret, adapt, and run control tests (compliance, fraud, outsourcing, etc.), then report findings to the CIO, ensuring controls align with IT’s strategic priorities.
• Regulatory & Internal Reporting: You’ll prepare precise, high-impact reports for the Internal Control Committee (ExCo), regulators (NBB/BNB, ECB), and Group entities (CDF/IT Group), shaping risk discussions at the highest level.
• Procedure Governance: As the gatekeeper for IT risk and security procedures, you’ll ensure they’re up to date, accessible, and visible, keeping our compliance framework structured and resilient.
• Governance Body Support: Acting as NAC secretary for major IT initiatives, you’ll track stakeholder conditions (Business & Functions), driving accountability and alignment in high-impact projects.
• Risk & Control Self-Assessment (RCSA): You’ll conduct the annual RCSA for all IT risk categories, using the RISK ORM methodology to assess risks, incidents, and recommendations, giving a full picture of IT’s risk profile, including external threats.
• Regulatory Reporting – IT Risk Questionnaire: You’ll coordinate the bank’s response to the ECB’s IT Risk questionnaire (via Group) and the NBB’s BNP Paribas Fortis reporting, ensuring submissions are accurate, regulator-ready, and endorsed by the CISO/CIO.
• Compliance Controls Execution: You’ll run IT-wide compliance checks (awareness, ethics, etc.), report findings to the IT Management Team, and drive remediation where needed, ensuring actions are documented and evidenced.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

Background & Experience

• A Master’s degree in IT, economics, or engineering, with a strong IT foundation.
• 10+ years of experience, including at least 5 years in Risk or IT whether in financial services, consulting, or another regulated industry.
  
What You Bring to the Table

• IT & Security Process Insight: You understand how IT and security technologies integrate into risk and operational frameworks and where the gaps might be.
• Risk Assessment Skills: Hands-on experience in identifying and evaluating IT and cyber risks, with a practical (not just theoretical) approach.
• Regulatory & Standards Know-How: Familiarity with frameworks like EBA guidelines, DORA, ISO 27001, or NIST and the ability to apply them in real-world IT risk and compliance scenarios.
• Control Design & Testing: You can translate regulations and policies into effective controls and know how to test whether they actually work.
• Agile Mindset: Experience with Agile methodologies in a risk or control environment is a plus, but adaptability matters most.
• Process Thinking: You quickly grasp end-to-end processes, spot risks, and propose practical solutions without getting lost in bureaucracy.
• Clear Communication: Whether it’s a report for executives or a presentation for regulators, you distill complex topics into concise, actionable messages.
• Stakeholder Alignment: You bridge the gap between technical teams, business units, and regulators keeping everyone aligned without losing sight of compliance and risk goals.
• Collaboration: You thrive in cross-functional teams, working smoothly with colleagues and partners to execute risk and control initiatives.
  
Practicalities

• Languages: Fluent in French or Dutch, with strong English (written and spoken).
• Tools: Comfortable with SharePoint, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
• Nice-to-have: Experience with RISK 360 is a plus, but not a must.

The organisation has built a strong reputation through its scientific expertise, in-house R&D laboratory, and regulatory excellence. Operating internationally through a network of manufacturing and distribution partners, the company offers innovative veterinary solutions across multiple continents while maintaining the agility, ownership culture, and entrepreneurial spirit of a growing SME.

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Animal Health Sales Manager - Pharmaceutical Products - Veterinary channel, you will have the following responsibilities: 

Business Development - Creation of new partnerships

• Identify new business opportunities and evaluate new potential products for the portfolio.
• Conduct market analysis to identify unmet needs within the Belgian veterinary sector.
• Assess partnerships with pharmaceutical manufacturers and negotiate exclusive distribution opportunities.
• Define product positioning, pricing strategies, and go-to-market plans.
• Prepare and support product launches in collaboration with the sales team.

Field Sales Management 

• Develop and execute the commercial strategy for the Belgian market.
• Lead, motivate, and coach a team of 5 sales representatives covering Belgium.
• Maintain close contact with key stakeholders in the Belgian veterinary market.
• Monitor market trends, competition, and business performance.

As a successful Animal Health Sales Manager - Pharmaceutical Products - Veterinary channel, you will have the following profile:

• Veterinary degree or equivalent in-depth expertise and network within the veterinary industry.
• 10/15 years of experiences in the Animal Health industry.
• Strong knowledge of the Belgian veterinary market and its key stakeholders.
• Proven experience in a commercial, sales management, or business development role.
• Previous experience managing and coaching sales teams.
• Strategic mindset combined with a hands-on approach.
• Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
• Fluent in Dutch with a good level of English.

FMCG

Jobomschrijving

• Create and maintain production plans
• Ensure products are available for customer orders and stock
• Monitor production constraints daily and adjust schedules when needed
• Support projects related to new product launches, phase-outs, and process improvements
• Work with different teams to coordinate product launches and discontinuations
• Represent the planning team in internal meetings
• Keep planning data and systems up to date
• Communicate with planning, production, purchasing, and customer service teams to solve planning challenges

• Great communication skills in Dutch, English and French
• Related bachelor or master 
• Stress resistant and assertive
• Experience in Production Planning 
• Experience within FMCG is a big plus
• Good SAP knowledge

jobs.occupation: Legal Counsel - Commercial & Consumer Law - Limburg
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international leisure and hospitality group headquartered in Europe, operating multiple business units across several countries. The Belgian organization employs approximately 2,000 people across different sites and operates within a highly decentralized structure, allowing local entities to maintain significant autonomy while benefiting from the support of a large international group.

Jobomschrijving

As a Legal Counsel your responsibilities are:

• Provide pragmatic and business-oriented legal advice to senior management and operational teams.
• Draft, review, negotiate, and manage a variety of commercial contracts.
• Advise on agency, distribution, procurement, and service agreements.
• Support construction and real estate projects, including related contractual negotiations.
• Monitor and advise on consumer law matters impacting the Belgian business.
• Contribute to ESG-related projects and provide legal support regarding evolving sustainability regulations.
• Identify legal risks and develop practical mitigation strategies.
• Strengthen compliance frameworks and internal governance procedures.
• Collaborate closely with departments such as Procurement, Marketing, Communications, and Operations.
• Translate complex legal concepts into pragmatic solutions that facilitate business growth.

A successful Legal Counsel should have:

• Master's degree in Law obtained from a Belgian university.
• Minimum 3 years of relevant legal experience as legal counsel or lawyer
• Fluent in English, ideally in Dutch as well (or conversational level)
• Strong expertise in: Commercial contracts, Consumer law, Real estate and construction law
• Exposure to ESG-related matters is considered a strong asset.
• Comfortable working independently and managing a broad legal scope.

As a production worker, you're the driving force behind the production process. You ensure the production line always runs smoothly by replenishing and trimming meat as needed. Don't worry if you don't have experience with knives – you'll learn! You'll also help load and unload trucks and work in various departments, such as production, packaging, and shipping. No two days are the same for a production worker, and that's what makes it so rewarding.
We're looking for a production worker who's a hands-on person.

You're physically fit, speak fluent Dutch or English, and enjoy working independently and as part of a team. As a production worker, you take responsibility, remain calm under pressure, and prioritize effectively.

Flexibility is key: you'll start between 3:30 and 6:30 a.m. and work until everything is finished, OR you'll work in two shifts: from 3:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. and the other week from 1:30 p.m. to 10:30 p.m.

Working in a refrigerated environment? No problem for you!

 

Eager to get stuck in? Then you're the production worker we want on our team!

Where Italian nostalgia meets real hospitality leadership
 

Nando isn't just another restaurant, it's Nonna's kitchen, brought to life in Wilrijk, Antwerp. Retro details, honest Italian comfort food, and a room that feels like family. We're looking for a 
Waiter / Service Responsible to own the floor: someone who leads by example during service, keeps the room running like clockwork, and makes sure every guest leaves feeling like they just had dinner at home.
 

What you'll do
 
 

• Welcome guests and set the tone for the evening 

• Take orders and serve with precision, even when it's slammed 

• Own the floor during service — pace, table turns, team energy, guest happiness 

• Coach and steady the team in real time; step in and solve problems before guests notice them 

• Be the calm, capable presence management can count on when it gets busy  

What you bring
 
 

• Experience as a waiter or shift leader in hospitality 

• A natural feel for service and a bit of leadership instinct 

• Composure under pressure — busy nights don't rattle you 

• Organized, hands-on, solutions over excuses 

• English (required), basic Dutch (required); Italian or French is a real plus  

What's in it for you
 
 

• Full-time, 38h contract 

• €16.00–€18.00 brutto/hour, negotiable based on experience 

• Meal vouchers, holiday pay, and a 13th month 

• Bike allowance and uniform provided 

• Real responsibility on the floor from day one — with a clear path to become manager within your first 6 to 12 months 

• Room to grow within a restaurant group that's expanding  

Restaurant is open 7/7, with 2 days off per week.
 

 Send your CV, a photo, and a short intro to 
hr@lvpgroup.be — tell us why Nando feels like your kind of room.

Following comprehensive in-house training, you will work independently with a variety of sheet metal processing machines. You will manufacture and process metal components according to technical drawings and ensure a high-quality finish for every part.

Your responsibilities include:

• Operating and setting up various sheet metal processing machines.

• Performing cutting and bending operations based on technical drawings.

• Calculating flat patterns and preparing production parts.

• Processing metal components through bending, cutting, punching, tapping, and grinding.

• Performing semi-automatic welding when required.

• Inspecting finished products for quality and dimensional accuracy.

• Ensuring compliance with safety and quality procedures.

For our client in the food industry, located in the Oudenaarde region, we are looking for an Order Picker who is willing to work in a 3-shift system.

Your responsibilities 

 
• You collect products from the cold and hot production lines and store them in the correct location in the refrigerator. 
 
• You label products correctly and register batch numbers, expiry dates and returnable packaging in MAPA. 
 
• You monitor stock levels and report shortages in a timely manner. 
 
• You check incoming deliveries for quantity, temperature and condition, and register the information in MAPA. 
 
• You assist drivers with loading and unloading and correctly apply the FIFO principle. 
 
• You keep the warehouse, refrigerators and loading bays clean and tidy and ensure that returnable packaging is stored in the correct location. 
 
• You work an early, day or late shift – working hours vary depending on the schedule and the day. 

What are we looking for in an Order Picker?

 

 
• You have a good command of English. 
 
• You are comfortable working in a chilled environment of approximately 7°C. 
 
• You can operate an electric pallet truck and a reach truck. 
 
• You are flexible and available to work early, day and late shifts, including occasional Saturdays or Sundays. 
 
• You work accurately: quantities, temperatures, batch numbers and expiry dates must be correct. 
 
• You are able to maintain an overview when several orders need to be prepared at the same time and can determine which tasks should be given priority.

This international company specializes in the manufacturing and supply of plastic components for the automotive industry, producing high-quality injection-molded parts for vehicles.

Jobomschrijving

For our client in Gijzegem, we are looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician m/f/x to work in a 2-shift system (6:00 AM - 2:00 PM and 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM). Are you technically skilled, eager to learn, and ready to roll up your sleeves? Then you might be the colleague we are looking for!

As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for ensuring the optimal operation of our machinery and production equipment. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.

In addition, you will contribute to technical improvements and small-scale projects aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of our installations. A positive attitude and willingness to continuously develop your skills are just as important as your technical knowledge. Experience with PLC systems is a plus, and further training will be provided internally.

Your Responsibilities
	
• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.	
• Quickly and efficiently diagnose and resolve faults in electrical, electronic, hydraulic, and mechanical systems.	
• Independently execute small technical improvement projects.	
• Participate actively in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance machine performance and reliability.	
• Help maintain a safe working environment and comply with environmental regulations.	
• Contribute to housekeeping and cleanliness standards within the workshop and production areas.

	
• You have a technical education (A2 level, Associate Degree, or Bachelor's degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation, or equivalent through experience).	
• Knowledge of injection molding machines is an advantage.	
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is a plus; additional training can be provided internally.	
• You have experience maintaining and repairing industrial machinery and equipment.	
• Experience in a manufacturing environment and with preventive maintenance is a strong asset.	
• You have a good command of Dutch.	
• You can understand technical manuals and documentation in English and/or German.	
• You have strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.	
• You can efficiently solve electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.	
• You take a proactive approach and contribute ideas to prevent future breakdowns.	
• You are able to work independently on maintenance and repair activities.	
• You are service-minded and enjoy collaborating with colleagues across different departments.	
• You communicate clearly about technical issues and solutions.	
• You work closely with production teams to minimize downtime.

Key Responsibilities

• Patient reception: Welcome and assist patients upon arrival
• Phone management: Handle incoming calls, patient inquiries, and appointment requests
• Schedule coordination: Organise and update practitioners' schedules (appointments, emergencies, reminders via email/SMS)
• Administrative communication: Communicate with patients, insurance funds, laboratories, and suppliers
• Document handling: Process patient records, forms, and insurance documentation accurately
• Practice support: Assist the team with daily operational tasks to ensure smooth workflow 
• Rigorous, motivated, friendly, and dynamic
• Strong organisational and administrative skills
• Able to work autonomously and take initiative
• Excellent command of English (required); Dutch is highly desirable
• Knowledge of Arabic or Romanian is an asset
• Previous experience in a medical or dental environment is desirable
• Good computer skills (agenda software, email, basic administration) 
Contract Details

• Initial contract: full-time (37h/week)

For our client in Gijzegem, we are looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician m/f/x to work in a 2-shift system (6:00 AM - 2:00 PM and 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM). Are you technically skilled, eager to learn, and ready to roll up your sleeves? Then you might be the colleague we are looking for!
 

As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for ensuring the optimal operation of our machinery and production equipment. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.
 

In addition, you will contribute to technical improvements and small-scale projects aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of our installations. • Help maintain a safe working environment and comply with environmental regulations.

• You have experience maintaining and repairing industrial machinery and equipment.
 
• Experience in a manufacturing environment and with preventive maintenance is a strong asset.

• You can understand technical manuals and documentation in English and/or German.

• You can efficiently solve electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.
 
• You take a proactive approach and contribute ideas to prevent future breakdowns.
 
• You are able to work independently on maintenance and repair activities.
 
• You are service-minded and enjoy collaborating with colleagues across different departments.
 
• You communicate clearly about technical issues and solutions.
 
• You work closely with production teams to minimize downtime.

As a Sales Support Specialist, you play a central role in ensuring a smooth and professional experience for our business partners and internal stakeholders.

You act as a key coordination point between Sales, Finance, Operations, and our external partners, supporting the full lifecycle of sales-related requests.

• Excellent organizational and multitasking skills

Apply 
 

Company
 

Imec performs world-leading research in nano-electronics. Imec leverages its scientific knowledge with the innovative power of its global partnerships in ICT, healthcare and energy. Imec delivers industry-relevant technology solutions. In a unique high-tech environment, its international top talent is committed to providing the building blocks for a better life in a sustainable society. Over 5000 expert scientists from over 95 countries shape tomorrow’s world with their research which is typically 5 to 10 years ahead of the market. Imec is headquartered in Leuven (Belgium) and has offices in the Netherlands, Taiwan, US, China, Japan and India. 

The Imec RF/mmWave and High-Speed ADC group in Leuven enjoys a world-class reputation in advanced high speed ADC and in millimeter-wave (mm-wave) RF Designs. In these fields our expertise is in the design of record-breaking high sampling rate ADCs and integrated RF/mm-wave front-ends in advanced CMOS and III-V based technologies. The design group also performs research in the fields of circuit design for advanced (optical) wireline communication, future RF technologies, mm-Wave sensing for life sciences, and mm-Wave imaging. 

The circuit design group is technically mentored by Piet Wambacq and Jan Craninckx and has an established state-of-the-art research reputation that has been confirmed over the years by our extensive presence in top conferences in solid-state circuit design, such as ISSCC, RFIC, ESSCIRC, VLSI and CICC. 

 

As an independent research center, we collaborate closely with top players in both industry and academia, giving our people continuous exposure to both the latest evolutions in industrial challenges and approaches, as well as into the newest emerging academic ideas and paradigms.
 

What you will do
 

We are looking for an experienced IC design researcher who can participate actively in the innovation and design of advanced RF/mm-wave and high speed (Gs/s) integrated circuits in the most advanced CMOS and IIIV technologies. 
 

Your key responsibilities will be: 
 
 

• Research and design of innovative high-speed, low-power RF and analog/mixed-signal integrated circuits in advanced CMOS and IIIV technologies.  

• Drive the bottom-up evolution of these integrated circuits considering the evolution of scaling.  

• Together with the team, bring new ideas and new technical innovations based on your solid technical experience.  

• Take part in technical interactions with external partners and towards new prospects.

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities for your career development. 
 
 

• As a member of our Fab Engineering team, you will closely work with experts of the MES and related software – commonly referred to as CIM.  

• You have an active role throughout the entire equipment lifecycle, from automation specification during procurement, to requirement gathering after commissioning, to operational improvement after production release. You make sure that operations and engineering requirements regarding CIM integration are sufficiently specified and can be implemented accordingly. To enable this implementation, you need to understand equipment behavior and communication capabilities – which frequently requires exploration and diligent testing.

Who you are
