• You may take the lorry home – can leave from your place of residence
    
• Language: German or English (minimum)
    
• Candidates may live in Belgium (German payroll)

 Requirements 

National routes, with occasional trips across the border to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, or France.

No experience is required; we are looking for passion and motivation for vehicle transport.

A CE driving licence, Code 95 qualification, and a valid medical fitness certificate are required.

Are you passionate about SAP and eager to work in an innovative IT landscape with first-adopter technologies?

At Joris Ide, SAP plays a key role in supporting and optimising our business processes across Europe. As a SAP FICO Consultant, you contribute to third-line support, system enhancements and end-to-end projects, working closely with both IT and the business. Ready to make an impact? Ide-al!

What does your day look like?

• You research new SAP applications and functionalities to support business use cases.
• You build new processes and continuously optimise existing ones.
• You roll out the SAP template to new factories and countries.
• You work closely with business process owners and key stakeholders.
• You participate in blueprint and fit-gap analyses.
• You analyse and understand business processes and requirements and translate them into functional designs.
• You configure the system and write functional and technical specifications.
• You document and test new functionalities thoroughly.
• You support the business during acceptance testing and go-live.
• You play a key role throughout all project phases, from start to finish.
• You work with the latest SAP technologies, including SAP S/4HANA.

Who are we looking for?

• You have profound knowledge of SAP FICO (Finance & Controlling)
• You are familiar with business processes and their implementation in SAP
• You have strong analytical skills
• You have a proactive, solution-oriented mindset
• You enjoy working in an informal, no-nonsense environment
• You work independently but collaborate easily with colleagues
• You are interested in a manufacturing environment
• You are willing to travel occasionally within Europe
• You speak English; knowledge of Dutch or French is a plus
• You are able to debug programming codePersoonsgebonden competenties (soft skills):
• Analyseren
• Communiceren
• Initiatief
• Plannen en organiseren
• Resultaatgerichtheid
• Samenwerken

EOC Group is growing its hotmelt adhesives business (Exomelt), as part of a portfolio of startups and new ventures. We are looking for a hands-on, dynamic Technical Service & Development Specialist to be the technical face of hotmelts to our customers, translating their applications, processes and specifications into the right hotmelt solution, and driving technical business development on the ground.
 

You will need a thorough, practical understanding of hot melt adhesives and some formulation know-how of your own, but you won't be doing deep chemistry alone. You can lean on a team of formulation and chemistry specialists to turn your technical offers into robust products. This is a customer-facing, solution-oriented role for someone who is as comfortable on a customer's production line as in a technical discussion.

 

What will you do?

• You understand customers' applications, processes and specifications in depth, and translate them into the right hotmelt solution and a compelling technical offer.
• You drive technical business development, identifying and pursuing opportunities with new and existing customers in a hands-on, dynamic way.
• Once a solution is proposed, you support customers with in-line application advice, helping them run and troubleshoot hotmelt products on their equipment.
• You act as the technical liaison between customers and EOC's formulation and chemistry specialists, briefing the team on customer requirements and translating technical results back to customers.
• You provide training to agents and distributors who are intensively used to market our products.
• You track technical market trends and innovations in hotmelt adhesives, and bring relevant insights back into EOC's product and technology roadmap.
• You represent EOC and the Hotmelts business at industry conferences and trade shows, building EOC's technical reputation and network in the hotmelt adhesives market.

Who are you? 

• You bring a thorough understanding of hotmelt adhesives (EVA, APAO, rubber-based, polyolefin, or similar hotmelt technologies) and their end-use applications.
• You have working formulation know-how, enough to have credible technical conversations and shape a technical offer, while relying on specialists for detailed formulation work.
• You hold a chemistry degree or equivalent technical qualification (preferred).
• You are hands-on and dynamic, with a genuine drive for technical business development, comfortable owning a customer relationship from technical scoping through to in-line support.
• You communicate and build relationships strongly across customers, internal specialists, and management.
• You are willing and able to travel approximately 50% of the time, mainly shorter trips to customer sites, conferences and trade shows, not extended multi-week travel.
• You have a self-starting mindset suited to a startup environment, comfortable with ambiguity and building processes as the business scales.
You are fluent in English and German; additional European languages are an asset given EOC's customer base.

jobs.occupation: Senior Accountant: A Dynamic and Evolving Sector
jobs.description:
About the company

Our client is a well-established player in the logistics and transportation sector, operating across multiple sites and international flows. In a context of strong operational activity, the company is looking to strengthen its accounting team to support its growth and the increasing complexity of its operations.

The company offers a dynamic working environment where responsiveness and accuracy are essential to managing significant and diverse financial flows.

Your role

As a Senior Accountant, you will join an accounting team and play a key role in ensuring the accuracy and reliability of the accounts within a high-volume, multi-site environment.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Managing general accounting and ensuring the accuracy and reliability of the accounts across several entities or sites.
• Participating in monthly and annual closings in a context of high and diverse business volumes.
• Monitoring and analysing operational costs (transportation, fuel, subcontracting) and identifying opportunities for optimisation.
• Performing bank and accounting reconciliations, ensuring the consistency of multi-site financial flows.
• Collaborating with operational teams to ensure reliable and accurate financial information.
• Contributing to the improvement of accounting processes in an industry where speed of execution is key.

Your profile

• You have at least 8 years of solid experience in general accounting, ideally in a high-volume operational environment.
• You hold a Bachelor's degree in Accounting.
• You are fluent in French, English and Dutch, both spoken and written.
• You are detail-oriented and able to maintain an overview while managing a high volume of transactions.
• You are responsive and comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change quickly.
• You enjoy working as part of a team and are comfortable collaborating with operational stakeholders on a daily basis.

Our client is a global leader in connecting, fixing, lifting, and anchoring technology for the construction industry. Part of a major international group, they operate across 60 locations worldwide and contribute to some of the most sustainable and cutting-edge building projects globally, including the Paris Metro Rail project, the Burj Khalifa, and the Kennedy Space Centre. 

Jobomschrijving

• Develop and implement the CI program in consultation with site managers.
• Ensure follow-up and successful delivery of projects from start to finish.
• Lead multiple projects, both large and small, from design to execution.
• Craft custom solutions and provide expert insights to exceed client expectations.
• Collaborate with stakeholders, management, and contractors to ensure project success.
• Develop, layout, and optimize industrial processes.
• Collect and analyze data to design, test, and implement new or improved processes.
• Support CI projects and Kaizen initiatives on-site.
• Implement best practices from other sites and help transition to Industry 4.0.
• Contribute to automation projects and build stability and productivity on critical machines.
• Supervise operational and CI projects from start to finish with the site team.
• Deliver training related to Kaizen, VSM, and CI methodologies.

• Engineering degree.
• Proven experience in process improvement, Lean tools, and project management.
• ERP systems knowledge.
• Familiarity with drawing packages and programming tools for robotics.
• Dutch, French, and English.
• Strong analytical skills, technical insight, and ability to work under deadlines.

Are you a night owl with a talent for solving technical challenges?

Do you thrive in a modern production environment where teamwork and quality are top priorities? Then this is the opportunity for you!

Your role

As a Maintenance Technician in the fixed night shift, you are essential to our production process. You ensure that machines operate at their best, perform preventive maintenance, and resolve malfunctions quickly and effectively. With your technical skills and problem-solving mindset, you keep the production running even while the world sleeps.

What will you do?

• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on machines and installations.

• Detect, analyze, and fix malfunctions (primarily electrical, ideally with mechanical expertise).

• Start up and optimize production lines.

• Actively contribute to improving the reliability and efficiency of the equipment.

• Collaborate with a team and report to the technical service manager.

Work schedule

• 2 workdays (2 x 7.36 hours) and 2 weekend days (2 x 11 hours), offering a steady yet varied schedule.

 

 

• A technical degree or relevant experience in a production environment.

• Broad technical knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and pneumatics; PLC knowledge is a plus.

• A flexible, positive attitude and strong problem-solving skills.

• A team player who is eager to learn and improve.

• Fluency in Dutch or English.

Are you an experienced procurement professional looking to make an impact in a dynamic international aviation environment? As a Senior Purchaser, you will play a key role in ensuring the availability of critical parts and materials that keep our helicopter operations running safely and efficiently worldwide.

Acting as the link between operational departments and our supplier network, you will balance urgent operational requirements with commercial performance, supply continuity, quality, lead times and cost efficiency. In addition to day-to-day purchasing activities, you will help drive continuous improvement across our procurement processes, supplier strategies and supply chain performance.

👉Please note that this is an expression of interest only. We are currently building a talent pool for future opportunities and are not actively recruiting for this position at this time.

Your responsibilities include:

• 
Managing strategically important supplier relationships and acting as the main point of contact for supplier-related matters. 

• 
Driving supplier performance improvements focused on service levels, lead times, cost efficiency and overall performance.

• 
Collaborating with internal stakeholders to resolve supplier performance issues and ensure continuity of supply. 

• 
Managing procurement activities, purchase orders and supplier agreements while ensuring compliance with agreed terms.

• 
Monitoring open purchase orders and proactively following up to avoid operational delays. 

• 
Maintaining accurate purchasing records and ERP system data.

• 
Providing support for Aircraft on Ground (AOG) situations and participating in the on-call rotation approximately every 4 to 5 weeks.

• 
Acting quickly on urgent procurement requests to minimize aircraft downtime. 

• 
Supporting the development of procurement processes, supplier strategies and supply chain initiatives.

• 
Identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, supplier performance and cost control across the organization.

We are looking for a proactive and commercially minded procurement professional who thrives in a fast-paced operational environment and enjoys building strong supplier relationships.

You bring:

• 
A bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience. 

• 
Previous experience in a purchasing role. 

• 
Experience working with ERP systems such as Navision or SAP. 

• 
Strong negotiation and influencing skills. 

• 
Professional proficiency in English; French is considered an advantage.

• 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• 
Good IT skills and digital literacy.

• 
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 

• 
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

• 
The ability to remain flexible and resilient under pressure.

• 
A collaborative approach and the ability to build strong relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Are you ready to begin or further develop your career in procurement within an international aviation environment? As a Junior Purchaser, you help ensure that the parts and services needed for our base and line maintenance activities are available at the right time, in the right place and at the best possible cost.

Working closely with experienced purchasers, internal stakeholders and suppliers, you will support an accurate and reliable purchasing process. You will follow up open orders, maintain procurement data and help resolve delivery issues in accordance with our internal procedures.

👉Please note that this is an expression of interest only. We are currently building a talent pool for future opportunities and are not actively recruiting for this position at this time.

Your responsibilities include:

• 
Creating and managing purchase orders while checking pricing, accuracy and compliance with agreed terms and internal procedures.

• 
Monitoring open purchase orders and following up with suppliers to support the timely delivery of parts and services.

• 
Maintaining accurate purchasing records, supplier information and data within our ERP and procurement systems.

• 
Identifying and escalating potential delays, discrepancies and supply risks.

• 
Acting as a day-to-day contact for suppliers regarding order status, delivery information and discrepancies.

• 
Supporting the resolution of late deliveries, shortages and other delivery-related issues.

• 
Assisting with supplier performance monitoring and collecting information for follow-up actions.

• 
Working closely with colleagues in purchasing, maintenance, logistics and other internal departments.

• 
Contributing ideas to improve order follow-up, data quality, team efficiency and service levels.

• 
Gradually building your procurement knowledge and taking ownership of purchasing activities.

You will also participate in the Aircraft on Ground, or AOG, on-call rotation approximately once every four to five weeks. During these time-critical situations, you will coordinate with suppliers, logistics providers and internal teams to help minimize aircraft downtime. This out-of-office-hours support can be provided remotely from home.

We are looking for an accurate, proactive and motivated colleague who is eager to learn and develop within an international procurement environment.

You bring:

• 
A bachelor’s degree or an equivalent level gained through experience.

• 
Initial experience in purchasing, supply chain, logistics or an administrative role, which is considered an advantage.

• 
Experience with an ERP system such as Navision or SAP, or a willingness to learn.

• 
Professional proficiency in English.

• 
Knowledge of French is considered an advantage.

• 
Good written and verbal communication skills.

• 
Good IT skills and digital literacy.

• 
An interest in developing your negotiation and influencing skills.

• 
Strong organizational and analytical abilities.

• 
A proactive, solution-oriented and results-driven approach.

• 
Attention to detail and the ability to remain flexible under pressure.

• 
A collaborative mindset and the ability to build professional relationships.

• 
A genuine willingness to learn and grow within the role.

We are looking for a warehouse worker for a company in Wavre specializing in acoustic and vibration isolation solutions for buildings and industrial equipment. You hold a valid forklift truck certificate.

Your tasks:

 

 
• You perform and coordinate all inbound logistics activities, including receiving, inspection, registration, and storage of goods. 
 

 
• You apply incoming goods control procedures and manage delivery discrepancies with internal stakeholders. 
 

 
• You prepare, pick, pack, label, and dispatch customer and internal orders accurately and on time. 
 

 
• You supervise daily warehouse operations and coordinate team priorities to ensure efficient workflows. 
 
•  
You guide, support, and motivate the shipping and receiving clerks through hands-on leadership. 

 
• You enforce warehouse procedures and ensure compliance with safety, quality, and environmental standards. 
 

 
• You maintain inventory accuracy through cycle counts and effective stock control. 
 

 
• You monitor, analyse, and communicate warehouse performance and KPIs. 
 

 
• You identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives to increase efficiency and service levels. 

You are fluent in French and have a good command of English.

You have several years of experience in warehouse operations, shipping and receiving, or logistics coordination, including team coordination. You are highly organized, reliable, and committed to delivering accurate, high-quality results. 

You hold a valid forklift license and have experience operating warehouse handling equipment. 

You are familiar with ERP and warehouse management systems.

You communicate effectively and collaborate well with internal stakeholders across different departments. 

You lead by example and have the ability to guide, support, and motivate team members.

jobs.occupation: Key Account Manager | FMCG Non-Food | Relocation to Paris
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international player in the Non-Food FMCG sector, recognized for its portfolio of strong consumer brands and its commitment to innovation, quality, and sustainable growth. Present across multiple European markets, the company partners with major retailers and continuously invests in developing its brands, people, and commercial capabilities.

Jobomschrijving

The Key Account Manager will have the following responsibilities :

• Develop and manage strategic relationships with key retail accounts across Belgium and Luxembourg.
• Lead annual commercial negotiations, including pricing, promotions, trade terms, and joint business plans.
• Identify growth opportunities and implement account strategies to achieve sales and profitability targets.
• Drive category expansion, product launches, and promotional activations with retail partners.
• Monitor sales performance, market trends, and competitor activity to recommend corrective actions and growth initiatives.
• Prepare forecasts, business reviews, and account performance analyses for internal and external stakeholders.
• Ensure excellence in customer management while maximizing brand visibility and market share.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in a Key Account Manager or similar commercial role within FMCG
• Proven experience negotiating with Belgian retail chains.
• Excellent negotiation and relationship-building skills.
• Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.
• Fluent in French & Dutch. English is a strong asset.
• Willingness to relocate to Paris.

Our client is an international market leader in consumer electronics, with a strong presence in Belgium.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage and further develop the commercial partnership with the partner operating the four branded stores in Belgium.
• Build and maintain a strong relationship with a major Belgian telecom operator, ensuring its propositions are effectively integrated into the stores.
• Take commercial ownership of a business representing approximately. 
• Act as the central point of contact between the customer, telecom partner and internal Sales, Retail, Marketing and Supply Chain teams.
• Translate commercial strategies into concrete actions and initiatives at store level.
• Coordinate and follow up promotional plans across multiple product categories.
• Manage internal and external approval processes and ensure commercial initiatives are implemented correctly and on time.
• Prepare and monitor sales forecasts in close collaboration with Supply Chain.
• Analyze commercial performance and identify opportunities to further drive sales and business growth.
• Prepare and present commercial updates, results and business plans to key stakeholders.

• Similar experience in a commercial role such as Account Manager, Key Account Manager or Business Developer.
• Strong commercial mindset and comfortable taking ownership of an important customer portfolio.
• Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to navigate different and sometimes competing interests.
• Strong analytical capabilities and comfortable working with forecasting, sales data and commercial reporting.
• Confident communicator with strong presentation skills.
• Assertive and resilient: able to defend your position, ask the right questions and take ownership.
• Strong team player who enjoys working within an experienced and commercially driven team.
• Good command of Excel and PowerPoint.
• Fluent French and English are mandatory, with French required at a very strong professional level due to the customer and stakeholder environment.
• Dutch is an advantage, with a willingness to further develop the language considered important.

Are you looking for a stable job in a high-tech production environment where quality, innovation, and teamwork are at the heart of everything? We are recruiting a Production Operator/Production Worker for a leading company specializing in the packaging of nuts. You'll play a key role in maintaining an efficient production process while ensuring the highest quality standards.

Whether you're just starting your career or already have experience in manufacturing, we offer comprehensive training, ongoing support, and opportunities for career growth. As a Production Operator, you will work in a modern packaging facility equipped with advanced machinery, ensuring production runs smoothly and products meet our quality expectations.

Your Responsibilities

• Set up, operate, and adjust automated packaging and packing machines.

• Monitor product quality and ensure all packaged products meet company standards.

• Troubleshoot minor technical issues and perform basic maintenance tasks.

• Contribute to efficient production planning and continuous process improvement.

• Work closely with fellow operators and team leaders to achieve production targets.

• Maintain a clean, safe, and organized workplace in accordance with hygiene and safety regulations.

• You have initial experience working in a production or manufacturing environment, preferably within the fruit and vegetable industry.

• You have a good command of both Dutch and English.

• You have an affinity for technology and production processes.

• You are detail-oriented and committed to delivering high-quality work.

• You are a team player with a hands-on mentality.

• You are flexible and willing to work in shifts when required.

Robert Half is looking for a Customer Service Representative (Italian/French/English) (M/F/X) in Zaventem.

Do you have excellent knowledge of Italian, French and English? Are you looking for a permanent position within a dynamic and international team? We are seeking a customer-oriented, detail-focused team player for a growing company in the diplomatic sector.

Your responsibilities:

• Customer contact by phone and email;
• Maintain and update customer files (including specific customs documents);
• Perform daily checks, checklists, and follow up on overdue files;
• Work with proprietary software; fast and comfortable using PC;
• Collaborate with internal colleagues and external partners.

Profile:

• Excellent Italian, French and English required; -
• You must have a bachelor or masters degree.
• You live in Belgium and are eligible to work here.
• You can reach the company easily (Zaventem)
• Accurate and detail-oriented, affinity with administrative processes
• Team player, able to work independently; flexibility is a must
You must meet all requirements to be considered for this position.

As a Business Analyst, you start from the business and its processes rather than from a predefined IT solution. You engage with various stakeholders, identify their challenges and needs, and seek to understand how processes actually work today.
You analyze the current way of working, identify bottlenecks and opportunities, and work together with the business to define a clear as-is and to-be situation. You ask critical questions, align different interests and help determine which changes can deliver the greatest added value.
You then translate these insights into clear business requirements, processes, objectives and solution directions. Throughout this process, you maintain a view of the bigger picture and ensure that proposed solutions align with operational reality and the broader digitalization strategy.
You work closely with Product Owners, Project Managers, Architects, Functional Analysts and development teams. While the more functional or technical profiles focus in greater detail on the concrete software implementation, you remain primarily responsible for the business context, process logic, scope and stakeholder alignment.
Throughout the project, you remain involved in validation and decision-making, ensuring that the final solution genuinely addresses the original business problem.

• 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar role. More experience is certainly welcome
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
• You have strong communication skills and can interact comfortably with operational employees, management and IT professionals
• You communicate professionally in English and understand Dutch and French

Our client is the Belgian market leader in its sector, with a strong ambition to accelerate its international expansion.

While recognized as a leading player in its industry, the company has maintained the agility, entrepreneurial spirit, and close-knit culture of an SME. With a team of approximately 20 professionals, success relies on individuals who combine ownership, initiative, and a willingness to contribute beyond the boundaries of a traditional job description.

To support its continued growth and strengthen its internal organization, the company is looking for a Secretary General/Chief of Staff with a solid legal background and a strong operational mindset.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Secretary General acts as a trusted partner to the management team, ensuring that the company operates efficiently, compliantly, and in a structured manner.

The role is ideally suited for someone with a background as a lawyer, in-house counsel, or legal professional, who enjoys combining legal rigor with operational involvement. You will be expected to move seamlessly between strategic, cross-functional topics and day-to-day execution.

One hour you may be reviewing an important contractual matter, overseeing compliance obligations, or advising management on governance issues; the next, you may be coordinating an internal project, improving a process, organizing follow-up on key decisions, or liaising with external partners.

We are looking for an individual who combines a helicopter view with a hands-on mentality, who is equally comfortable thinking strategically and executing pragmatically.

Key Responsibilities

Governance, Legal & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, internal policies, and corporate obligations.
• Support management in assessing legal and operational risks.
• Maintain a pragmatic and business-oriented approach to legal matters.

Operational Coordination & Business Support

• Organize internal meetings, monitor action plans, and drive accountability.
• Assist the CEO and management team with strategic and operational priorities.
• Facilitate communication and collaboration across teams and external stakeholders.

Process Improvement & Organizational Excellence

• Bring structure, clarity, and consistency to internal operations.
• Review and improve processes, workflows, and internal controls.
• Ensure that priorities are translated into tangible actions and results.

HR, Administration & Corporate Support

• Support HR administration, onboarding processes, and internal policies.
• Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
• Contribute to a positive, efficient, and well-organized working environment.

Finance & Corporate Administration

• Oversee administrative aspects of invoicing, reporting, and operational follow-up.
• Coordinate with external accountants and financial advisors.
• Ensure that recurring administrative and financial processes are properly managed and monitored.

External Stakeholder Management

• Coordinate relationships with external accountants, IT providers, insurers, and other professional partners.
• Ensure that external support functions are properly managed and aligned with business needs.

Profile

We are looking for someone who:

• Holds a Master's degree in Law.
• Has approximately 5 years of professional experience, ideally as a lawyer, in-house counsel, legal advisor, or in a similar role combining legal and business responsibilities.
• Possesses a strong legal foundation and an interest in governance, compliance, and corporate organization.
• Combines analytical rigor with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset.
• Enjoys alternating between strategic thinking and operational execution.
• Is highly organized, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality work.
• Is proactive and comfortable taking ownership without requiring constant supervision.
• Thrives in an SME environment where flexibility, initiative, and entrepreneurial spirit are essential.
• Understands that in a team of 20 people, everyone contributes beyond their title and is willing to step outside their comfort zone when needed.
• Is fluent in Dutch, and English. French is a plus.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. • Team management skills

• Able to identify anomalies and suggest improvements

jobs.occupation: Senior R&D Specialist - Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy
jobs.description:
About you and this role
 

At Dow, our Analytical Science organization plays a critical role in accelerating innovation, supporting manufacturing excellence, and solving complex technical challenges across our global businesses.
 

The Analytical Science team in Seneffe is a key part of this global network, providing world-class analytical expertise to support research, product development, process optimization, and customer-focused innovation. Leveraging advanced analytical technologies and deep scientific knowledge, the team partners closely with R&D, manufacturing, and commercial organizations to deliver impactful solutions across a broad range of material science applications.
 

We now have an exciting opportunity for a 
Senior R&D Specialist – Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy to join our Analytical Science division in 
Seneffe, Belgium.
 

In this role, you will apply advanced analytical techniques to solve complex challenges in industrial chemistry and materials science. Working closely with global R&D, manufacturing, and business teams, you will provide critical insights that support product development, process optimization, manufacturing excellence, and customer-focused innovation.
 

As a subject matter expert in Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy, you will lead analytical investigations, develop new measurement methodologies in a world class NMR lab with global resources, and enhance existing analytical capabilities. This role offers the opportunity to collaborate across a diverse global network while supporting multiple high-impact projects simultaneously.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Lead analytical investigations to resolve complex technical, product, and manufacturing challenges. 

• Develop, optimize, and implement advanced NMR methodologies to expand analytical capabilities. 

• Manage and maintain state of the art NMR instrumentation including cryoprobe technology. 

• Interpret complex analytical data and provide technical leadership on projects involving materials characterization, process optimization, and product performance. 

• Drive innovation through the application of advanced analytical techniques and scientific problem solving. 

• Share technical expertise, mentor colleagues, and contribute to capability building within the Analytical Sciences community. 

• Ensure delivery of high-quality analytical results while managing multiple priorities and project timelines.  

Qualifications
 
 

• Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Polymer Science, Materials Science, Biochemistry, Physics, Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline. 

• Demonstrated expertise in Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy including method development and advanced applications, for example in multidimensional solution-state NMR, pulse programming, solid-state NMR, and/or DNP-NMR. 

• Strong knowledge in at least two of the following areas: analytical chemistry, polymer science, organic chemistry, materials science, coatings or formulation science, chemical processing, polymer characterization, or statistics/data analysis. 

• Proven track record of applying analytical science to solve complex technical challenges. 

• Experience supporting research, product development, manufacturing, or process optimization programs. 

• Fluency in English, both written and verbal. 

• Additional language skills, preferable French, Dutch, Italian, Spanish or German are an advantage.  

Additional Notes
 
 

• This position does not offer relocation assistance 

• Please submit your application in English to be eligible for consideration in the selection process.  

 

Benefits – What Dow offers you
 

We invest in you.
 

Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
 

Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
 
 

• Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives. 

• Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it. 

• Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals. 
 

• Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).   

• Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only). 
 

• Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.   

• Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations. 

• Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building. 

• Workplace culture empowering role-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs. 

• Competitive yearly vacation allowance. 

• Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents). 

• Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured. 

• Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation. 

• Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey. 

• On-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location). 

• Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more. 

• Additionally, some of our locations might offer: 
 

• Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location) 

• Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location) 

• Carbon-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)    

Join our team, we can make a difference together.

Whether it’s express deliveries, pallet transport, or construction-related materials, you’ll encounter a wide variety of jobs. Every day is different, while still offering a familiar routine. • You start your day between 5:00 and 8:00 a.m. at our site in Bornem with a cup of coffee and a vehicle check.
    
• You will deliver various goods throughout Belgium. Occasionally, you may cross the border, but you will always return home at the end of the day.

• You have experience as a CE truck driver.
    
• You have good knowledge of the road network.
    
• You have a good command of Dutch or English due to safety requirements.

• A competitive salary.
    
• A great working atmosphere and the opportunity to drive modern, high-quality equipment.

Can you tick all the boxes above? Apply today and join our team!

• You have a Category C driving licence and the required certificates.
    
• You have a valid ADR certificate.

• You are physically fit.
    
• You have experience as a Category C truck driver.
    
• You have good knowledge of the road network.

jobs.description:
Welcome to Traxial: Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

At Traxial, we are designing the next generation of high-performance, energy-efficient systems. We’re looking for a PE & Motor Control Engineer to join our innovative team and play a pivotal role in creating systems that push boundaries in robotics and industry.
 

This is what you’ll do: 
 
 

•  

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design, develop, and optimize high-efficiency power electronic & motor control systems. 
   
 

•  

Create detailed requirements and functional designs for power electronic circuits & motor controllers.. 
   
 

•  

Perform simulations, testing, and validation to ensure system performance meets all requirements. 
   
 

•  

Troubleshoot and resolve issues during the design, prototyping, and manufacturing phases. 
   
 

•  

Ensure products are compliant with relevant standards for power drive systems. 
   
 

•  

Stay informed about the latest trends and developments in power electronics in robotics & industrial applications. 
  

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

A Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

Minimum of 3 years of experience in power electronics & circuit design.
   
 

•  

Strong knowledge of inverters and motor controllers.
   
 

•  

Experience with PCB design tools such as Kicad, Altium or equivalent.
   
 

•  

Experience with electronic circuit simulation software such as LTSpice or equivalent.
   
 

•  

Understanding of thermal management and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC).
   
 

•  

Previous experience in model-based design and/or FPGA platforms will be considered a plus.
   
 

•  

A team player with excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset.
   
 

•  

Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Flexible and understanding that start and end times may vary daily.​

Fluves is a pioneer in fiber optic sensing, combining advanced DTS and DAS technology, real-time data processing and smart analytics to monitor and protect critical infrastructure.
 

Through its Marlinks product line, Fluves monitors more than 1,800 km of subsea power cables linking offshore wind farms and power grids. The DALI product line detects leaks and intrusions in water networks. Fluves Corrosion assesses the risk of corrosion under insulation in chemical plants.
 

Fluves is a growing international scale-up, active in critical infrastructure markets around the world.
 

Our products handle high-volume DAS/DTS signals. Doing that reliably depends on a IT stack with a set of backend (edge) services that ingest data, orchestrate workloads, expose APIs, and integrate outputs into our application. We are looking for a software engineer to build and evolve this stack, ensuring secure, scalable, and observable processing from field deployments through to client-facing applications.
 

What you will do
 

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated software engineer for the following responsibilities:
 
 

• Take an active role in the development of the edge-server platform, application backend and API integrations. 

• Challenge existing poor architectural patterns constructively and bring structure. Propose, showcase and implement architectural alternatives to improve the computational flow. 

• Actively and continuously improve and modernize existing components, focusing on incremental, high-impact enhancements. 

• Extend the existing monitoring and benchmarks and profile the current code to identify and improve bottle necks. 

• Collaborate closely with colleagues in the product development team to design, build, and continuously improve product features in the edge and application layer, and deliver new integrations with internal, third-party, and client platforms. 

• Document best practices and clarify trade-offs to shorten the time to deployment of new data product features. 

Who you are
 
 

• Holds a degree in computer science or computer engineering, or has equivalent experience. 

• At least 3 years of experience. 

• Professional Python developer with proven experience with backend development in Django, Django restframework, Postgres and Timescaledb. 

• Track record in parallel computing and multiprocessing and/or experience with message brokers, storage backends and task queues (e.g. RabbitMQ, Redis, Celery …). 

• Understanding the limitations of computer hardware (CPU and GPU and disk storage patterns). 

• Knowledge of low-level programming languages and/or GPU architecture. 

• Preferably feels comfortable with scientific Python libraries for array computing such as Numpy and Xarray. 

• Some notion of the frequency domain and Fourier transformation is appreciated. 

• Clear and open communicator striving for clarity with a documentation reflex. 

• Writes unit tests, keeps (sphinx) documentation up to date, knows git and is familiar with CI/CD pipelines. 

• Uses AI tools as a standard part of how you write, review, and reason about code, while remaining accountable for the outcome. 

• Down to earth, hands-on problem solver that likes to take a deep dive into computational challenges. 

• Fluency in English, both spoken and written. Proficiency in one additional language — Dutch, French, or German — is highly desirable, along with strong writing and presentation skills. 

• Current residence in Belgium.

Shape the architecture behind the next generation of AI supercomputers.
 

Join imec and design the future of AI computing
 

What if your architectural decisions could influence the future of artificial intelligence at the scale of the world's most advanced computing systems?

At imec, you will work at the intersection of AI, semiconductor innovation, and large-scale computing architectures. Together with leading experts in computing systems, chip technology, software, and artificial intelligence, you will help define how future AI infrastructure is built, optimized, and scaled.

This is not a product maintenance role. It is an opportunity to explore breakthrough architectures that could shape the next decade of AI and high-performance computing.
 

What you will do
 

As a Principal AI & High-Performance Computing Architect, you will drive innovation across the entire computing stack, from AI applications and system software to processors, accelerators, and semiconductor technologies.

You will create models, simulations, and design explorations that help identify the most promising paths toward future AI computing systems that deliver significant improvements in performance, energy efficiency, and sustainability.

Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Exploring architectural solutions for next-generation AI and high-performance computing clusters. 

• Analysing the behaviour and performance characteristics of large-scale AI workloads. 

• Developing performance models that identify bottlenecks and opportunities for innovation. 

• Evaluating future processor, accelerator, memory, and system designs. 

• Collaborating with experts in computer architecture, AI, semiconductor technology, system software, and modelling. 

• Defining requirements for future AI computing platforms and processor architectures. 

• Guiding strategic research directions through data-driven performance analysis and projections. 

• Contributing to breakthrough innovations that improve performance, energy efficiency, operational cost, and environmental impact. 

Who you are
 
 

• Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or relevant STEM degree, with at least around 8 years of experience.   

• Experience with performance analysis, engineering, and optimization of HPC applications, such as molecular dynamics and computational fluid dynamics,  

• Experience in AI for HPC is a plus.   

• Experience with distributed AI/ML applications, such as LLM training and inference.   

• Experience in system performance modeling ranging from a single device (e.g. a GPU) to a machine scale (e.g. a cluster).  

• Good understanding of GPU (preferably XPU) system architectures, distributed programming models, runtime resource management, and microarchitecture.   

• Strong programming ability in C++ and Python. CUDA knowledge is considered a plus.   

• Your communication and interpersonal skills enable you to work in a dynamic, distributed team. You actively share experiences and knowledge with colleagues. A history of mentoring more junior engineers and interns is a huge plus.

As a Bio Process Technician at BBEPP, you choose a job that is truly different. You will work with a team of engineers and technicians on a wide variety of innovative projects. No routine work, but an inspiring environment where you gain new insights, deepen your expertise, and further develop your talents. Together with your colleagues, you scale up and optimize bio-based processes (from lab to industrial scale) that contribute to a sustainable bio-economy and to solutions for today’s and tomorrow’s climate challenges.

In the role of a Bio Process Technician, you are responsible for preparing processes and setting up (pre-) industrial pilot installations. In addition to setting up these test installations, you will also carry out the different process steps and operate the corresponding equipment. In consultation with the process engineers, you closely monitor the process parameters of the scale-up processes assigned to you (fermentation, biocatalysis, purification). You regularly take samples, analyse them in the lab, and critically evaluate the results, actively contributing ideas for potential improvements. Moreover, you act as a true ambassador for safety, structure, and hygiene in the process environment.

We're looking for a motivated weekend employee (2 x 12-hour nights per week + 2 x 8-hour days per month). You're a hands-on technician with a no-nonsense mentality who enjoys actively participating in innovative bio-based processes.

You work independently, methodically, and accurately, and you have knowledge of biotechnological processes such as fermentation or biocatalysis, or experience in process industry, chemistry, or food. Experience with bio-based products and processes is a plus. You are a real team player and communicate fluently in both Dutch and English.

The ideal candidate holds a bachelor’s degree in chemistry, biochemistry, HBO5 chemistry/biochemistry, or a laboratory technician diploma. In this case, previous work experience is not required. If you already have experience in the process industry, chemistry, or food sector, an A2 diploma (secondary education) in a scientific or technical field is also sufficient.

Nobody is perfect, at Bio Base Europe Pilot Plant, there is plenty of room to learn by doing! Can’t check every box above, but are you flexible, eager to learn, and open to tailored training? Do you enjoy taking on challenges, with a healthy dose of pioneer spirit running through your veins? Then don’t hesitate to get in touch!

For a key Belgian player in the energy transition, JOBS IN MIND is looking for a Site Engineer to join a major offshore high-voltage infrastructure project. You will contribute to the development of new energy infrastructure connecting Belgian offshore wind power to the electricity grid.
 

Your role
 

As Site Engineer, you will be part of the construction team and work across the sites in Vlissingen and Schiedam, combined with the office in Brussels. You report to the Construction Lead and act as a key link between engineering, construction, quality and the EPC contractor.
 

Your responsibilities include:

• Reviewing technical documentation submitted by the contractor 

• Coordinating suppliers and external parties on site 

• Managing and structuring incoming inspection reports 

• Preparing weekly and monthly reports 

• Supporting technical analyses and improvement initiatives  

You will work in a multidisciplinary team with inspectors, outfitting engineers, design engineers, construction managers and other project specialists.
 

The project
 

The project involves the development of a new offshore energy hub to connect Belgian offshore wind farms to the electricity grid. The infrastructure includes:
 
 

• An artificial energy island with offshore transmission infrastructure 

• AC substations at 66 kV and 220 kV 

• 6 export cable systems of approximately 50 km each  

Construction of the substations is currently ongoing in Vlissingen and Schiedam. Outfitting activities are starting in summer 2026, making this a key position for the next phase of the project.

Introduction
 

Our truck factory in Ghent is the largest Volvo Group truck factory worldwide. Every day, almost 3000 colleagues assemble top-quality trucks here. Innovation and continuous improvement are standard on our agenda, and that from day 1. We therefore firmly believe in the philosophy of Lean Manufacturing, in which attention to quality, safety and the environment are our top priority. Our site today has many different departments, but we all have one thing in common: passion for what we do. 
 

Meet your team
 

You will join a team of engineers who work both independently and in a team. Together we support each other to give the customer a qualitative and feasible solution to meet the desired truck specifications.
 

Your ideal job?
 

On our assembly line and in the Market Adaptation Center, all requests for a customized truck are handled according to the following principle: Our customer? He is king. Introduction
 

Volvo Action Service (VAS) takes care of our Volvo Group customers across Europe whenever one of their vehicles has a problem. Delivering great customer service is at the heart of our operation, as we take a proactive approach to get vehicles back on the road as quickly and smoothly as possible.
 

This is us, your new colleagues
 

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.
 

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.
 

This is the job
 
 

• Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind. 

• Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress. 

• A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box. 

• Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business  

Are you the one?
 
 

• You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers. 

• You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported. 

• You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset. 

• You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up. 

• You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills. 

• You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients. 

• You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Czech and Polish.

jobs.occupation: warehouse worker / forklift operator - night shift
jobs.description:
Looking for a permanent job on the fixed night shift within an international logistics environment? Then this job might be just the thing for you.

Your responsibilities:

• Loading and unloading containers and trucks with the forklift according to applicable safety procedures.
• Operating the forklift and electric pallet trucks for the efficient internal transport of goods.
• Managing and accurately moving goods within the cold warehouse.
• As a warehouse worker and forklift driver, you work closely with colleagues to ensure the logistics process runs smoothly at night.
You work in a fixed night shift. Start time can be at 16:00 or at 18:30. You choose one of the two for your entire employment.

VG 458/BUOSAP

You hold a forklift certificate, or are willing to take a practical driving test.

You are fluent in Dutch or English (both spoken and written).

You are a great team player.

You prioritize working safely and accurately.

You ensure an optimal flow of goods throughout the entire night shift.

Job description 

Depending on your location, you will start your journey from Genk, Antwerp, or Zeebrugge. You are free to choose your own departure time, provided that you leave before 5:00 a.m. Please note that you must inspect the vehicles for any damage before departure. Ensuring the load is properly secured is a key responsibility!

If you prefer to stay overnight during your routes, this can certainly be discussed.

With the loading list assigned to you, you will have a clear overview of your route and know exactly where to go.

Are you able to provide a highly secure parking location for the truck at your home? Great! If not, you will use your own vehicle to travel to the departure location each time and return the truck in excellent condition after completing your route.

You are able to communicate effectively in Dutch, French, and/or English.

 Requirements 

National routes, with occasional trips across the border to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, or France.

No experience is required; we are looking for passion and motivation for vehicle transport.

A CE driving licence, Code 95 qualification, and a valid medical fitness certificate are required.

Job description 

Your job in a nutshell
 In the evening, when others go to sleep, your workday begins. Between 22h and 00h, you depart with a refrigerated truck towards your first delivery.
 You drive throughout Belgium and deliver to various supermarkets. No stressful city driving, but clear routes and a well-organised schedule.

What will you do?
 • You load and unload using an electric or manual pallet jack
 • You deliver fruits and vegetables to supermarkets across Belgium
 • You check deliveries and documents
 • You drive independently and take responsibility for your own route
 • You ensure correct and safe deliveries

What does your day look like?
 • You start at night at the depot, pick up your truck and depart on your route
 • During your shift you typically make 2 to 6 stops per night and complete your deliveries efficiently. Your workday lasts on average 12 to 15 hours, but you work within a clear and structured system without chaos or unnecessary stress
 • After your round, you return to the depot (Geel) and your workday is finished—and the best part? You simply sleep at home in your own bed

What do we expect from you?
 • CE driving licence with certificates (Code 95 – medical fitness certificate)
 • Good knowledge of English is a must, Lithuanian is a plus
 • You are flexible and customer-oriented
 • You live in the Geel region
 • You perform physical work with a smile
 • Willingness to work weekends (Saturdays and Sundays)

What do you get in return?
 • A very good salary in relation to your effort and hours
 • Many working hours, no hotel nights—always sleeping at home
 • Working with clear structure and fixed routes
 • Permanent contract after a successful temporary employment period

Interested? Apply today and jump on board!

 Requirements 

• CE driving licence with certificates
 • Flexible mindset
 • Good knowledge of English, Russian or Lithuanian
 • Living in the Geel region

1 Master Thesis "Differentiable Ray Tracing for Radio Propagation Modeling" - JOB ID: 269596  * Differentiable ray-tracing frameworks such as Sionna RT have become powerful tools for wireless channel modeling. This master's thesis advances differentiable ray tracing for realistic large-scale radio propagation, either by integrating atmospheric refraction models or by learning electromagnetic environment properties directly from channel measurements.
 * Under the guidance of our team, you will implement and evaluate atmospheric refraction models in the differentiable ray-tracing framework Sionna RT.
 * You will implement and evaluate differentiable algorithms for estimating electromagnetic material properties from real-world channel measurements.
 * You will learn how to develop and validate simulation workflows for large-scale radio propagation, combining physics-based propagation models with discrete ray tracing, low-complexity ray-shooting, and gradient-based optimisation techniques.

 * You will gain hands-on experience with modern wireless communication simulation frameworks, electromagnetic wave propagation, physics-based and inverse modeling, and AI-enabled optimisation methods.
 * You will work closely with researchers in wireless communications and contribute to the development of next-generation ray-tracing methods for realistic large-scale propagation prediction.

Your qualifications:

 * You are pursuing a master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field.
 * First experience in at least one of the following areas: (i) atmospheric refraction modelling for ray tracing or (ii) learning environment properties using differentiable ray tracing. Candidates should explain in their cover letter how their background matches one of these areas and demonstrate relevant expertise.
 * You have solid programming skills in Python; experience with object-oriented software development is an advantage.
 * You have a basic understanding of electromagnetics, wave propagation, wireless communications, or computer graphics.
 * Knowledge of ray tracing, geometric optics, optimisation methods, or machine learning is beneficial but not required.
 * Experience with scientific computing frameworks (e.g., NumPy, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Sionna) is a plus.
 * You enjoy developing algorithms and solving challenging scientific and engineering problems.
 * You are able to work independently while collaborating effectively in an interdisciplinary research team.
 * English language skills commensurate with the role

1 Master Thesis "Bi-Static Sensing of UAVs" - JOB ID: 269595  * Reliable detection and localisation of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is becoming increasingly important for future civilian and commercial applications. This master's thesis focuses on the development and experimental validation of antenna arrays for bi-static sensing of UAVs using software-defined radio technology.
 * Under the guidance of our team, you will design, build, and characterise circularly polarised patch antennas for different array geometries for UAV sensing applications.
 * You will integrate the antenna arrays into an SDR-based testbed and perform experimental validation.
 * You will support us in developing simulation models for bi-static multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) sensing and realise a real-time measurement setup that can estimate azimuth, elevation and range.

 * You will gain hands-on experience with antenna design, beamforming, direction-of-arrival estimation, and software-defined radio systems.
 * You will learn how to validate the sensing algorithms using a state-of-the-art motion capture system.
 * You will work closely with researchers in wireless sensing and contribute to the development of next-generation UAV detection and localisation technologies.

The Com... 1 Master Thesis "Characterizing features of Driving Dynamics on a Motorcycle Probe Vehicle" - JOB ID: 269966  * For this master's thesis you will investigate extensive time series of driving dynamics obtained from multiple motorcycle rides by multiple riders on given tracks.
 * You will support us in working out characteristic features in driving dynamics that differentiate the different riders.
 * You will investigate the possibility of using simulation software (like IPG Motorcycle maker) to use the obtained data for setting up simulations of motorcycle movements.

 * Under the guidance of our researchers, you will implement model building approaches to extract characterizing features from motorcyclist data.

Ownership Lifestyle Check - lab systems

Lab operator frontend and backend

 * Maintaining and improving the Capacitor/Electron build and the GitHub Actions release pipeline. 
 * Owning the device configuration backend, a Django REST backend that stores lab and device configuration, authenticates lab operators, generates signed Google Cloud Storage URLs and receives logs from the field. 
 * Keeping the REST APIs, PostgreSQL models, authentication bridge and upload pipeline secure and reliable.

Product-wide improvements and integrations

 * Driving refactoring, dependency updates and reliability improvements across the Lifestyle Check stack.

 * Maintaining and improving CI/CD pipelines, build tooling and release workflows.

Data quality & collaboration

 * Quality and robustness ownership - you design and maintain solutions that are reliable, fit our business needs and are reasonably easy to operate and maintain. 
 * Careful handling of health data - data protection and security are not a formality here. 
 * Collaboration with our development team.

Your profile

 * Strong Python skills - you can find your way into unfamiliar, grown code and own both Flask and Django backends.

 * Strong SQL and experience with relational databases (we use PostgreSQL and SQLite).

 * Windows engineering - services, packaging, installers, firewall; our application runs unattended on the on-site PCs. 
 * PyInstaller + NSIS experience, or comparable desktop-deployment tooling. 
 * PHP / Laravel basics so you can read and coordinate changes in our admin platform. 
 * Security awareness - patching, handling secrets, dependency management, GDPR in a health context.

Your future responsibilities
We are seeking a motivated Master Student to carry out a Master Thesis in the field of nonlinear integrated photonics, in collaboration with an established industrial and research partner. This thesis focuses on advanced optical modulation techniques and experimental characterization of photonic systems. You will work on the implementation and analysis of coherent modulation schemes, including IQ modulation for carrier-suppressed single-sideband (CS-SSB) operation and dual-sideband modulation. The work combines numerical modeling, hands-on experimental characterization, and system-level demonstrations using heterodyne measurement techniques. If you are eager to deepen your expertise in integrated photonics, optical modulation, and experimental photonics, this thesis offers an excellent opportunity to develop strong technical and research skills.

 * Development and analysis of integrated photonic modulation schemes:
 ** Conducting a focused literature review on coherent optical modulation and photonic integrated circuits.
 ** Implementing and analyzing IQ modulation schemes for CS-SSB generation.
 ** Investigating and comparing dual-sideband modulation techniques.
 * Experimental characterization of photonic and acousto-optic components:
 ** Characterizing the performance of an acousto-optic modulator (AOM).
 ** Setting up and performing heterodyne measurement experiments.
 ** Analyzing measured data and extracting key performance metrics.
 * Numerical modeling and data analysis using dedicated simulation and scripting tools (e.g., Matlab, Python, Comsol).

Please not: roles are open at multiple seniority levels for demonstrated excellence.At Tesla Engineering Germany in Freiburg, we're building the future of sustainable energy by developing innovative power electronics for energy storage and vehicle charging systems. You will own the cradle-to-grave mechanical design of tightly integrated, high-volume electromechanical systems, from first concept through prototyping and validation to mass production. You'll work closely with Electrical, Product, Reliability, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams. This is an opportunity to own key projects, use modern tools, and work in state-of-the-art facilities on power electronics that ship in Tesla products worldwide. Your work contributes directly to the world's transition to sustainable energy. At the lead level, you will also set technical direction and guide a small team of mechanical engineers.

What You’ll Do

- Own the electromechanical design of injection-molded plastics, sheet metal, high-pressure die castings, heat sinks / cold plates, insulation systems, magnetics, HV/LV interconnects, busbars, and PCBA-adjacent structures

Department: SE FIN TI BC

Job Grade: Germany - Non Senior Management ÜT-Kreis

Mode of Employment: Full Time or Part Time / Permanent

A Snapshot of Your Day 

For the first 18-24 months this role has one clear focus: accompanying the carve-out of Transformation of Industry and supporting preparations for a potential future FP&A organization, hand in hand with the management team. On 25 August 2026 Siemens Energy announced preparations for the legal and operational separation of Transformation of Industry into a standalone company, a fast-growing business with around 17,000 employees, €6 billion of revenue and a double-digit profit margin.
At the moment, the central Business Controlling team of Transformation of Industry is preparing to evolve towards a potential Corporate FP&A department for a future standalone company, which could bring together more than 100 finance professionals. Its possible target organization, processes and reporting architecture are still being explored, and you will contribute to this work. You report directly to the Vice President of FP&A and work alongside the management team. The role asks you to hold two hats at once: you coordinate and organize the transformation centrally, the way a program office does, and at the same time you go deep into the content - preparing and challenging the decisions yourself and then carrying them into the organization.
A potential new team - the Center of Excellence - may grow out of this work: as the future organization develops, you help prepare a dedicated team that could bundle cross-cutting topics across the different FP&A teams, including standardized data and reporting, shared tools and systems, automation, process improvement and AI. Subject to the future setup and related decisions, the role may offer a path toward taking on team leadership responsibility for this unit.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Support the carve-out of Transformation of Industry from an FP&A perspective, including organizational and process changes, standalone company requirements, and Day 1 FP&A readiness
* Help prepare the potential future FP&A organization together with its management team, including target structures, roles and responsibilities, job profiles, and related training and reskilling needs
* Support the Vice President of FP&A in the daily business by preparing presentations, analyses, and decision-making materials for leadership and board audiences
* Improve the core FP&A processes together with the management team across planning, forecasting, closing, and reporting by turning best practices into common standards
* Take care of communication into the teams by explaining the why, keeping everyone informed, gathering input early, and making people part of the change journey
* Help develop the concept for a potential Center of Excellence within the future FP&A organization, including scope, services, operating model, staffing, roadmap, and the opportunity to potentially grow into a team leadership role

What You Bring

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Business Informatics, or a related field
* Longstanding experience in Controlling, FP&A, Finance Transformation, or Consulting, with the curiosity to grow into a carve-out environment
* An interest in organizational design, including roles, responsibilities, and interfaces, with the confidence to contribute ideas to a management team
* A solid understanding of planning, forecasting, closing, and reporting, along with strong Excel and reporting tool skills and curiosity about AI and automation
* Excellent communication and change management skills, combined with the energy, structure, and drive to build something new in an evolving environment
* Fluent English; additional languages are an advantage

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
