jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Project Controller / Commercial Project Manager (f/m/d), you will be the financial lead for a portfolio of complex real estate construction projects within Siemens Energy. Acting as the trusted finance business partner to the Real Estate Project Management organization, you will oversee budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and investment approvals while ensuring full compliance with IFRS and local accounting standards. Working closely with colleagues from Accounting, Operations, Procurement, Legal, and Real Estate, you will provide transparent financial insights that support strategic decisions and drive successful project delivery.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead the commercial execution of a dedicated portfolio of real estate construction projects, including budgeting, forecasting, cost recognition, and financial reporting
* Prepare robust investment approvals by developing business cases, profitability analyses, and discounted cash flow models for strategic construction initiatives
* Establish accurate financial project structures in SAP, including Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), and ensure alignment with approved project budgets and schedules
* Ensure timely month-end closing, accurate project accounting, and full compliance with IFRS and Local GAAP throughout the project lifecycle
* Present clear financial performance reports, highlight cost deviations, and provide actionable recommendations to senior management and key stakeholders
* Partner with cross-functional teams across Finance, Real Estate, Operations, Procurement, and Legal to enable informed commercial decision-making and successful project execution

What You Bring

* A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or Economics; a master's degree or CPA qualification is an advantage
* Longstanding professional experience in Finance, Controlling, or Project Finance, ideally within construction, infrastructure, or capital investment projects
* Strong understanding of Financial Planning & Analysis/Business Case Models in preparation of investment approvals (e.g. proof of profitability & discounted cash flow calculation
* Proven experience managing CAPEX projects, annual budgets, forecasting, free cash flow, depreciation, and financial reporting for complex project portfolios
* Solid knowledge of IFRS and Local GAAP, with hands-on experience in PP&E (CAPEX) accounting and strong SAP expertise, ideally across PS, CO, and FI modules
* Business fluent English communication skills

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

Please submit your CV in English in order to be considered for the role.This role is available in Manchester, Amsterdam, and Berlin.This is a 12-month fixed-term contract with the possibility of extension.The Installer Support team serves as an escalation point for our network of channel partners who distribute, install and service residential Tesla energy products. We strive to empower our channel partners to provide the best end-customer experience possible, and we are an endpoint for determining next steps and solutions for many situations.Installer Support Engineering Technicians offer real-time diagnostics and solutions for trained on-site technicians during installation and maintenance of Tesla’s residential solar, storage and home charging energy products. Strong candidates for this role will already have knowledge in the residential energy industry. Applicants should expect to become a subject matter expert (SME) with Tesla’s energy products with the ability to remotely access and troubleshoot equipment.This is an exciting, fast-paced and rewarding role, and a fantastic opportunity to dig deep into our innovative products while collaborating with some of the most talented people in the world!

What You’ll Do

- Provide top-tier support for live on-site or off-site technical issues regarding residential energy products via phone, chat, email or other channels
- Follow best practices in case handling, follow-up, and documenting interactions and work performed with great detail
- Become highly knowledgeable in the technical operation and complexities of Tesla’s energy products
- Understand and troubleshoot proprietary power electronics systems and their supporting components
- Read and understand single-line diagrams as they pertain to PV and storage systems as well as load and meter component placement
- Review operational logs in proprietary and non-proprietary applications
- Identify trending issues, collect information and report findings to leadership and engineering teams
- Identify process and knowledge gaps and submit feedback that leads to better training and resources
- Become a subject matter expert (SME) in residential Tesla energy products.
- Utilise software including Linux environments, SSH, and more for advanced troubleshooting

What You’ll Bring

- Bachelor's degree in a technical or engineering field, or a minimum of 2+ years’ experience in a technician role
- Fluency in English and Spanish is required for this role 
- Ability to independently make decisions and solve problems with limited direction
- Outstanding written and verbal interpersonal communication skills
- Experience and understanding of customer service, technical support and engineering environments
- Ability to document interactions and steps clearly, accurately and with detail
- Ability to prioritize workflows effectively according to multiple criteria
- Understanding of electrical theory and experience with emphasis on AC/DC power systems or other electronic systems, devices and components
- Experience troubleshooting metering and communications issues involving many variables
- Understanding of commercial electrical metering, energy flow, power factor, and phase rotation
- Electrical engineering knowledge and/or experience is a plus

jobs.description:
What to Expect

As a Vehicle Technician with our Attributes team you will play a critical role in the development of Tesla’s industry-leading products. You will help bring the electric vehicle and energy storage products we design to life, and ensure their acoustic integrity. You will work side-by-side with fellow NVH and Vehicle Dynamics staff and other engineering teams to solve the toughest challenges in the industry and deliver world-class performance. Tesla is looking only for the best and most talented. Accelerate your career. Accelerate the world’s transition to sustainable energy and transport. Role is based in BTEC (Berlin - Germany). Occasional travel is required.

What You’ll Do

- Work independently or alongside other technicians to complete vehicle retrofits and adaptations for attributes performance evaluation 
- Perform and streamline component swaps (tires, springs, stabilizer bars, dampers, bushings, etc.) during NVH and Vehicle Dynamics tuning or evaluation sessions 
- Contribute to fabrication of prototype parts and/or vehicles for engineering development 
- Installation of data acquisition equipment to include sensors (i.e. accelerometers, microphones, gyros, thermocouples, strain gauges, load cells, pressure transducers, torque sensors, displacement sensors, CAN bus traffic, GPS, etc.) 
- Assess vehicle performance for NVH – squeak  and rattle, brake noise, drive unit noise, road and wind noise, HVAC noise. Record test data if required. 
- Maintain Attributes fleet vehicles in excellent condition 
- Maintain test equipment 
- What You’ll Bring
- 3+ years experience working in an automotive dealership, workshop or lab.  
- Strong communication skills, independent worker, and an excellent team player able to work on flexible schedule 
- Excellent knowledge of vehicle and vehicle subsystems operation; knowledge of electric vehicle architecture a strong plus 
- Ability to work independently or as part of a team as needs require, under pressure and adapt to changing priorities 
- Excellent attention to detail and hands on approach 
- Basic understanding of NVH and Vehicle Dynamics, vehicle instrumentation (Siemens and Head Acoustics desirable), CAN communication, and vehicle software 
- Must have a valid driver’s license 
- Language preferences: English and German

jobs.occupation: Experienced Insurance Manager (f/m/d) Liability / Financial Lines (Versicherungsprüfer/in)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

In close collaboration with your team, you will play a key role within the global insurance and risk management of Siemens Energy. Working closely with your team, brokers, and insurers, you will actively shape the placement of corporate liability and financial lines insurance programs in the international insurance market, provide advisory support to business units on complex contracts, and manage challenging claims. Your daily responsibilities will integrate legal and insurance expertise, strategic business thinking, negotiation skills, and the ability to effectively communicate complex issues.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Responsibility for the design, placement, implementation, and management of corporate liability and financial lines insurance programs, including the development of insurance terms and coverage concepts, considering the needs and risk profile of our business units
* Advising and placing liability project insurance
* Primary contact for insurance-related questions regarding contract structures and active participation in contract negotiations worldwide
* Supporting business units in reporting and processing insurance claims, as well as analysing and evaluating insurance solutions. Independently handling complex claims, with a particular focus on operational, product, and environmental liability claims, and managing claims processes abroad
* First point of contact for senior management-related questions regarding insurance coverage for the board and management in accordance with German corporate law

What You Bring

* Several years of relevant professional experience in a comparable position or relevant industry experience, particularly in the placement of international insurance programs, contract commentary, and claims handling in international project business
* Fluent in German (C1/C2) and English (C1), both written and spoken. Additional language skills, such as Spanish, are desirable
* Analytical skills and a confident approach to complex issues, connecting legal, technical, and economic aspects into clear recommendations
* Confident in negotiations, high level of personal responsibility, structured working style, and enjoyment of proactive topic advancement
* Proficient in all common MS Office applications and generative AI, with an affinity for implementing digital processes

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

What to Expect

Tesla is accelerating the world's transition to sustainable energy. We continuously develop revolutionary strategies and products within shortest time, and successfully launch them on a large scale. This is only possible through extraordinary speed, innovation, and efficiency. Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg forms the perfect basis for rolling out Tesla's incredible success story in Europe. The most important pillar for this is our employees. Their passion, motivation and engagement ensure that we consistently achieve our goals. We are looking for you to continue and expand this success story together. We are looking to hire a talented Senior Legal Counsel, Supply Chain, to join our legal team to support the Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg. In this role, you will support the purchasing manufacturing and engineering teams with supply chain matters in connection with the vehice production parts of the  manufactuting facility. The focus for this role is to be the trusted advisor for manufacturing, engineering, and procurement teams at the factory. You will be part of a global legal team that supports facilities and special projects throughout the world. 

What You’ll Do

- Support commercial and procurement teams on a variety of transactions and negotiations, including drafting and reviewing contracts in connection with sourcing for production parts (i.e., logistics, real estate, utility agreements and NDA’s). 
- Manage the enforcement of respective contracts (i.e., warranty claims, default notices, general claim management as well as dispute resolution)
- Provide strategic legal advice to manufacturing, engineering, and purchasing leads in supply chain insolvency matters
- Liaise with global Legal and Supply Chain teams to ensure global consistency
- Make an impact on organization and structures
- Report about and montior market developments in vehicle production parts supply chain matters 

What You’ll Bring

- At least 5 years’ relevant experience at a law firm and/or in-house corporate international environment, ideally with a commercial legal background, with an exceptional ability to handle a high workload of complex legal matters at the same time
- Team player with the ability to proactively identify problems, drive projects, and execute pragmatic/creative legal and business solutions on a timely basis
- Inspire trust, forge relationships quickly with key stakeholders at all levels, and earn the confidence and cooperation of your business partners
- Work well both autonomously, collaboratively and transparently, and are effective at juggling and prioritising competing tasks in a fast-paced, challenging environment
- Possess an entrepreneurial mindset, quick and flexible learner with high standards, impeccable integrity and ethics, unquestionable good judgment, and well-honed analytical skills
- Excellent communication skills, with a business level to near-native level fluency in German and English (written and spoken)
- Good sense of humour, disdain for drama, and a desire to get things doneWhat we offer You will be working in our state-of-the-art Gigafactory, where you’ll solve the world's most interesting problems with the best and brightest people who share a passion to change the world. jobs.occupation: Supply Chain Manager, Indirect Procurement – Engineering Services, Supplies & Equipment (EMEA) (Automobil-Fachwirt/in)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

The Tesla EMEA Indirect Procurement team is looking for a highly motivated Supply Chain Manager to support procurement for Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment across the broader EMEA region. You will partner closely with Engineering, Facilities, Finance, and operations stakeholders to source and manage complex service, supplies and equipment spend — from engineering consultancies, test and lab services, and specialized technical support through to engineering equipment, tooling, and infrastructure investments. This role requires a hands-on buyer who can drive end-to-end sourcing, negotiate commercial terms, ensure compliant purchase-to-pay execution, and keep critical engineering and capital programs on schedule and on budget.

What You’ll Do

- Serve as the primary Indirect Procurement partner for Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment demand across EMEA, translating business requirements into clear scopes of work, sourcing strategies, and executable purchase packages.
- Lead end-to-end sourcing for engineering services (e.g., design/engineering support, testing, prototyping services, technical consultancy, and specialized lab/operations support) and engineering supplies (e.g., lab consumables, non-production hardware, development materials) and equipment categories (tooling, fixtures, facility and infrastructure investments).
- Own RFx processes (RFI/RFP/RFQ): develop bid packages, run competitive tenders, evaluate commercial and technical proposals, and present award recommendations that balance cost, lead time, quality, risk, and supplier capability.
- Dive deep into supplier quotes and statements of work to challenge scope, pricing structures, rates, milestones, and total cost of ownership; negotiate best cost, payment terms, warranties, SLAs, and commercial protections.
- Ensure supply activation and on-time delivery for engineering development activities and capital projects, proactively managing bottlenecks, change orders, and expedites.
- Partner with Engineering, Facilities, Finance/FP&A, Legal, and Compliance to align budgets, approval thresholds, contract terms, and capital equipment spend governance requirements.
- Manage the full purchase-to-pay lifecycle for assigned categories: requisition triage, PO creation/release, goods receipt / service confirmation support, invoice issue resolution, and spend compliance.
- Build and maintain a capable regional supplier base for Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment across EMEA; drive preferred-supplier strategies, framework agreements, and multi-site leverage where beneficial.
- Track category spend, savings, cost avoidance, and risk; report status, escalations, and opportunities to Supply Chain leadership and key stakeholders.
- Work collaboratively at a cross-functional level with Engineering, Quality, Logistics, Supplier Industrialization, Legal, Finance, and other Supply Chain teams to deliver seamless operational support.
- Uphold Tesla procurement policies, ethical standards, and audit readiness across all sourcing and contracting activities.

What You’ll Bring

- You live and breathe procurement. You take ownership of assigned buying demand and ensure Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment needs stay in control from intake through delivery and payment.
- You possess a higher vocational or university qualification in a subject such as automotive engineering, mechanical engineering or business management, or equivalent experience
- Specific diploma’s Supply Chain/Purchasing are preferred
- Proven 5+ years of experience in Indirect Procurement, with hands-on ownership of Engineering Services and/or engineering equipment categories (equipment, tooling, technical services, project-related spend).
- Experience supporting manufacturing, automotive, industrial, or high-tech engineering environments is preferred; familiarity with plant/lab operations at a gigafactory or similar large industrial site is a plus.
- Strong commercial acumen: able to interpret complex SOWs, rate cards, and multi-year service proposals and negotiate cost, terms, and risk allocation.
- Comfortable operating across multiple sites and stakeholders across Tesla operations specifically in the wider EMEA region; experience with cross-border sourcing and multi-currency contracting is advantageous.
- Working knowledge of P2P / ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, or equivalent) and standard procurement governance (DOA, capital expenditure approval flows, contract lifecycle).
- Analytical, structured, and hands-on — equally effective running a strategic tender and resolving day-to-day PO, delivery, or invoice issues.
- Exceptional stakeholder management, communication and negotiation skills; ability to lead high-stakes contract discussions, challenge constructively and drive decisions at pace.
- You are fluent in English; German language skills are a strong plus.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Team Lead for Function Controlling (f/m/d) within the SE FIN GS BC SO organisation, you will be at the forefront of acting as business partner for SE GS Solution Functions. Your role will involve driving financial performance and supporting strategic decision-making across the Solution organization of SE GS. Your primary focus will be on optimizing cost controlling processes by implementing AI and Dash solutions, ensuring effective budget planning, and providing insightful analysis of forecasts and actuals. You will lead a global team, coaching and developing team members to achieve their full potential.
Each day, your leadership will strengthen financial performance and enhance accountability across all functions of Solution business.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead the financial performance management of cost centres by preparing, consolidating, and analysing forecasts, budgets, and monthly closings
* Act as a business partner by conducting reasonable analyses of key financial drivers for cost centres, delivering clear financial reports that include deviation analyses and actionable performance insights
* Implement and oversee standardized processes and automation initiatives, leverage AI where applicable to streamline operations.
* Develop and implement dashboards that provide real-time insights into cost centre performance and manpower utilization
* Collaborate with various functions to address complex setup topics, accounting questions, and reporting issues, ensuring reliable financial steering and alignment with organizational goals

What You Bring

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field
* Extensive experience in financial controlling, FP&A, budgeting, and corporate finance within a complex business environment
* Proven leadership capabilities in developing and managing teams of experienced finance professionals
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive business decisions
* Excellent knowledge of SAP applications, financial reporting, internal controls, and process improvement within a global matrix organization
* Fluent English communication skills; German is beneficial for collaboration within the local business environment 

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

* Develop and maintain integrated cutover plans covering data migration, system validation, go-live activities, legacy system integration, and decommissioning

* Identify cutover risks early, develop contingency and fallback strategies, and lead issue resolution to minimize business disruption during critical go-live periods

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits

The S4 program at Siemens Energy, formally called S4E or S4E‑Unify, is one of the major global Business- & IT Transformation Programs within Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Goal is to significantly reduce complexity, increase speed and flexibility, foster cross-organizational collaboration and finally drive significant cost reductions. The S4E-Unify core team consists of roughly 300 colleagues around the globe plus a substantial extended community of subject matter experts (SME), change network ambassadors and other contributors. It affects 40,000 global users and follows an implementation roadmap through 2030.  The S4E program is delivered through phased “Unify” rollout waves, bringing sites and business areas live step by step on SAP S/4HANA. It includes standardized business templates, a defined operating model with strong governance and board‑level sponsorship, and an enhanced user experience that modernizes how employees work.

jobs.employer_name: Technische Universität München (TUM), TUM Center for QuantumEngineering (ZQE)
jobs.description:
The research group for the Topology of Correlated Systems at the TUM Center for Quantum Engineering (ZQE) and the Department of Physics is looking for a postdoctoral researcher (f/m/d) to join the BMFTR-funded collaborative project “GarliQ - Green Advanced Refrigerants: Light-element oxides & intermetallics for Quantum cooling” at the earliest possible date. The position is initially limited to 3 years, full-time.

GarliQ is a collaborative project between TUM and kiutra GmbH, funded under the BMFTR call “Enabling Technologies for Resilient R&D Supply Chains in Quantum Technologies”. The project aims to develop new materials with magnetocaloric properties for use as cooling media in adiabatic demagnetization refrigeration (ADR) systems in the millikelvin temperature range - key components of the cryogenic infrastructure for quantum technologies.

Independent synthesis of magnetocaloric material systems (oxide and intermetallic compounds) via solid-state synthesis and melt crystal growth
Structural characterization of the synthesized materials, including by X-ray diffraction
Investigation of magnetic and thermodynamic low-temperature properties using standard and dilution refrigerator cryostats; as applicable, experiments at neutron and synchrotron sources
Determination of magnetocaloric parameters (isothermal entropy change, adiabatic temperature change)
Scale-up of promising synthesis routes for integration into ADR cooling systems, in close coordination with the industrial project partner kiutra GmbH
Supervision of PhD students, master's students, and student assistants within the project
Writing scientific publications for peer-reviewed journals
Presentation of results at national and international conferences

Completed doctorate in physics, materials science, chemistry, or a related field
Solid experience in the synthesis of inorganic solids
Knowledge of structural characterization (powder X-ray diffraction, Laue diffraction, microscopy, …)
Experience with magnetic and thermodynamic measurements (magnetometry, susceptibility, heat capacity, …) at low and ultra-low temperatures
Experience operating crystal growth facilities and/or cryostats
Demonstrated publication record in solid-state physics or materials science
Independent, structured way of working and enjoyment of interdisciplinary teamwork
Excellent written and spoken English; knowledge of German is an advantage
Experience supervising students is an advantage
We offer the opportunity to contribute to an internationally visible research topic at the interface of solid-state physics and quantum technologies - in an excellently equipped low-temperature laboratory at the TUM Department of Physics and in close collaboration with an innovative industry partner.
TUM offers a working environment with flexible working hours, flat hierarchies, and open communication, as well as a comprehensive, free range of professional and personal development opportunities.
Remuneration is based on qualifications according to TV-L. TUM aims to increase the proportion of women in its workforce; applications from women are therefore explicitly encouraged.

* Facilitate cross-functional workshops and best practice exchanges between manufacturing sites to support operational excellence

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits

About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Earth Observation & Science projects within Space Systems, Airbus Defence and Space in Ottobrunn is looking for an

Optical Architect (d/f/m)

You will join a multicultural team of engineers specialized in the development of optical (sub-)systems working for Earth Observation & Science projects within Space Systems. These developments cover instruments for ESA, CNES, DLR and EU programmes across the spectral range from ultraviolet to thermal infrared. Examples include LIDARs (ATLID, MERLIN), Multi-Spectral Instruments (Sentinel-2 MSI, Sentinel-4, Sentinel-5) from the Copernicus programme, infrared instruments (LSTM, TRISHNA), meteorological instruments (IASI-NG and METimage) embarked on MetOp-SG, instruments for scientific missions like EUCLID, cameras embarked on LEO and GEO satellites, and national programmes.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria.

Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Transformation and Change Management (f/m/d) Specialist, you will work at the intersection of business transformation, AI deployment, and organizational change. On any given day, you may align with business leaders on upcoming AI rollouts, develop strategies to increase adoption of new digital solutions, coach stakeholders through change, and collaborate with Industrialized Rollout teams to ensure transformation activities are seamlessly integrated into deployment plans. You will monitor adoption trends, identify risks and barriers, and translate insights into actionable recommendations that accelerate business value realization. A key part of your role will be establishing scalable change management standards, tools, and governance approaches that enable consistent execution across multiple transformation initiatives. Ultimately, you will help ensure that AI-driven change is not only deployed successfully, but embraced, embedded, and sustained across Procurement.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Leadership of the people and organizational aspects of AI-enabled transformation initiatives, ensuring sustainable adoption of new ways of working
* Development and execution of change strategies to drive business readiness, stakeholder alignment, and behavioral change
* Establishment and continuous improvement of a standardized change management framework, including tools, governance, and success measures
* Integration of change management activities into deployment plans in collaboration with rollout leads, business leaders, and AI product teams
* Definition and monitoring of adoption metrics, business readiness, user adoption, risks, and value realization across rollout waves
* Identification of adoption barriers, consolidation of lessons learned, and implementation of continuous improvement measures to maximize transformation outcomes

What You Bring

* Master’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Organizational Development, or a similar field
* Extensive experience in Change Management, Business Transformation, Organizational Development, or Digital Transformation, including IT tool implementations such as SAP Ariba or Workday
* Proven track record in leading large-scale transformation programs across functions, regions, and business units, including organizational and cultural transformation
* Demonstrated experience in driving adoption of new technologies, digital solutions, and automation initiatives, including the development of training and communication materials
* Strong expertise in senior stakeholder management, organizational change, operating model transformation, and business process improvement, ideally within a consulting environment
* Fluent in German and English (C2 level)

About the Team

You will join an Organization and Workforce Transformation team within Procurement that combines strategy and execution. We design future‑oriented concepts, but we also take responsibility for making them work in practice. Collaboration, trust, and a strong sense of ownership define how we work together. If you enjoy building something meaningful with real impact, you will feel at home here.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

About Us

What if your work could drive change in a globally established industry, shaping processes that touch every corner of the world? At Forto, we are at the forefront of change, harnessing the power of AI to revolutionise logistics. We want to reinvent digital supply chains to be transparent, frictionless and sustainable. From day one, our mission has been to simplify global trade – creating a seamless and efficient logistics process.

Your Role & Mission

The mission of the Flash team at Forto is to fundamentally redesign operations processes by leveraging automation and intelligent decision-making to handle shipments more efficiently. We aim to scale CoPilot so that it becomes the primary system used by operations managers, enabling them to be more effective and efficient in their daily work.

As a Senior Software Engineer in the Flash team, you will help build AI-driven solutions and the CoPilot that powers our logistics operations. You will maintain and evolve a sophisticated event-driven, distributed architecture designed to answer one key question:

How do we improve shipment handling and bring efficiency to our operations teams at scale?

From quotation and rate management, to shipment execution and schedule optimization (capacity utilization and GP optimization), to carrier integrations and automated data extraction from unstructured sources (emails, PDFs, spreadsheets), this role focuses on building reliable, data-heavy systems that directly impact revenue and operational performance.

What you will do

- Design, build, and evolve scalable and resilient backend systems
- Contribute to an event-driven, distributed architecture
- Work on AI-adjacent systems (integration, orchestration, data-heavy workflows)
- Own services end-to-end (design, implementation, documentation, operation)
- Collaborate closely with product managers, operations, and other engineers
- Communicate clearly with stakeholders and explain technical trade-offs
- Contribute to technical standards and best practices within the team
- Foster a culture of excellence by coaching team members in best practices for backend engineering, domain-driven design, and navigating the complexities of the logistics domain.

Required Skills and Experience

- Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and complexity analysis, particularly as they apply to large-scale data processing and financial calculations.
- Proven professional software craftsmanship, with a focus on building high-quality, maintainable, and testable code (an understanding of TDD is a plus).
- Expertise in designing and implementing large-scale, event-driven microservices architectures and robust APIs, with a keen understanding of data consistency in distributed systems.
- Deep understanding of synchronous vs. asynchronous communication patterns and their impact on system performance and reliability
- Hands-on experience developing distributed backend applications, with a strong focus on data consistency, system quality, low latency, and high availability.
- Proficiency in microservices, with hands-on experience in backend technologies such as Node.js, TypeScript, and MongoDB.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and container orchestration for deploying and managing scalable pricing services.
- Experience with cloud providers (AWS or GCP preferred) for deploying and managing highly available and scalable applications.
- A collaborative, team-oriented mindset with strong critical product thinking and a sense of ownership over the accuracy and effectiveness of pricing data.
- Fluent in English, both verbal and written, for effective communication within a global team.

Preferred Skills and Experience

- Experience integrating AI/LLM-powered features into user faced applications
- Experience applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) in complex product domains

Don’t fit all of our criteria? That’s okay! We know that you might be hesitant to apply if you don’t meet all our requirements, but here at Forto, we pride ourselves on embracing diverse perspectives and celebrating potential. If you are passionate about this position and the Forto values, please apply anyway. There could be a place for you in this role – or another one that’s a perfect fit! 

Why work with us?

Our team is hard-working, constantly seeking to maximise the impact of their work, but we put our people first, always winning with care. We value efficient systems and swift, direct communication. We want everyone to have their time to speak, so that we can embrace diverse perspectives to help drive towards solutions always.

jobs.employer_name: Max-Planck-Gesellschaft zur Förderung der Wissenschaft e.V Max-Planck-Institut für Physik
jobs.description:
Scientist – Quantum Sensors & Qubit Technology (m/f/d)

The Semiconductor Laboratory (HLL) of the Max Planck Society, located on the research campus in Garching near Munich, is a leading facility for the development of highly precise radiation sensors and detector systems. On approximately 1,400 m² of cleanroom space, HLL develops, fabricates and tests advanced semiconductor detectors for applications in X-ray astronomy, particle physics and materials research. With around 50 employees from different nationalities, HLL provides a highly international and interdisciplinary environment in which scientists, engineers and technology specialists work closely together across the entire development chain — from fundamental research and simulation to device design, fabrication and experimental characterization.

To strengthen our activities in quantum sensing and advanced quantum-device technologies, and to provide scientific and technological support to our research, engineering and service teams, we are looking for a Scientist – Quantum Sensors & Qubit Technology (m/f/d) to join our team at the earliest possible date on a full-time basis (39 hours/week). 

Your responsibilities

- Develop and optimize quantum sensor concepts based on qubit systems and quantum effects.
- Perform advanced numerical simulations and modeling of qubit-based sensing systems, including relevant physical processes, noise sources and system-level performance.
- Work closely with technology development, engineering and experimental teams to translate simulation results into practical implementations.
- Analyze experimental data and use the results to refine physical models and sensor designs.
- Contribute to scientific publications, technical documentation and intellectual property.

Your profile

- PhD in physics, electrical engineering, applied physics, quantum engineering or a related field.
- Background in quantum sensing, qubit control and precision measurement.
- Experience with numerical simulation, modeling and system design.
- Analytical and problem-solving skills combined with a practical, technology-oriented mindset.
- Strong motivation to work in close cooperation with technology, engineering and experimental teams.
- Fluency in English; knowledge of German is an advantage.

Advantageous experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be particularly valuable:

- Cleanroom / semiconductor / microfabrication experience
- Familiarity with Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or equivalent 
- MEMS/NEMS or integrated sensor technologies
- Precision measurement and low-noise instrumentation
- Experience bridging qubit physics, device design and fabrication technology

What we offer

- International environment, diverse responsibilities and a high degree of autonomy: Flat hierarchies and a collaborative, agile team within an internationally renowned research institution. You will work closely with scientists, engineers and technology specialists across disciplines and have the opportunity to shape the development of innovative quantum-sensing technologies.
- Advantages of the public sector: Remuneration according to the German public service pay scale TVöD (Bund), depending on qualifications and experience; occupational pension scheme (VBL); 30 days of annual leave (31 days as of 2027), plus additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve. The position is initially limited to two years, with the possibility of subsequent permanent employment.
- Work-life balance and compatibility of family and career: Flexible working hours (flextime), opportunities for mobile working, support in finding childcare and care for family members, and a comprehensive company health management program.
- Professional development: Thorough onboarding and opportunities for internal and external training and further education tailored to your individual needs. You will have the opportunity to continuously develop your expertise in quantum sensing, qubit technology, simulation and semiconductor technology.
- Research campus: Excellent access by public transport, including the possibility of a monthly subsidy for the “Deutschland-Job-Ticket”, or by car with free parking in the immediate vicinity of the laboratory. A canteen and further dining options are available nearby, as well as campus-wide events and activities.

The Max Planck Society strives for gender equality and diversity. The Max Planck Society is committed to increasing the number of individuals with disabilities in its workforce and therefore encourages applications from such qualified individuals. Furthermore, the Max Planck Society seeks to increase the number of women in those areas where they are underrepresented and therefore explicitly encourages women to apply.

Further information and application

Detailed information about the Semiconductor Laboratory (HLL) can be found at HLL – Semiconductor Laboratory (http://www.hll.mpg.de/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) .

For further information about the position, please contact Dr. Jelena Ninkovic, Tel.: +49 89 839400-49.

Please submit your application, including meaningful application documents, exclusively online via our application portal (https://bewerbermanagement.net/en/jobposting/6c80f90f47c14e1b28b7c86e27f035140c44c8f20/apply) by 31 October 2026. Include the names of three referees that can be contacted in your CV.

We look forward to receiving your application! 

Semiconductor Laboratory of the Max Planck Society 

Administered by:

Max Planck Institute for Physics

(Werner Heisenberg Institute) 

Human Resources Department

Boltzmannstraße 8

85748 Garching

Germany

jobs.description:
The LIT - Leibniz Institute for Immunotherapy (foundation under civil law) (https://lit.eu/) – is a biomedical research center focusing on translational immunology in the fields of cancer immunotherapy, transplant rejection and autoimmunity. The objective of the LIT is to develop innovative and efficient cellular immune therapeutics in these areas. Our own GMP laboratories and close networking with University and University Hospital offer excellent opportunities for clinical translation of novel immune cell products.

The Flow Cytometry Core Facility is recruiting a highly motivated

BTA, MTA oder CTA (m/f/d) – CG-2026-2

(full time, 40.1 hours per week)

The position is initially limited to two years with the possibility of extension.

The Flow Cytometric Cell Analytics and Cell Sorting Core Facility at the LIT offers research groups from the LIT, the University Hospital of Regensburg (UKR), and the University of Regensburg (UR) the opportunity to identify and characterize individual cell populations and to isolate them in a targeted manner, thus making them accessible for further downstream analysis. In addition, the facility offers advice and support for beginners and advanced users on flow cytometry-related questions and problems, such as the selection of appropriate fluorochromes, the creation of staining panels and the optimization of gating strategies.

We are now looking for a highly motivated technical assistant with excitement for flow cytometry, sophisticated instruments, organizational/administrative skills and a stong service mentality who is excited to enrich our facility. The facility hosts state-of-the art sorters and analyzers. The community of users is highly international and covers a range of scientific topics within and associated with Immunology.

Your tasks include, but are not limited to:

- Daily operation of the sorting machines
- Monitor and maintain the equipment in the facility, including arriving spectral cytometers. This includes quality control and cleaning of equipment.
- Reagent and consumables management, including planning, tracking and ordering of reagents and preparation of solutions and reagents
- Documentation, SOP and data management, including tracking and recording of instrument usage per user, creating and updating protocols for instruments, data backup and transfer to sorter users
- User support, including assisting users with scheduling of experiments, training experienced users for independent equipment usage of sorting machines and their software, expert advice to users
- Support for research initiatives of the facility, e.g. assisting flow cytometry-related research projects, assay development, promote the facility’s scientific work
- Management of facility waste, including autoclaving and coordination of waste disposal
- Ensure smooth operation of the facility

The ideal candidate possesses:

- Completed education as BTA, MTA or CTA
- Experience in handling of live cells, advanced equipment, flow cytometry
- High affinity for and ideally experience with work with sophisticated equipment, incuding equipment maintenance and trouble-shooting
- Experience in providing training
- Self-motivated person with an intrinsic service mentality, a collaborative attitude and the drive to advance the research within the institute
- Reliable and precise work style, high degree of independence
- Good organizational and administrative skills
- Good inter-personal skills, good communication skills in English and German
- Interest, and ideally also experience in working in an interdisciplinary and international environment

We offer:

- An international cutting-edge research environment that offers exciting and diverse opportunities
- Flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes
- A highly motivated and cooperative team
- Flexible working hours
- Job ticket and excellent benefits
- Excellent funding situation and state-of-the-art equipment

The remuneration is based on TV-L.

The Leibniz Institute for Immunotherapy aims to increase the share of women in the workforce. Therefore, qualified female candidates are explicitly encouraged to submit their applications. Moreover, the LIT advocates for the compatibility of family and career.

Disabled applicants (m/f/d) with equal qualifications will receive preferential treatment within the recruitment procedure. Please refer to your disability status already in your application.

Please note that expenses that may arise in the context of an eventual job interview cannot be reimbursed.

For more information, please contact Prof. Dr. Carmen Gerlach (carmen.gerlach@lit.eu). We are looking forward to receiving your detailed application in German or English. Please apply via our Online - Application Portal (https://rci.hr4you.org/job/view/113/bta-mta-oder-cta-m-f-d-cg-2026-2?page_lang=en) the reference CG- 2026-2.

We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!

Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.

This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.

Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly’s operational and analytical systems.

This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.

What you will do

- Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.
- Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.
- Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.
- Build tooling that gives product engineers fast feedback before they publish or change data products.
- Help define how Smartly models data products, publishing contracts, schema evolution, field stability, deletion semantics, access policy, lineage, and cost attribution.
- Operate and improve the CDC runtime model, including Kubernetes workloads, source-specific isolation, offsets, schema history, heartbeats, signal channels, lag visibility, replay, resnapshotting, and recovery.
- Integrate platform metadata into DataHub so engineers can discover data products, understand ownership, trace lineage, and reason about the impact of changes.
- Work with product, infrastructure, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML teams to make the standard path easier and safer than bespoke point-to-point integrations.

What we are looking for

- Strong experience building and operating production software systems, preferably in platform, infrastructure, backend, or data-intensive environments.
- Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: reliability, idempotency, replay, eventual consistency, ownership boundaries, compatibility, and operational failure modes.
- Practical experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases, including schema design, migrations, transactions, replication, or operational performance.
- Experience with Kafka, event streaming, CDC, Debezium, or adjacent data-movement technologies. Direct Debezium experience is valuable, but strong fundamentals matter more.
- Experience building software that other engineers use: CLIs, internal platforms, control planes, automation, CI validation, developer tooling, or self-service workflows.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud or infrastructure platforms, including runtime isolation, deployment, observability, and operational ownership.
- Ability to turn ambiguous architectural direction into practical increments, make trade-offs explicit, and deliver useful production systems without waiting for perfect certainty.
- Clear written and spoken communication in English. This role involves aligning multiple engineering teams around standards, contracts, and ownership boundaries.

Useful experience, but not required

- DataHub or other data catalog, lineage, or governance systems.
- Open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, object-store-backed data lakes, S3, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or analytical storage systems.
- GitHub Actions, policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, controllers, operators, or reconciliation-based systems.
- Data contracts, schema registries, Protobuf, Avro, JSON Schema, compatibility checking, field-level metadata, or contract testing.
- Experience supporting analytics, AI/ML, feature-store-style access patterns, or cross-domain product-service integrations.
- Experience with JVM languages and Python, TypeScript, Go, or Ruby.

What we offer you

At Smartly, we offer a place where you can do meaningful technical work while growing with a global team.

- Inclusive global culture built on trust, transparency, open feedback, and respect for different perspectives.
- Global impact through technology used by major brands to plan, create, optimize, and understand digital advertising at scale.
- Wellbeing support, paid holidays, family leave, and sustainable ways of working.
- Equity options, performance-based rewards, competitive compensation, and career development opportunities.
- A flexible hybrid workplace that balances office collaboration with focused remote work. At Smartly we work 3 days a week from the office.

About Smartly

Smartly is an advertising technology company helping brands create, manage, optimize, and understand digital advertising across major media platforms. Our engineering organization builds the systems that connect media, creative, and intelligence capabilities into a product used by customers globally.

We value clear communication, ownership, curiosity, and collaboration across teams. We want Smartly to be a place where people can do strong work, grow, and feel respected.

Not sure you tick every box? Please apply anyway. We care about strong engineering fundamentals, ownership, curiosity, and the ability to build reliable systems with others. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers.

Our end-to-end technology, unmatched access to media platforms and exceptional customer service help Fortune 500 brands to reach and engage consumers and learn what performs best.Smartly is a multinational and diverse team of 750+ Smartlies from 60+ nationalities, working in 13 countries. Together, we want to create and maintain an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and heard. Our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach is at the heart of it.

jobs.occupation: vEFK - Verantwortliche Elektrofachkraft / Qualified Electrician (m/f/d) (Elektrofachkraft für festgelegte Tätigkeiten)
jobs.description:
TYTAN Technologies

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.

We are seeking an experienced **vEFK (Electrical Safety Manager)** to take on formal electrical safety responsibility for our drone production facility, in accordance with DGUV Vorschrift 3 and DIN VDE 0105-100. As vEFK, you will be the designated person accountable for the safe operation, maintenance, and modification of all electrical systems and equipment across production lines, test benches, and facility infrastructure.

Your Road Map To Make an Impact

- Assume formal responsibility (per §13 DGUV V3 / VDE 0105) for electrical safety across the production facility, including assembly lines, battery test/charging stations, RF and avionics test benches, and building electrical systems
- Issue, review, and sign off on electrical work permits and switching authorizations
- Conduct and document risk assessments for electrical work (live working, lockout/tagout, isolation procedures)
- Supervise and coordinate Elektrofachkräfte (EFK) and elektrotechnisch unterwiesene Personen (EuP) on site
- Oversee inspection and testing of electrical equipment, machinery, and battery/charging infrastructure (per DGUV V3, VDE 0701-0702, and applicable Li-ion battery handling standards)
- Manage compliance with low-voltage directive, EMC requirements, and relevant drone/UAV manufacturing electrical safety standards
- Investigate electrical incidents, near-misses, and non-conformances; drive corrective actions
- Maintain documentation: circuit diagrams, inspection logs, training records, and safety instructions (Betriebsanweisungen)
- Liaise with quality, EHS, and engineering teams on electrical aspects of new production line rollouts and equipment procurement
- Train and qualify personnel on electrical safety procedures specific to drone assembly (e.g., high-density battery packs, motor/ESC testing, RF equipment)

Job requirements

- Completed vocational/technical training as Elektroniker, Elektroinstallateur, or equivalent, plus further qualification enabling appointment as vEFK (e.g., Meister, Techniker, or Ingenieur in Elektrotechnik)
- Formal written appointment eligibility as vEFK per employer's organizational delegation (Unternehmerpflichtenübertragung)
- Several years of hands-on experience in industrial electrical systems, ideally in manufacturing/production environments
- Sound knowledge of DGUV Vorschrift 3, VDE 0100/0105, VDE 0701-0702, and low-voltage directive requirements
- Experience with battery systems (Li-Po/Li-ion) and their associated electrical hazards is highly desirable given the UAV/drone context
- Strong documentation discipline and ability to train/supervise other electrical personnel
- Fluent German (technical/regulatory) and good working English (for international engineering teams)

Preferred / Nice to Have

- Experience in aerospace, UAV, or electronics/precision manufacturing
- Familiarity with ESD-sensitive component handling
- Knowledge of RF/EMC testing environments
- Experience with automated or semi-automated production line electrical systems

Why TYTAN?

- Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security
- Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale
- Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors
- Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback
- Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact
- Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company
- Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

- Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through Virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation
- Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit
- Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us
- Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team
- Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together
- Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands
- Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

- You create reliable evaluation datasets and metrics and validate improvements through offline evaluations, user signals and A/B tests

- You research promising approaches in information retrieval, recommender systems and Large Language Models and translate them into measurable customer impact

jobs.occupation: Senior Cost Estimator, EMEA Infrastructure Development - (m/w/d) (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

The EMEA Infrastructure Development team is seeking a Senior Cost Estimator to serve as the subject matter expert in construction cost estimating across Tesla's EMEA portfolio, including Service Centers, Retail Stores, Delivery Hubs, and Non-SSD sites (R&D, Training, Offices, etc.) You will drive the transition from decentralized regional estimating to a centralized EMEA-wide approach — defining the methodology, standards, templates, and governance for how projects are evaluated. You will deliver independent, reliable construction cost estimates at every project stage, giving project teams, designers, procurement, and leadership a trusted reference for go/no-go decisions.

What You’ll Do

- Develop cost estimates from Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) through detailed CapEx budgets, with accuracy appropriate to each project stage (AACE estimate classes as reference framework)
- Produce high-level estimates based on historic data to support go/no-go decisions against key cost metrics
- Analyze plans, Due diligence reports and interpret designs; perform dimensional quantity take-offs; identify scope implied but not explicitly shown in design documents
- Develop and manage a Basis of Estimate for each project — scope, execution strategy, precision level, assumptions, exclusions, risks, and critical information
- Lead value engineering at early design stages, providing cost-driven feedback and recommendations to designers
- Visit project sites as required to validate scope, site conditions, and constraints in support of estimation — working from assumptions and scope definition provided by the Project Manager, Real Estate team and design team
- Support the Procurement and PMs with contractor pricing validation and bid leveling to ensure we are receiving good value for spends
- Contribute to continuous improvement of estimating processes
- Maintain and update the cost database, ensuring pricing reflects current market conditions, inflation, transport costs, and regional differentiation
- Deliver accurate, independently validated estimates to support ATP and go/no-go decisions; review outputs against historic pricing and regional benchmarks
- Provide expert input to Procurement on sourcing and pricing for atypical works or high cost-variance items

What You’ll Bring

- Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, or related field — or equivalent professional experience
- 5+ years as a senior specialist or SME in project cost estimating, preferably in retail, commercial, industrial, or multi-site infrastructure rollout environments
- Practical knowledge of construction means and methods across civil, structural, architectural, MEP disciplines with the ability to translate technical knowledge into accurate, defensible cost advice
- Solid understanding of CapEx cost estimating from ROM through detailed CapEx budgeting; proven experience with quantity take-offs and design document interpretation
- Experience maintaining or developing pricing databases or cost libraries at a portfolio or multi-country level
- Ability of identifying main risks especially during ROM which could significantly impact the costs in a later stage
- Analytical, detail-oriented, and self-motivated; proactive communicator in a fast-paced, multicultural environment
- Experience building, leading, or transitioning to a centralized estimating function — methodology, SOPs, and standardization frameworks
- Proven track record as the go-to cost expert for project teams, designers, and leadership; authoritative cost advice with confidence, independence, and sound professional judgement
- Availability to travel across EMEA as required (up to 50%)
- English required; additional European language skills a strong plus
