- Optimize design for the overall RPAS and ensure integration of all level 1 sub-products.
- Perform trades & candidate aircraft configurations associated to RPA and flight chain architectures & requirements.
- Coordinate the flight chain design (GSCCS, FMCS, FMAIS, SFLS), ensuring consistent safety-critical design.
- Ensure RPA compliance with airworthiness and safety, environmental conditions, design maturity, security and RPAS airport operations at the aircraft level.
- Control the RPA and flight chain technical baseline and design changes, Assessing the consequences of technical Change Requests on overall RPAS architecture and aircraft configuration, ensuring configuration maturity aligns with programme milestones and safety objectives.
- Lead the definition of the certification and qualification roadmap for in close alignment with customer and regulatory bodies.
- Integrate and coordinate Flight Physics activities (performance, HQ, loads) and drive flight chain consistent solutions into the overall configuration.
- Achieving the handling quality requirements for the RPAS failure free and for failure cases.
- Secure the project schedule to achieve the program milestones, align technical directives to all design teams, ensuring end to end readiness.
- Ensure integration and verification plans and activities to achieve final certification and qualification; from analysis and simulation through systems testing and completed at Flight Test Level.

If you are ready to take on this exciting challenge and make a significant impact on the future of Airbus UAV products, we encourage you to apply.

- Master of Science in Aerospace Engineering or equivalent.
- Significant Engineering experience > 8 years in related area.
- You have excellent leadership skills and profound experience in leading teams.
- Deep knowledge of Flight Dynamics, Flight Mechanics and Flight Control Laws.
- Extensive experience in the development of Flight Control Systems.
- Experience in the development of DAL-A software.
- Knowledge in Overall Aircraft Design, Overall System Design and Overall Physical Design.
- Operational knowledge on UAS or aircraft Operation, in particular Automatic Take Off and Landing.
- Proven track record in project management and technical management.
- Excellent coordination and communication skills.
- Goal-oriented mind set and good analytical skills.
- Very strong team player.

This includes defining the operational concept, developing and validating on-board software, and developing a simulator of the spacecraft, among many other things. One of the central elements of our spacecraft is the System Reference Database (SRDB) that contains a digital representation of the Avionics architecture, and serves as the central engineering and data hub for the Avionics design.

At the Airbus site in Friedrichshafen you will be working on innovation where others spend their holidays. Enjoy panoramic views of Lake Constance while having lunch in our canteen. And after work, join one of our many corporate sports groups to go running, sailing or skiing.

The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

The Division of Soft-Tissue Sarcoma at the Hopp Children’s Cancer Center (KiTZ) - a joint institution of the Heidelberg University Hospital and the German Cancer Research Center - is seeking, starting between December 2026 and January 2027, a Laboratory Technician / Laboratory Manager.

Your Tasks

We are a friendly and motivated laboratory with German and international researchers working to understand tumor biology and generate new models to help find treatments for children and adults with sarcoma. The candidate’s tasks will comprise lab management, cell culture, plasmid preps, support in various molecular biology techniques and training of new laboratory members on specifc tasks when required. Occasional mouse work may be required. Routine animal work is covered by a dedicated technician, with the successful candidate only expected to assist during periods of absence or in exceptional circumstances. While the position involves both administrative and laboratory work, there is some flexibility in the balance between these two areas, depending on the successful candidate’s interests. The candidate will work together with other members of the laboratory and will be trained in the various tasks.

- Be motivated, responsible, and well organised
- Have completed vocational training as a biological laboratory technician or hold a comparable qualification
- Have experience in cell culture and standard molecular biology techniques
- Have basic experience in handling mice, ideally hold a FELASA certificate
- Be willing to train technical trainees and early-career scientists in specific laboratory techniques
- Have a working knowledge of English and German
- Have good communication skills and the ability to document laboratory work accurately

WHAT MAKES THIS POSITION SPECIAL

- Training in a range of laboratory techniques
- An interesting and varied role, with the opportunity to contribute actively, alongside the wider research group, to laboratory organisation and the group’s future development
- Friendly, collaborative, and international working environment
- Workplace in the new KiTZ building and access to the modern, state-of-the-art infrastructure of the DKFZ campus

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Resident Quality Engineer (f/m/d), you will spend your day working closely with suppliers, manufacturing teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure product quality, production stability, and delivery performance. A significant portion of your role involves being on-site at supplier locations, leading quality escalations, supporting production recovery, and driving sustainable process improvements. You will analyze manufacturing challenges, coordinate corrective actions, conduct audits, and collaborate with engineering and operations teams to strengthen process capability and customer satisfaction. With approximately 25–30% travel, you will play a critical role in maintaining quality excellence across the supply chain.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Deployment to supplier sites as a dedicated quality escalation expert to stabilize production following critical quality, technical, or delivery issues
* Leadership of immediate containment activities to prevent defect escapes, protect customers, and maintain operational continuity
* Development and management of supplier recovery plans including action tracking, milestone management, accountability, and executive reporting
* Execution of root cause analyses, manufacturing process reviews, and quality audits to identify risks, process gaps, and improvement opportunities
* Definition, implementation, validation, and sustainability tracking of corrective and preventive actions to address both short-term and systemic issues
* Collaboration with supplier engineering, quality, and operations teams to improve process capability, product quality, manufacturing efficiency, and long-term performance

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Quality Engineering, or a related technical discipline
* Extensive experience in quality management, manufacturing environments, supplier quality, and production process improvement
* Strong expertise in root cause analysis, problem-solving methodologies, Kaizen, supplier recovery activities, and critical manufacturing process assessments
* Proven ability to identify technical failure mechanisms, implement sustainable process improvements, and ensure long-term effectiveness of corrective actions
* Experience working in cross-functional and international environments, ideally with turbine hot gas components or other complex manufacturing technologies
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills, combined with fluency in German and English and willingness to travel approximately 25–30% to supplier locations worldwide

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and 
decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, 
steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, 
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

About us
The transition to a sustainable, carbon-neutral future is reshaping the energy, building, and industrial process industries at an unprecedented pace. Renewable energy, storage solutions, and the accelerating electrification of transport and industrial processes are placing new and complex demands on the power grids of tomorrow.
As ONE Tech Company, Siemens is more than the sum of its parts — and this role sits right at the heart of that ambition. We are aligning product and portfolio elements across our businesses, harmonizing our energy management offerings, and building a coherent go-to-market strategy that reflects the full strength of Siemens. jobs.occupation: Sales Director (f/m/d) Test & Validation - DACH (Leiter/in - Vertrieb)
jobs.description:
Shape the Future of Engineering Test & Validation

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation - helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

Our Testing business sits at the heart of this transformation. As products become more software-defined, connected, electrified, and complex, manufacturers need to bring together physical testing, data acquisition, simulation, analysis, and engineering software into a connected validation process.
This creates a significant growth opportunity - and we are looking for an exceptional commercial leader to lead it across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland (DACH).

The Opportunity
As Test Country Lead (w/m/d) DACH, you will own the commercial success and growth of the Siemens Test business across the region.
You will lead the Sales and PreSales organization while remaining highly visible in the market and directly engaged with strategic customers. This is a player-coach leadership role: you will build and develop a high-performing organization while personally shaping major opportunities, executive relationships, and strategic accounts.
You will spend at least 50% of your time with strategic customers and in the market, ensuring that you remain close to customer priorities, technology trends, competitive dynamics, and the opportunities shaping the future of engineering test and validation.
This is an opportunity to build and grow a significant business in one of the world's most important engineering markets, supported by Siemens' global technology portfolio, resources, and customer relationships.
What you will ownLead the DACH Test Business

- Own the overall commercial performance of the Test business across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.- Drive revenue, growth, profitability, and market-share objectives across hardware, software, maintenance, and customer & engineering services.- Define and execute the regional business strategy and annual operating plan.- Identify new growth opportunities, markets, customers, and routes to market.- Establish clear commercial priorities, KPIs, and accountability across the organization.

Lead from the Market- Personally engage with strategic customers and executive stakeholders, building trusted relationships at C-level and senior engineering levels.- Lead major strategic sales pursuits and complex, multi-year opportunities.- Develop compelling value propositions and quantified business cases that connect technology investment to measurable customer outcomes.- Understand customer engineering and validation challenges and translate them into differentiated Siemens solutions.- Maintain a strong understanding of market trends, competitor strategies, technology shifts, and emerging customer requirements.- Represent Siemens Test at customer events, industry conferences, and executive forums.

Build a High-Performing Sales Organization- Lead, coach, and develop the DACH Sales and PreSales organization.- Recruit and retain exceptional commercial and technical sales talent.- Create a culture of accountability, customer obsession, collaboration, and continuous improvement.- Align individual strengths and expertise with strategic market opportunities.- Establish clear development and succession plans for key roles.- Raise the overall standard of consultative, value-based, and solution-oriented selling.

Win in a Competitive Market- Develop differentiated strategies for strategic accounts and competitive opportunities.- Build strong account and territory plans that increase market penetration and customer value.- Lead competitive positioning across the Test & Validation landscape.- Govern Proof-of-Concept engagements with clear success criteria, commercial objectives, and transition plans.- Develop and manage a high-performing partner ecosystem to extend market reach and accelerate growth.

Connect Customers with Siemens Technology

- Work closely with global Product Management, Industry, Engineering, and Services teams to bring the right solutions to customers.- Ensure that customer feedback and market intelligence directly influence regional and global strategy.- Drive adoption of the broader Siemens portfolio by connecting test, measurement, simulation, engineering software, and services into compelling customer solutions.- Ensure operational excellence through accurate forecasting, disciplined opportunity management, reliable demonstrations, and measurable sales performance.

What You Bring

We are looking for an accomplished Sales Director, Business Leader, or Commercial Leader who combines strong sales leadership with a deep understanding of engineering-driven technology markets, especially in test & validation.

- A successful track record in B2B sales leadership within engineering software, test & measurement, validation, simulation, industrial technology, or a closely related field- Experience leading Sales and PreSales organizations with direct responsibility for regional business performance.- A proven record of winning complex, high-value opportunities involving multiple technical, commercial, and executive stakeholders.- Strong experience developing strategic accounts and building long-term relationships with senior engineering and executive decision-makers.- Experience selling solutions such as test & measurement, data acquisition, test automation, validation, simulation, NVH, HIL/XIL, engineering software, or related technologies is highly valuable.- Strong commercial judgment and demonstrated success in negotiations and complex deal structures.- The ability to translate sophisticated technology into clear customer value and compelling business outcomes.- Experience building, coaching, and motivating high-performing sales organizations.- A strong external network and understanding of the DACH engineering and manufacturing ecosystem.- Experience working with strategic partners and developing indirect routes to market.- Strong understanding of industries such as Automotive & Transportation, Aerospace & Defense, Electronics & Semiconductors, Energy, and Industrial Machinery.- Excellent executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and storytelling skills.- Willingness to travel regularly across the DACH region and internationally.- Highly proficient spoken and written German and English.

Why Us

We are Siemens: At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across many countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Our Benefits & Rewards

The primary locations for this opportunity are Austria, Germany, and Switzerland. The applicable salary ranges for these locations are:
Austria: €162,200 – €308,300
Germany: €145,500 – €291,000

Switzerland: CHF 249,900 – CHF 437,200

This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation with 50% of this being comprised of an annual incentive target (100% achievement). The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/ (https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/)

This position may also be posted in additional locations beyond those specified above. For such locations, the applicable salary ranges and benefits will be disclosed by the Talent Acquisition Partner at the time of initial contact, in accordance with local legal requirements.

Equal Opportunities

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. jobs.description:
Job description

In order to support the Logistic ELT2 Team, Airbus Helicopters is looking for a

Logistics Systems Engineer (d/f/m)

Your location

At our Donauwörth site, located on the banks of the river Danube, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the airworthy product. Watch them take off and touch down on our own on-site test airfield.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

The team of Logistic Systems at Airbus Helicopters is responsible for specifying, implementing and improving the logistics system (warehouse, infrastructure, IT, material allocations, material flows, and processes) to enable Operations (industrial, services, and MRO) for an efficient and reliable On-Time-Delivery of material to the Point of Use/Delivery.
As a Logistic System engineer, you will contribute to the mission by specifying and designing layouts, flows, processes as well as identifying, analysing, and implementing improvements within warehouse and shopfloor logistics operations. You will leverage operational insights, audits, and data to optimise internal flows, standardise work practices, and enhance process robustness across Airbus Helicopters sites.

- Designing logistic (intra and inter-site) process and infrastructure solutions to enhance efficiency and accuracy
- Designing warehouse layouts and specify infrastructure/means to ensure optimal flows and surface utilization
- Specifying in collaboration with the internal customers logistics means to ensure safe and efficient handling of material
- Support the creation and update of logistics work instructions, ensuring clarity, consistency, and operational applicability
- Ensure a smooth handover to production of the solutions designed by involving operations at an early stage
- Ensuring all logistics solutions are in line with the company's strategic, compliance and environmental policies
- Ensuring all processes are in line with the guidelines provided by quality, export control, and other relevant functions
- Identifying the need for changes in the existing logistic infrastructure and initiate appropriate actions
- Monitor intra-site and inter-site process execution, identifying inconsistencies and contributing to corrective action plans
- Supporting the digitalisation team
- Analyse shopfloor logistics flows, including inbounding, picking, kitting, and outbound, to identify improvement levers
- Provide functional support to site leads and warehouse teams, helping deploy and stabilise improved internal logistics processes at site level

Desired skills and qualifications

- Degree in logistics or a related technical field
- At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in the logistics sector (engineering, field service, logistics platforms)
- In-depth knowledge of process design, process optimization, and the implementation of new processes
- Experience with SAP systems (ideally the EWM warehouse management system)
- ​Knowledge of the aerospace industry is a plus
- Basic knowledge of quality management is desirable
- Ability and willingness to navigate a complex corporate environment
- Business-level proficiency in German and English required; knowledge of French is a plus

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

About CF Assurance (CF A)
Our mission at Controlling and
Finance Assurance (CF A) is to provide objective, factual and independent
foresight to help Siemens be excellent and to improve the overall success of
the company. As a business partner to Siemens management, we leverage our
expertise in a wide range of topics in order to create an impact. We offer an
inspiring, diverse and inclusive environment for our people to develop
professionally and personally. Our core values – being respectful, curious,
humble and open – define how we work together as a department.
To deliver on our vision of
being pioneers in assurance and a talent incubator for Siemens, CF A offers a
unique Growth and Development Model. We believe in the concept of lifelong

harmonized control requirements (the ‘Policy and Control Masterbook’) as well
as our ‘Risk and Internal Control (RIC) Manual’ as the foundation for the
internal control process.

into ONE Tech Company, our IC department plays a critical role in
ensuring robust Internal Controls across the enterprise, especially over
Financial Reporting (ICFR) and Sustainability Reporting (ICSR). We are at the
forefront of leveraging innovative technologies – including Generative AI – to enhance control effectiveness, drive automation, and support
Siemens' strategic growth levers.

dedicated, results-oriented pioneer who leverages their expertise and inspires
others to give their best. You are comfortable challenging established
approaches and driving change where it creates value. Be bold and apply now to become a part of our CF Assurance Internal Control team in
Munich or Erlangen.

implement innovative use cases leveraging GenAI to
transform IC processes – covering ideas from automated control testing and
risk assessment to intelligent documentation and anomaly detection. You

effectiveness, efficiency, and insights.

effective yet efficient design of Siemens' Internal Control methodology, especially
for IT controls of systems relevant for financial reporting (e.g.,
ITGC/ITAC) and sustainability reporting.

for the IT Controls part of our Internal Control System (ICS) methodology
and update the RIC Manual to reflect new methodological
developments, regulatory requirements, and technological advancements.

patterns regarding IT controls of the Siemens Group and evaluate control
deficiencies, leveraging data analytics and AI-driven insights where
applicable, and be confident to bring relevant topics into management’s
view.

broader CF Assurance function and expand your experience through
assignments as a guest auditor, contributing to the 'CF A innovation process', or supporting cross-functional transformation initiatives.

administration, information systems, finance, or related studies, ideally

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.

At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust.

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

Who will you join?

Group Compliance - Investigations
About the role

Allianz Group Compliance is evolving its investigations function toward a more integrated, increasingly technology- and AI-enabled operating model. We are at the beginning of that journey. The primary requirement for this role remains hands-on experience in complex investigations. In addition, the role holder will help shape how the function adopts investigative technology and AI - pragmatically, and in a responsible, human-led way. We welcome candidates from an investigations, IT-forensics or legal-tech background who combine strong investigative capability with a genuine interest in developing this area.

How can you make an impact?

As an Investigator / Investigation Counsel, your responsibilities will include:

Investigations

html Quality Manager (all genders) in Space Hardware ProductionTaufkirchen, Garching / Full-time / Permanent employee

Blackwave designs, manufactures and ships flight-qualified, commercial off-the-shelf composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) for launch vehicles and satellites. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, the company delivers COPVs from a standardized portfolio with flight heritage. The approach reduces lead time from months to days while ensuring that each tank is qualified and flight-ready. Blackwave's mission is to end COPV failure in spaceflight. The company employs more than 150 people across manufacturing facilities in Germany and Texas.

More information at Blackwave.com and the procurement platform COPV.com.

Quality Manager (all genders) in Space Hardware Production
Taufkirchen, Garching / Full-time / Permanent employee YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

THE WHY

At Blackwave, we develop and manufacture Composite Overwrapped Pressure Vessels and carbon fiber structures for the space industry — hardware where failure is not an option. As we scale from one site in Germany to two with our new facility in Texas, quality can't be an afterthought or a paper exercise. We're looking for a Quality Manager who builds a pragmatic, ISO 9001-compliant Quality Management System from the ground up for our Texas site, keeps our German QMS sharp, and creates a quality culture that engineers, operators, and management actually live — not one that gathers dust in a document folder.

THE WHAT

- Own ISO 9001 at both sites: Maintain certification in Germany and establish it in Texas, preparing all audits — internal, certification, and customer — together with the teams so they're passed without major findings. Blackwave Code: High Performance
- Build processes people actually use: Define and implement essential quality processes that are pragmatic and scalable enough for development, manufacturing, and management to apply confidently in daily work. Blackwave Code: Togetherness
- Make performance visible: Give leadership clear, up-to-date visibility into company performance through meaningful KPIs and management reviews that drive decisions rather than just report numbers. Blackwave Code: Candor
- Own risk end-to-end: Establish and actively maintain a company-wide risk management system covering organizational, process, and product risks — with clear ownership and follow-up on mitigations. Blackwave Code: Accountability
- Digitize quality: Establish a digital QMS platform as the mandatory system of record, with quality documentation and workflows fully migrated and adopted across the organization. Blackwave Code: Playfulness

YOUR PROFILE

- 3–5+ years of experience in quality management within a manufacturing environment — you've stood on a shop floor, not just in an office
- Degree in a technical field (e.g. aerospace or mechanical engineering) plus relevant further training in quality management
- Hands-on ISO 9001 experience: you've managed audit cycles and can walk us through a process you set up yourself, end to end
- Pragmatic quality mindset: you build processes for usage, not just for compliance — standards are an enabler, not bureaucracy
- Builder mentality: you create structures from scratch rather than maintaining what's already there, and you see a bit of chaos as an opportunity
- Strong ownership and communication at all levels — from C-level to operator
- Fluent English is a must; German is a plus

WHAT WE OFFER

- Freedom to Create: Extensive decision-making freedom and short decision paths – we trust your expertise to lead your team.
- Fresh Fuel Every Day: Shared lunch breaks with freshly prepared, varied meals to keep the team energized.
- Coffee Culture @ Blackwave: Enjoy premium coffee from our portafilter machine or join one of our barista courses.
- Choose Your Perk: Select from a Deutschland-Ticket, EGYM Wellpass, or a Give Card.
- Gear up for Take-off: Receive premium Blackwave team apparel during your on boarding.
- Grow in Aerospace: Expand your professional horizons in a high-growth company at the forefront of space technology.
- Rooftop Relaxation: End your day on our spacious rooftop terrace with a panoramic view of the Alps.

The approach reduces lead time from months to days while ensuring that each tank is qualified and flight-ready. Blackwave's mission is to end COPV failure in spaceflight. The company employs more than 150 people across manufacturing facilities in Germany and Texas.

More information at Blackwave.com and the procurement platform COPV.com.

R&D Engineer – Composite Winding Process (all genders)
Taufkirchen / Full-time / Permanent employee YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

The What: COPV failure in spaceflight is a solved problem – if the underlying process is right. The quality of our composite winding process determines the quality of every tank we build. We need an engineer who will own this research, drive it forward independently, and help us produce tanks that do not fail.

The Why: You are the owner of our composite winding process research. You don’t inherit a finished method – you develop one. From experiment design to test execution, data analysis to team knowledge transfer: you plan the work, run it, and take responsibility for the results.

You ensure:

- Experiments are designed thoroughly and executed to plan.
- Findings are analyzed critically and translated into concrete process improvements.
- Knowledge is documented andsharedso the team moves forward together.

YOUR MISSION

Research and improve the composite winding process: Design and run experiments to advance our winding process and improve tank performance. Learn from every project, increase your efficiency over time, and develop improvement ideas.

High Performance – Deliver strong results under pressure. Each project makes the next one better.

Own your projects end-to-end: Take full responsibility for assigned projects – scope, schedule, and deliverables. Drive projects forward without being prompted. Question your own results and push for better.

Accountability – Own your work. Follow through. Deliver results independently.

Work closely within the team and across functions: Collaborate effectively within the team and with colleagues across the company. Coordinate on test scheduling, share progress proactively, and contribute to a team that moves as one.

Togetherness – The team succeeds together. Support others as you expect to be supported.

Share findings and challenge ideas openly: Defend your conclusions with confidence and stay open when others push back. Document and share knowledge proactively – what you learn should not stay with you alone. In our environment, speaking up and being transparent isn't just a value – it's a safety requirement.

Candor – Surface problems early. Speak up. Fix things faster.

Bring curiosity and ideas to every project: Approach technical challenges with genuine interest and a drive to understand how things work. Bring new ideas to the table, experiment with approaches, and stay energized by the complexity of the problem.

Playfulness – Serious about the mission. Driven by curiosity.

YOUR PROFILE

- Engineering degree in mechanical, aerospace, materials, chemical, or related field (BSc minimum; MSc or PhD preferred).
- At least 2 years of hands-on experience with composite materials and their processing.
- At least one thesis or job focused on composites– composite materials, processes, dimensioning, testing
- Comfortable working in a lab, workshop, or test environment; practical ability comes along with theoretical background.
- Willingness to document work thoroughly and share knowledge with the team.
- English proficiency, German nice to have

Please upload work references and university transcripts with your application to be considered!

WHAT WE OFFER

- High level of autonomy and real impact on our technology.
- Startup mindset meets aerospace innovation: flat hierarchies, fast decisions, and room for your ideas.
- Your choice of benefit: Germany ticket,EgymWellpass, or a tax-free Give Card.
- Fresh shared lunches and a healthy team culture.
- Stunning views of the Alps from our Taufkirchen rooftop terrace.
- Growth opportunities: exciting projects and inspiring colleagues.
- A team that celebrates success together – tech talks, team events, and after-work gatherings.

Please send your CV in English and get ready for take-off!

Testing Operator - Space Hardware Testing (all genders)
Taufkirchen / Full-time / Permanent employee YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

THE WHY

We build pressure vessels and carbon structures for spaceflight. Before our hardware flies, it gets tested — and you keep the testing running. Without you, the test bench stands still.

THE WHAT

You prepare tests, help run them, and document the results. You work in the lab and at the test bench — hands-on, in a team, with real space hardware every day.

Your tasks in detail:

- Prepare and post-process the testing areas: You set up test benches and specimens, tear down after tests, and keep the testing area ready for action. → High Performance: The test bench is ready when the team needs it.
- Run and document tests: You support destructive testing and acceptance testing (NDT) and record every step cleanly. → Accountability: What was tested is documented. No gaps.
- Say what you see: Anything unusual about a specimen, the test bench, or a result — you report it right away, not when someone asks. → Candor: You raise problems before they grow.
- Support the team and infrastructure: You pitch in where needed — in the testing team and with technical infrastructure on site. → Togetherness: We win as a team.
- Learn new things: NDT methods, new test procedures, new materials — you want to grow. We'll train you. → Playfulness: Curiosity is a strength here, not a distraction.

YOUR PROFILE

- Training: Completed vocational training as a materials tester / Werkstoffprüfer (plastics, metals, or fiber composites/CFRP) or comparable technical training.
- Experience: First experience in a test lab or materials testing is a plus — not a must. What matters more: you want to learn.
- Work style: Motivated, reliable, hands-on. You want the job done — and done right.
- Team player: You enjoy working with others and help out when things get busy.
- Languages: German and English, each at B2 minimum — one of the two confident for daily work.
- On-site: This role is 100% on-site in Taufkirchen. The lab and test bench don't fit in a home office.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Creative freedom & responsibility: Autonomy, scope for decision-making and short implementation paths.
- Flexible working hours & remote option: You can work remotely by arrangement.
- Culinary variety: Lunch together with fresh, varied dishes every day.
- Attractive additional benefits: Choose between Deutschlandticket, EGYM-Well pass or a monthly top-up payment card (GivveCard).
- Knowledge exchange at the highest level: Work with experienced engineers and experts from the aerospace industry.
- Dynamic environment: Exciting projects, development opportunities and a start-up atmosphere with agile, cross-functional collaboration.
- Community & team spirit: Monthly blackout events for socialising, networking and exchange.
- Unique working atmosphere: Enjoy the end of the working day on our large roof terrace with a view of the Alps!

jobs.occupation: PhD position (m/f/d) on immune reset through CAR T in chronic inflammatory diseases (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
State-of-the-art medicine and nursing care you can rely on! - Since being founded in 1815, Universitätsklinikum Erlangen has offered medicine of the highest standard and incorporated the latest insights from medical research and state-of-the-art equipment into diagnosis and therapy. More than 10.000 employees from approximately 50 different occupations are needed to provide the wide range of services offered by Universitätsklinikum Erlangen, ensuring our patients receive the very best care around the clock.

As a PhD student, you will investigate how human immune-cell networks shape tissue inflammation, regeneration and response to cellular therapies. The project will focus primarily on the human immune system and combine patient-derived material with experimental models to address mechanistic questions in cellular immunology.

Your tasks:

- Characterizing human immune-cell populations and their functional states using multiparameter flow cytometry and high-dimensional immune phenotyping.
- Investigating cellular interactions and immune networks by integrating phenotypic, functional and molecular data from immune cells and tissues.
- Studying immune responses to cellular therapies, including the mechanisms underlying immune depletion, reconstitution and tissue regeneration following CD19 CAR-T-cell therapy.
- Generating and analyzing molecular data using approaches such as bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing and other transcriptomic or spatial technologies.
- Establishing and applying experimental models to investigate mechanisms identified in human samples, including selected mouse models of intestinal inflammation, immune reconstitution and tissue regeneration after CD19 CAR-T-cell therapy.
- Developing and combining experimental and analytical approaches ranging from established methods such as ELISA, Western blotting and flow cytometry to advanced multidimensional cytometry, UMAP-based analysis and transcriptomic approaches.
- The project offers substantial scope to develop an individual scientific profile. Previous experience with these techniques is welcome, but curiosity, scientific independence, willingness to learn, and enthusiasm for understanding how immune cells interact in human disease are similarly important.

Essential experience/ qualifications:

- Above the average motivation and work ethics
- Strong theoretical and practical background in standard methods of molecular and cellular biology as well as cellular immunology
- English writing and speaking skills
- Ability to work together in a multi-national team that is supportive of one another
- A master degree (M.Sc.) in immunology, biology, molecular biology, molecular medicine or equivalent

additional advantages:

- Experience in omics data science
- Hands-on experience in human immunology

We offer:

- The position is full-time and will be payed according to salary group TVL-E 13, 65% (DFG-typical rate)
- Intended pay grade depending on qualifications and personal requierements
- Initially, the position is limited for one year, with the possibility of an extension till the degreee is achieved
- The head of the department guaranties in writing that there is funding till the degree is achieved.
- Hiring process opened and will be completed asap.
- An enthusiastic, interdisciplinary team of scientists and doctors
- High end translational research
- State-of-the-art laboratories
- Two-Stepp mentoring with a hands-on mentor (post-doc) plus the PI as supervisor with high frequent project discussions for efficient development
- Structured program for hard- and soft-skills in research (paper and grant writing classes, paper clubs, soft-skill training)
- Notes for applicants (f/m/d) ( https://www.karriere.uk-erlangen.de/bewerbung/hinweise-fuer-bewerbende/ )
- Comprehensive health promotion offers
- All benefits of the public service incl. supplementary pension plan of the Versorgungsanstalt des Bundes und der Länder (VBL) (Federal and State Government Employees' Retierment Fund)
- Family-friendly enviroment

jobs.occupation: Head of Global Commodity Engineering Mechatronics 2 (f/m/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description:
Job Posting: Head of Global Commodity Engineering Mechatronics 2 (m/f/d)
Transform the everyday.
This role is responsible for leading the global strategy, governance, and execution of Material Lifecycle Management for mechanical and mechatronic components across the entire supply chain. The individual ensures suppliers, manufacturing processes, quality standards, and material strategies are optimized for cost, quality, productivity, resilience, and sustainability while driving cross-functional collaboration between Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing, Logistics, and Quality teams worldwide.
In short, this is a senior global leadership position focused on improving supplier performance, product quality, operational efficiency, and supply chain effectiveness throughout the lifecycle of mechanical and mechatronic materials and components.

What we offer you

- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests
- (Global) development programs that can be customized according to your wishes and ambitions
- Diverse health and wellness offerings
- A work environment where you can contribute with your whole personality and truly feel like part of Siemens

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here.

The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

How you will make an Impact with us

- You will be responsible for the global strategic direction of Material Lifecycle Management for mechanical and mechatronic components, including drawing-controlled parts, assemblies, manufacturing scopes, and supply chain investments.
- You will lead a team  (either directly or through collaboration models) and provide functional governance for local Material Lifecycle Management teams focused on mechatronics. You will ensure clear roles, standards, decision-making processes, and effective cross-site collaboration.
- You will develop and implement a global strategy for mechatronic parts, processes, and suppliers, focusing on standardization, technical feasibility, quality capability, supply chain resilience, sustainability, Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), and productivity.
- You will define supplier quality-related processes, methods, and standards for mechanical components and drive their global deployment, application, and continuous optimization across an international network.
- You will oversee preventive quality planning and industrialization readiness, particularly risk assessments, Process FMEA, Control Plans, Production Control Plans, First Article Inspection/PPAP, process audits, and release procedures for drawing-controlled purchased parts.
- You will establish a robust supplier problem management system with clear 8D governance, root cause analysis, effectiveness verification, lessons learned, claims management, and escalation procedures to sustainably reduce quality costs and recurring defects.
- You will further develop global and regional suppliers in collaboration with Procurement, R&D, Manufacturing, Logistics, and other partners, focusing on process capability, performance, technological expertise, capacity, risk mitigation, and ESG requirements.
- You will drive transparency, digitalization, and data-based management through supplier quality KPIs, audit and action management, quality cost tracking, risk dashboards, and standardized management reporting.
- You will identify productivity opportunities throughout the material lifecycle, including standardization, product variant reduction, make-or-buy optimization, value stream and supply chain analysis, cost and process improvements, and robust relocation and localization strategies.
- You will represent Mechatronics Material Lifecycle Management in global decision-making committees and ensure strategic contributions are integrated early into development, sourcing, investment, and production decisions.

What you bring

Leadership & Governance

- You bring extensive long-term leadership experience in global, multicultural organizations, including both direct people leadership and cross-functional management across sites, functions, and hierarchical levels. You are capable of developing teams, clarifying responsibilities, setting priorities, and driving organizational change effectively.

Mechanical & Mechatronic Components

- You possess a strong understanding of mechanical and mechatronic materials, especially drawing-controlled parts, manufacturing processes, tolerances, inspection concepts, process capability, industrialization, engineering changes, capital investments, and global supply chain risks.

Strategy, Digitalization & Productivity

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) in CAR-T Cell Therapy (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
The **Children’s Hospital Augsburg (Swabian Children’s Cancer Center) **and the University of Augsburg are looking for a Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) in CAR-T Cell Therapy and Therapeutic Target Discovery in Pediatric and Rare Tumors to join our interdisciplinary research program at the interface of pediatric oncology, tumor biology, cellular therapy, therapeutic target discovery, and computational cancer biology. The position is a full-time position which is limited to two years.

The Children’s Hospital Augsburg (Swabian Children’s Cancer Center) is part of University Hospital Augsburg (UKA), a rapidly growing academic medical center with 1,699 patient beds across 22 clinics and approximately 2,800 employees. Scientifically, the hospital is a member of the NCT-WERA cooperation and thus one location of the National Center for Tumor Diseases (NCT).

**Research Environment **

- Single-cell, spatial, and multi-omic technologies are providing unprecedented opportunities to characterize tumor composition, heterogeneity, and evolution. Our research program combines these approaches with experimental tumor modeling to identify clinically actionable vulnerabilities in rare and high-risk tumors
- Our group has established a strong track record in the molecular characterization of pediatric and rare tumors, including rhabdoid tumors and other embryonal malignancies. Recent integrative studies have provided new insights into the biology and evolution of these tumors and opened avenues for therapeutic translation (Johann et al., Cancer Cell, 2016; Erkek, Johann et al., Cancer Cell, 2019; Fincke et al., Clinical Cancer Research, 2023; Mucha et al., Communications Medicine, 2025; Fincke et al., Nature Communications, 2026, accepted)
- A central goal of this position is the identification, prioritization, and experimental validation of therapeutic targets in rare entities for which effective treatment options remain limited. Relevant tumor types include DICER1-associated neoplasms, rhabdoid tumors, pediatric and rare melanomas, and other high-risk pediatric malignancies
- The successful candidate will combine molecular and computational analyses with state-of-the-art experimental approaches. CAR-T-cell therapy will represent a major experimental platform for evaluating candidate cell-surface targets and developing targeted cellular therapies
- Together with our partner institutions, we are establishing a growing biobank of patient-derived tumor organoids and other advanced tumor models, enabling systematic investigation of target expression, therapeutic efficacy, and mechanisms of resistance, including in vivo

**Your Responsibilities **

- Identify and prioritize novel therapeutic targets using integrated molecular, single-cell, spatial, and multi-omic data
- Experimentally validate candidate targets using patient-derived models, organoids, and cell lines
- Generate, engineer, and functionally characterize CAR-T cells
- Develop and optimize CAR constructs and cellular therapy strategies
- Evaluate CAR-T-cell efficacy and mechanisms of resistance in vitro and, ideally, in vivo
- Integrate experimental results with bioinformatic and computational analyses
- Develop independent research projects and contribute to grants and collaborative projects
- Publish and present research findings
- Mentor students and junior researchers where appropriate

Requirements

Mandatory

- PhD or equivalent degree in biology, molecular medicine, cancer biology, immunology, biotechnology, or a related field
- Hands-on experience in CAR-T-cell generation, engineering, and functional characterization
- Strong background in experimental cancer or cellular biology
- Experience in independent experimental research and data analysis
- Strong interest in therapeutic target discovery and translational cancer research
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills
- Excellent written and spoken English

Highly desirable

- Experience with therapeutic in vivo testing of CAR-T cells and/or xenograft models
- Experience with tumor organoids or patient-derived models
- Expertise in CAR design, viral transduction, T-cell expansion, flow cytometry, or functional immune-cell assays
- Experience in therapeutic target discovery and validation
- Familiarity with single-cell, spatial, or multi-omic approaches
- Programming skills in R or Python

What we offer

- Remuneration up to pay grade EG 13 TV-L, depending on qualifications and professional experience, including the standard social benefits provided in the public sector (occupational pension scheme and annual special payment)
- The position is initially limited to two years; an extension is intended, subject to funding and successful performance
- An interdisciplinary research environment combining experimental oncology, CAR-T-cell engineering, therapeutic target discovery, and computational cancer biology
- Integration into the research program of the University of Augsburg, with close collaboration with the University Hospital Augsburg and computational research groups
- The opportunity to work on rare and clinically challenging tumor entities, including DICER1-associated neoplasms, rhabdoid tumors, melanomas, and other high-risk pediatric malignancies
- Access to advanced patient-derived tumor models, including a growing collection of tumor organoids
- Opportunities to develop an independent academic profile, publish, present at international conferences, and contribute to grant applications
- International collaborations and opportunities for research visits with academic partner institutions

Contact

For further questions please refer to Prof. Dr. Pascal Johann (Pascal.Johann@uk-augsburg.de)

Application Deadline

Please submit your application as soon as possible, latest at the 15th of October 2026.

We look forward to you!

The position is suitable for people with severe disabilities. Applicants (m/f/d) with severe disabilities will be preferred if they are essentially the same aptitude, ability and professional performance. Women are invited to apply in accordance with Article 7 (3) BayGlG. When starting work at the Augsburg University Hospital, proof of sufficient immune protection in accordance with §§ 23, 23a IfSG must be presented or the same must be met.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.

Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

At Roche, we believe precision medicine radically improves lives. Our Global CAP/CLIA laboratories are the "heartbeat" of diagnostic innovation, bridging the gap between early research and life-saving commercial diagnostics. As a Laboratory Manager, you aren't just overseeing a facility; you are leading a team that transforms complex biological data into the insights clinicians need to treat patients with cancer and other life-altering diseases.

We are seeking a high-caliber Laboratory Manager (m/f/d) to oversee our dual-specialty pathology and immunoassay laboratory. This role requires a unique blend of technical expertise in tissue-based diagnostics and immunoassay automated testing.

You will be responsible for the operational excellence of the lab, ensuring that both the Histology/Pathology and Immunoassay/Chemistry departments function at peak efficiency while maintaining total compliance with ISO15189, CAP (College of American Pathologists) and CLIA regulations.

The Opportunity

You will oversee a dual-specialty laboratory at the forefront of the industry. Your leadership will span two critical domains:
* Anatomic Pathology: Managing high-complexity tissue-based diagnostics, including advanced Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and In Situ Hybridization (ISH)
* Immunoassay Excellence: Driving peaks of operational efficiency in our automated immunoassay tracks on state-of-the-art cobas® platforms

You will also be a key driver in our Digital Pathology transformation, integrating whole-slide imaging and AI-based image analysis into routine clinical workflows to set new standards for diagnostic precision. Your key responsibilities:

* Visionary Operational Leadership: Supervise the daily "rhythm" of the lab, synchronizing pathology and immunoassay workflows to ensure competitive turnaround times (TAT)
* Guardian of Quality: Maintain an "inspection-ready" culture, serving as the primary lead for CAP/CLIA and ISO 15189 audits
* Champion of People: Lead, mentor, and inspire team of Laboratory scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence
* Strategic Technical Oversight: Manage the validation and implementation of new assays and novel platforms, ensuring every piece of equipment is a high-performing component of our diagnostic system
* Innovate & Improve: Actively identify opportunities for workflow optimization and cost-effective management without ever compromising the quality that defines the Roche name

Who you are
* You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Clinical Laboratory Science, Medical Technology, or a related Biological Science. A Master’s (MHA/MBA) or PhD is highly preferred.
* Furthermore, you have 5+ years of experience in a clinical laboratory setting
* Proven expertise in both anatomic pathology and automated immunoassay workflows is a distinct advantage
* The ideal candidate isn't just a technical expert; You are a leader who fosters a culture of quality, safety, and continuous improvement with at least 2 years of experience in a leadership role
* You live the Roche mindset by maintaining a track record of zero-deficiency inspections and a passion for navigating the complexities of emerging global regulations

You build that credibility from the ground up, combining daily community intelligence with real commercial content production.

You also engage proactively wherever technical conversations happen, from tutorials and GPU workload guides to infrastructure tips and genuine participation in technical discussions, always credibility first and aligned with our tone of voice.

jobs.occupation: Master's Thesis: Multi-Fidelity Propeller Optimization (all genders) (Ingenieur/in - Medizintechnik)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLEWe are looking for a Master's student to join our growing Aerodynamics team and carry out a thesis project on the development of a multi-fidelity propeller optimization framework for our hybrid-electric eVTOL aircraft. You will help extend an existing automated propeller design workflow - covering geometry generation, meshing, CFD simulation and post-processing - into a full optimization environment that combines fast Blade Element Momentum Theory (BEMT) predictions, high-fidelity CFD, and aeroacoustics prediction.
Your thesis will directly support propeller designs that perform efficiently across hover, transition and forward flight. The thesis takes around six months and is supervised jointly by our Aerodynamics team and the Chair of Aerodynamics and Fluid Mechanics at the Technical University of Munich (TUM).
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Conduct a literature review on propeller optimization methodologies and multi-fidelity approaches
• Familiarize yourself with two existing frameworks for propeller design optimization: low-fidelity BEMT environment, automated CFD surrogate modeling-based optimization framework
• Integrate aeroacoustics prediction methods, in the form of PSU-WOPWOP, as part of the low-fidelity BEMT framework
• Develop methods and strategies to leverage both frameworks and incorporate them into a combined multi-fidelity optimization framework
• Revise and update the automated geometry generation, CFD simulation execution, and post-processing into a unified workflow
• In the process you will parametrize the propeller design and perform an optimization of a test case eVTOL propeller, generate the pareto-front between efficiency and noise
• Validate low-fidelity predictions against CFD reference solutions
• Conduct optimization studies for representative flight conditions, evaluating solution quality, computational cost and convergence
• Optionally: utilize surrogate models to incorporate feedback from high fidelity model to low fidelity model for improved optimization convergence and acceleration
• Document your methodology and findings in your final thesis report

WHAT YOU BRING
• Are a student of mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, physics or a comparable field, enrolled at TUM and working towards your Master's degree
• Bring familiarity with CAD and CFD software, ideally Siemens NX and Ansys Fluent
• Hold foundational knowledge of aircraft and propulsion aerodynamics
• Have basic knowledge of numerical methods and optimization techniques
• Have strong Python programming skills
• Are able to work independently and collaborate with a team
• Have good written and verbal communication skills in English
• Bring an interest in aeroacoustics and propeller noise prediction

Moreover, it would be helpful if you also
• have prior exposure to Blade Element Momentum Theory or other low-fidelity aerodynamic methods
• have experience with aeroacoustics prediction methods like PSU-WOPWOP
• have experience with HPC-based simulation workflows
• explore the use of surrogate models to accelerate convergence between fidelity levels

WHAT WE OFFER
• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides
• A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn
• Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation
• Health & wellbeing: subsidized lunch in our canteen
• Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on board

jobs.occupation: Data & AI Engineer (all genders), PharmaHera Service GmbH (Data-Warehouse-Analyst/in)
jobs.description: Deine neue Umgebung: Behind PharmaHera is Atida - one of Europe's leading online pharmacy groups, serving over 5 million customers across 9 countries. Together with the CEPD Group, we combine more than 25 years of pharmaceutical expertise with digital excellence to redefine the online pharmacy experience: We are building a trusted, personalized health ecosystem that guides people from prevention to cure - backed by medical expertise and driven by our conviction: Pharmacy is about people. Based in Berlin, we serve as the group's competence center for Germany and the Netherlands. As a specialized partner, we manage e-commerce, marketing, IT, and logistics for our local mail-order pharmacies, such as APONEO. Our European markets run on a single, standardized data platform (our Foundation layer). Your mission for the future: To transform this data infrastructure so it is not only usable by people, but specifically prepared for AI agents that read, analyze, and autonomously act on it. The role Reporting to the Data & AI Engineer Lead, you will own the data pipelines, datasets, AI agents and tools built on top of Foundation, and you will build most of them with AI agents as part of your toolchain. The role sits one level of abstraction above the code: you specify, review and take responsibility for systems rather than typing every line. Core responsibilities Pipeline development: build and optimize data flows in Apache Airflow, from our European markets into BigQuery. Modeling in BigQuery: implement tables and views in the Foundation layer, guaranteeing KPI comparability across Spain, France, Italy and Germany. Semantic layer and data contracts: keep business definitions consistent across dashboards, models and agents, and define the schema, granularity and quality a dataset guarantees. AI-assisted delivery: use Claude Code and the Anthropic API as your everyday engineering environment -- turn a requirement into a precise specification, let the agent produce the pipeline, then review, test and own the result. Building for agents: expose Foundation through MCP tools and skills so that AIDA and our decision agents can query it reliably. A dataset is finished when an agent can use it without being misled. Evaluation: build the evals, checks and monitoring that tell us whether an agent's output is correct. Unit tests are not enough for non-deterministic systems. Data products: design data products for management, finance, commercial, operations and marketing -- reusable across markets. Visualization and reporting: work with the business team on reports and consumable datasets in Apache Superset. Code and traceability: clean Python and SQL, with every task traceable through our GitLab-Coda integration. Agent-generated code included. Your Profile & Tech Stack What You Bring to the Role (Must-Haves): Education & Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering or Data Science. AI-Assisted Engineering: Regular, demonstrable use of an LLM coding agent (Claude Code or equivalent) in daily work, plus the technical judgment to critically review agent-generated code. Tech Stack & Cloud: Solid experience with Google Cloud Platform (especially BigQuery), Apache Airflow, strong SQL, data-oriented Python, and version control via Git/GitLab. Languages: Fluent English for daily collaboration within our international team. Mindset & Work Ethic: Strong analytical skills, an independent and results-focused approach ("you get the problem and context, the solution design is yours to propose"), and a commitment to deeply understanding code rather than using AI as a blind shortcut. What Rounds Off Your Profile (Nice-to-Haves): Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), LLM APIs, ClearML, Docker, or Apache Druid. Know-how in evaluating non-deterministic systems and using BI tools (ideally Apache Superset). Industry experience in the healthcare, pharmacy, or e-commerce sectors, plus basic knowledge of German. What we are not looking for Someone who ships code they cannot explain. Someone who needs a ticket with the solution already inside it or with full requirements in place. We act fast: you get the problem, the context and access -- the design is yours to propose. Someone who uses AI as a shortcut and doesn't understand the problem they are solving. Someone who only thinks short-term. We build future-proof solutions. What You'll Get Your Work Environment: Freedom to Shape Your Role from Day 1: A position of responsibility with real opportunities for growth, where you can proactively drive initiatives and actively help shape strategies. Permanent, Full-Time Position: Long-term prospects in a future-proof market. Agile Work Environment: A motivated, dynamic team and flat hierarchies with short decision-making paths that enable fast execution. Flexibility with Team Spirit: Flexible working hours and a hybrid work model (mobile work & in-office) - with a focus on our Berlin office to foster collaboration and team cohesion. Direct Mentoring: Close collaboration and mentoring by the Data & AI Engineer Lead in a technically demanding environment. Hands-on Production Tech Stack: Real-world experience with Airflow, BigQuery, Druid, GCP, and a modern production AI stack (Claude, MCP, Agents, Evals). Professional AI Tooling: First-class AI engineering tools come as standard equipment. Your Benefits at a Glance: Health & Mobility: Urban Sports Club membership at an unbeatable price and a heavily discounted BVG corporate transit pass for your daily commute. Exclusive Perks: Attractive employee discounts on our entire APONEO product range, access to a wide variety of corporate benefits, and a Selgros card. All-Round Care: An on-campus cafeteria, free fresh fruit, vegetables, and snacks every day, plus an unlimited coffee and tea flat rate. Your Compensation & Terms: For this full-time, permanent position, we offer an attractive, market-based, and competitive compensation package. We anticipate an annual gross salary between EUR45,000 and EUR55,000 p.a. Together, we will determine your exact positioning within this range through a transparent process based on the following criteria: Your relevant practical work experience in Data & AI Engineering. Your professional qualifications and specific additional skills. Our internal salary structure to ensure fairness within the team. Equal Opportunity & Fair Pay: We don't leave fair pay to chance. We compensate all team members in equivalent positions transparently and fairly, regardless of gender or any other personal characteristic. Ready to join? Ready to actively shape the future of e-commerce and data-driven healthcare at Atida? Apply now! We look forward to receiving your CV and your earliest possible starting date.

Join our global team as a highly skilled Electrical Designer for Power Transformers (f/m/d), acting as a central hub of expertise and support for Power Transformer and Shunt Reactors engineers in our factories worldwide. Your role is crucial for ensuring our design processes are efficient, reliable, and continuously evolving. You will focus on providing support in applying solutions and guiding engineers, working closely with factories in Brazil, Mexico, and the USA to implement new tools, design rules, and innovative solutions. By connecting factory needs with our R&D development team, you will help shape the next generation of design technology and foster a culture of continuous learning.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Provide quick technical support to product engineers and assist transformer engineers with R&D rules and tools to minimize downtime
* Conduct pre-release tests of tools in real-world scenarios and provide feedback to developers
* Improve information flow and facilitate communication between factories, R&D, and other stakeholders, ensuring alignment with factory needs
* Ensure consistent global quality through structured technology transfer and work on a centralized knowledge hub for engineers
* Cultivate a community for experts to share knowledge and develop training programs for widespread adoption of best practices
* Propose improvements for tools and rules based on factory experiences, linking R&D advancements with practical engineering applications

What You Bring

* A completed degree in Electrical Engineering
* Longterm experience in Large Power Transformers and Shunt Reactors Design
* Strong understanding of various transformer and reactor types, including electrical design and calculations for dielectric, electro-magnetic, heating, cooling, and noise
* Good understanding of transformer components and their interactions, such as the core, windings, insulation, and leads
* A solid understanding of engineering, procurement, manufacturing, and quality processes, along with experience in technical product development
* Proficiency in English

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology

With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

You will serve as the organization’s “early warning and opportunity detection system,” translating external technology signals into actionable insights that inform strategy, portfolio steering, and investment decisions.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Develop and maintain a structured technology scouting process across H1–H4 horizons

* Own and continuously update the PRM Technology Radar and create strategic heatmaps of technology opportunities and threats

What You Bring

* Relevant and applicable bachelor’s degree/diploma

* Strong technical focus with a solid understanding of what Siemens Energy does, though not necessarily an expert in specific technologies

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.
