Senior Software Developer

Remuneration Group 13 | Limited: 2 years with the option to extend | Starting date: 01.12.2026 | ID: APMA007/2026 | Deadline: 11.10.2026 | Full-time/Part-time | Remote work possible

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The Photo Injector Test Facility PITZ in Zeuthen (near Berlin) is one of the leading international groups for developing modern photo injectors and their applications. Current R&D goals of PITZ include improving the electron source brightness beyond state of the art for X‑ray Free Electron Lasers as well as applications of high brightness beams, e. g. for most modern cancer radiation therapies like FLASH‑RT and SFRT (FLASHlab@PITZ). The Cherenkov Telescope Array Observatory (CTAO) is the next-generation, ground-based facility for very-high-energy gamma-ray astronomy. It will feature two massive telescope arrays deployed across both the Northern and Southern hemispheres. Operations and scientific data acquisition within the observatory are managed by the Array Control and Data Acquisition (ACADA) system. Within ACADA, the Resource Manager (RM) handles infrastructure administration and system supervision, while the Central Control (CC) orchestrates the execution of astronomical observation workflows.

As software developer, you will work for PITZ to develop server software for the accelerator control system, as well as for the ACADA system's RM and CC subsystems.

About your role:

- Development of server software for the control of different devices at PITZ using the DOOCS API
- Integration of applications into the accelerator control system
- Design and implement core operational subsystems as distributed, container-based software based on structural and behavioural design models
- Develop the orchestration logic to manage dynamic hardware groupings and automate workflows, alongside hierarchical, fault-tolerant architectures for system lifecycles and automated recovery

About you:

- University degree in computer science, physics, mathematics, engineering or related subject, or comparable qualification
- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience

For our location in Zeuthen we are seeking:

PhD student for TIQTOC optical atomic clock experiment for Ultra-light Dark Matter

Remuneration Group E13 | Limited: 3 years | Starting date: 01.01.2027 | ID: APDO006/2026 | Deadline: open | Part-time

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The Zeuthen location of DESY has a strong focus on astroparticle and particle physics (gamma-ray and neutrino astronomy, and collider particle physics). The experimental groups are accompanied by a strong theory group. DESY Zeuthen is responsible for developing and delivering detectors for astroparticle and particle physics experiments, and is actively engaged in R&D for future applications.

With the Centre for Quantum Technology and Applications (CQTA), DESY Zeuthen is taking a leading role in applying quantum technology to challenges in particle and astroparticle physics. A new search for the effects of ultralight dark matter is being constructed, using ultra-sensitive optical atomic clocks as the sensing element. The post holder will contribute to this search, developing a test setup for networked clock comparison and frequency stabilisation. The post holder will also help to develop the procedures to collect and analyse the frequency comparisons, forming the basis of fundamental physics searches for (e.g.) ultralight dark matter.

About your role:

- Active role in developing test infrastructure for optical atomic clocks and comparison to reference clocks
- Develop instrumentation for measuring fundamental constants
- Participate in building up clock-based experiments at Humboldt University, DESY, Heidelberg or U. Birmingham

About you:

- Very good command of English is required and knowledge of German is of advantage

- Strong motivation, very good organizational skills, resilience; ability to work in teams and excellent communication skills

Job Description

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.

Our clinical department defines, develops and delivers clinical programmes. Our global Clinical Operations colleagues within our PPD® clinical research services provide end-to-end support for clinical trials from study start up to monitoring through to study close out, across commercial and government contracts. Together, we help clients define and develop clinical programs, minimize delays, and implement high-quality, cost-efficient clinical studies.

The role can be home-based, office-based in Munich or Karlsruhe, or hybrid, and is offered as a permanent full time (1 FTE) or part-time position (0.8 FTE / 80%).

The CRA:

- Performs and coordinates all aspects of the clinical monitoring and site management process.
- Conducts remote or on-site visits to assess protocol and regulatory compliance and manages required documentation..
- Acts as a site processes specialist, ensuring that the trial is conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations and SOPs to guarantee subjects rights, well-being and data reliability.
- Ensures audit readiness.
- Develops collaborative relationships with investigational sites.
- Detailed tasks and responsibilities assigned to role are outlined in the task matrix.
- Travel up to 50-75%

A day in the Life:

- Monitors investigator sites with a risk-based monitoring approach applies root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks.
- Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on-site and remote monitoring activities.
- Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review.
- Documents observations in reports and letters in a timely manner using approved business writing standards.
- Brings up observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follow all issues through to resolution.
- May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner.
- Conducts monitoring tasks in accordance with the approved monitoring plan.
- Participates in the investigator payment process.
- Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings resolution.
- Investigates and follows-up on findings as applicable
- Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM) as required.
- Ensures study systems are updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System, CTMS).
- Performs QC check of reports generated from CTMS system where required.
- Participates in investigator meetings as necessary.
- Identifies potential investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites. Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted. Ensures trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.
- Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH-GCP and applicable regulations. Conducts on-site file reviews as per project specifications.
- Gives to the project team by assisting in preparation of project publications/tools and sharing ideas/suggestions with team members. Performs additional study tasks as assigned by CTM (e.g. trip report review, newsletter creation, lead CRA team calls etc).
- Facilitates effective communication between investigative sites, the client company and the PPD project team through written, oral and/or electronic contacts.
- Responds to company, client and applicable regulatory requirements/audits/inspections.
- Maintains & completes administrative tasks such as expense reports and timesheets in a timely manner.
- Gives to other project work and initiatives for process improvement, as required.

Education and Experience

- Bachelor's degree in a life sciences related field or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification.
- Previous experience in a clinical environment with exposure to clinical research, healthcare or clinical trials that provides the knowledge and skills required to perform the role
- Valid driver's license
- Full Right to work in Germany
- Fluency in English and German language to at least C1 level (note that the interview will be held in German).

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Effective clinical monitoring skills
- Demonstrated understanding of medical/therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology
- Excellent understanding and demonstrated application of ICH GCPs, applicable regulations and procedural documents
- Well-developed critical thinking skills, including but not limited to: critical attitude, in-depth investigation for appropriate root cause analysis and decision-making
- Ability to handles Risk Based Monitoring concepts and processes
- Effective oral and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with medical personnel

Serco is an international provider of services to governments and public organisations, operating across sectors where delivery, public confidence and reputation matter. In Europe, Serco works through both established Serco operations and specialist local businesses, combining international capability with a strong understanding of national requirements and operating environments.

European Homecare (EHC) in Germany and ORS in Switzerland are part of Serco and provide immigration and social care services in their respective markets. Each business has its own history, identity, workforce and stakeholder environment. Communications must therefore be locally relevant and sensitive to the nature of the services delivered, while supporting closer alignment with Serco’s standards, values, channels and wider European direction.

The European Communications team supports operations across 10 countries, four sectors and five languages. It provides strategic advice, shared standards and specialist support across internal communications, media relations, issues and crisis communications, digital content and reputation. This role is the senior local communications lead for EHC in Germany and leads internal communications for ORS in Switzerland, while working as an integral member of the European Communications team.

The postholder will have the autonomy to shape and deliver communications locally, working closely with local leaders and drawing on the expertise and support of the European Communications team. The role calls for sound judgement, curiosity and a practical approach to strengthening employee understanding, engagement and reputation as EHC and ORS continue their journey within Serco.

Key purpose  

- Lead communications for EHC in Germany across internal and external channels, ensuring communications are accurate, relevant and appropriate for a sensitive public-service environment.
- Own internal communications for ORS in Switzerland, helping leaders keep employees informed, engaged and connected to local priorities and Serco’s wider direction.
- Act as a trusted communications adviser to the EHC and ORS leadership teams, providing clear, practical and well-judged counsel, including in complex, sensitive or fast-moving situations.
- Build strong networks across the local businesses and Serco Europe, connecting people, expertise and information so communications are coordinated and effective.
- Support the continued integration of EHC and ORS within Serco, respecting their local identities while embedding Serco’s communications standards, governance, channels and values.

Structure and reporting relationship 

The role reports to the Customer Relations (CR) & Operations Director Switzerland. The postholder is also a core member of the European Communications team and works closely with the Director of Communications, Marketing and Public Affairs Europe and European Communications colleagues on priorities, standards, governance and delivery. The role operates with a high degree of independence and works closely with EHC leadership in Germany and ORS leadership in Switzerland.  

Internal Communications

- Own and deliver the internal communications plans for EHC in Germany and ORS in Switzerland, including print and digital newsletters, leadership updates, employee announcements, change communications and internal campaigns, working closely with local leaders and the European Communications team.
- Draft and distribute newsletters; act as an internal correspondent to identify and write impactful stories.
- Lead employee engagement initiatives aligned with Serco’s values and business priorities.
- Develop and maintain content for internal platforms.  

External Communications

- Lead day-to-day media relations in Germany and preferably Switzerland, including media monitoring, handling enquiries, preparing spokespeople and coordinating responses with European Communications colleagues when required.
- Lead local issues management and crisis communications preparedness, providing calm, practical and well-judged advice to leaders in sensitive or difficult situations.
- Produce clear written and visual content for external channels, including social media, in line with European Communications standards and priorities.
- Manage the German-speaking  website of Immigration Europe and related external digital content for Germany and Switzerland, in line with European Communications standards and approvals.

Integration Communications

- Contribute to integration plans following recent acquisitions, ensuring employees and stakeholders are informed and engaged.
- Apply strong change communications judgement, identifying how different audiences may respond to change and adapting messages, channels and engagement approaches to their needs and sensitivities.

Social Media & Content Creation

- Collaborate with the European communications team to source, create, and promote content that showcases services, people, and impact.

Stakeholder Engagement

- Build and sustain trusted relationships across operations, HR, corporate functions and leadership teams, creating effective networks within EHC in Germany, ORS in Switzerland and the wider European business.
- Represent the European Communications function locally. Act as a trusted communications adviser to EHC leaders in Germany across the full communications remit and to ORS leaders in Switzerland on internal communications, constructively challenging proposed approaches where reputational, employee or stakeholder considerations require it.
- For German-speaking market, develop and maintain strong working relationships with relevant media, partners, public authorities and other external stakeholders, supported by accurate and well-maintained contact information and external specialist partners.

Essential technical and professional skills, knowledge, and qualifications 

- Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
- At least seven years’ relevant communications experience, including substantial responsibility for advising senior leaders, managing communications independently and delivering through influence in a complex, matrixed organisation.
- Proven experience across internal communications, external communications, media relations, change communications and employee engagement.
- Strong change management and change communications acumen, with the ability to understand audience sensitivities, anticipate resistance and translate complex change into clear, relevant communications.
- Excellent planning and organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise competing demands across two businesses and maintain consistent delivery.
- Demonstrable experience of working with journalists, handling media enquiries and advising spokespeople, with the judgement to manage sensitive or high-pressure situations.
- Strong digital communications capability, including confident use of Microsoft 365, SharePoint and content management tools.
- Ability to brief and manage specialist creative support when needed, ensuring outputs meet communications objectives and brand standards.
- Able to navigate a large, matrixed company while remaining pragmatic, visible and hands-on within smaller subsidiaries. Comfortable balancing accountability to a local operational leader with active membership of a European functional team, adapting style without compromising communications standards.
- Sound understanding of, or experience in, public services, immigration, social care, government or another sensitive, regulated operating environment.

Additional / special features of the role 

- Highly self-sufficient and dependable, with the judgement to set priorities, make sound decisions, escalate appropriately and maintain delivery without close supervision.
- Credible, politically aware and collaborative, with the interpersonal confidence to build networks, sustain trusted relationships and influence colleagues from operational teams to senior leadership.
- Inclusive and audience-focused, prepared to reach beyond familiar channels and proactively engage employees and stakeholders with different roles, backgrounds, levels of access and communications needs.
- Calm and resilient in demanding or ambiguous environments, able to handle sensitive issues, challenge constructively, protect confidentiality and maintain effective relationships during difficult situations.
- Tech-savvy and adaptable to new digital tools and platforms.
- Interested in the evolution of the immigration market in Europe, incl. the politicial impact on the business of the Sector Immigration Europe

Desirable

- Must: German native or fully proficient
- Must: English level B2
- Desirable: French
- Experience in regulated environments or public sector communications.

jobs.description:
AURELIUS is a global alternative investor, distinguished and widely recognised for its operational approach. It focuses on private markets, in particular Private Equity and Private Debt. AURELIUS is driven by a spirit of entrepreneurship, with a collegiate, hands-on approach to complex projects. We are motivated, open, fun, and operate as a team of equals.

Create impact with passion!

For an AURELIUS’ portfolio company located in Bavaria we are looking for a

Head of PMO / Chief of Projects (m/f/d)

As a Head of PMO you will lead and professionalize the end-to-end Project Management / Delivery function across the EMEA utilities business, spanning residential and industrial energy tech, software, and analytics solutions. You will own delivery from project definition through mass production and customer rollout, integrating Sales, Product Management, R&D, NPI, Procurement, and Quality into one disciplined execution engine. Furthermore, you will transform a currently fragmented, product- and site-centric delivery model into a standardized, cross-BU project delivery organization with clear stage gates, transparent KPIs, and predictable outcomes. The Head of PMO will act as the single accountable owner like a “project CEO” for on-time, on-quality, and on-cost delivery of projects and new product introductions, and as the primary interface to major customers for delivery commitments. Your task is to drive execution discipline, cost control, and margin protection across the full project lifecycle. The role requires frequent travel.

Responsibilities

1. Project Delivery Leadership & Organizational Ownership

- Lead and develop the EMEA Project Delivery organization across customer projects, NPI, and cross-BU solution programs
- Define and implement the organizational setup, governance model, and PM career path, including near-/offshore delivery capacity
- Build a balanced delivery organization combining hardware project management, software/solution delivery, and NPI program management
- Ensure scalability, agility, and clear accountability across all delivery units and sites

2. End-to-End Engineering Delivery

- Own end-to-end delivery from project definition through development, industrialization, mass production ramp, and customer handover
- Act as the single point of accountability for on-time, on-quality, on-cost execution of customer projects and NPIs
- Drive execution discipline, cost control, and scalable delivery models across multi-site and multi-BU programs
- Establish a common project lifecycle, stage-gate framework, and PMO standards applied consistently across electricity, gas, thermal, software, and analytics
- Ensure robust project planning, risk management, change control, and claim management on all major programs
- Chair stage-gate reviews and enforce go/no-go decisions against scope, schedule, cost, quality, and business case

3. Cross-BU Solution Delivery (HW + SW + Analytics)

- Lead delivery of integrated solutions combining residential and industrial meters, head-end software, and analytics offerings
- Break down BU silos and orchestrate cross-BU program teams around customer outcomes, not product lines
- Establish shared solution architectures and reusable delivery playbooks across product families
- Ensure consistent solution scoping, pricing input, and delivery commitments across the portfolio

4. NPI & Industrialization

- Collaborate with Operations on NPI program management from early involvement design, to design freeze through pilot, ramp, and stable serial production
- Ensure early and structured involvement of NPI, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Quality in R&D projects
- Drive design-for-manufacturing, design-for-cost, and design-for-serviceability discipline into every new program
- Manage ramp readiness: supply readiness, test coverage, production line qualification, and yield curves

5. Cross-functional Collaboration

- Act as the delivery counterpart to Product Management (portfolio & roadmap) and R&D (technology execution)
- Partner with Sales and Customer Projects to translate customer commitments into feasible, margin-protected delivery plans
- Provide delivery input into bids, contract negotiation, and commercial terms (milestones, LDs, acceptance criteria)
- Collaborate with Procurement and SCM to secure supply, lead times, and cost targets for project ramp
- Collaborate with Quality to embed quality gates and field-performance feedback into delivery governance

Our research aims to decipher the molecular mechanisms of tumor evolution, cellular plasticity, and therapy resistance in gastric and gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma (GEAC). By integrating longitudinal patient samples from prospective clinical trials with cutting-edge multi-omics technologies and functional model systems, our group is committed to understanding the biological mechanisms underlying treatment resistance in upper gastrointestinal cancers and translating these discoveries into novel therapeutic strategies.

The position offers the unique opportunity to work at the interface of clinical oncology, cancer genomics, computational biology, and functional cancer research within an outstanding translational research environment.

Your responsibilities:

You will investigate the molecular mechanisms of tumor evolution, cellular plasticity, and therapy resistance in GEAC through the integration of longitudinal multi-omics datasets from prospective clinical trial samples. 

Your research will focus on computational analysis and interpretation of large-scale molecular datasets, including:

- Analysis and integration of single-cell and spatial transcriptomic datasets to characterize tumor evolution and treatment response
- Inference of tissue-specific gene expression and tumor activity from plasma cell-free DNA fragmentation patterns
- Development of computational approaches for the integration of genomic, transcriptomic, epigenomic and immune profiling data
- Multi-omics integration to reconstruct tumor evolutionary trajectories and characterize cellular plasticity during treatment
- Development and implementation of bioinformatic pipelines for high-dimensional sequencing datasets
- Close collaboration with clinicians, biologists, computational biologists and international collaborators
- Presentation of research at international conferences and publication in high-impact scientific journals

Your profile:

We are seeking an ambitious computational scientist with a strong interest in translational cancer research and multi-omics data analysis.

Required qualifications

- PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Data Science, Biomedical Sciences, Cancer Genomics or a related quantitative discipline
- Strong experience in the analysis of next-generation sequencing data (e.g. transcriptomic and/or genomic datasets)
- Excellent programming skills in R and/or Python
- Experience working in Linux/Unix environments and using reproducible computational workflows
- Ability to independently design and drive scientific projects
- Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English

Preferred qualifications

Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:

- Cell-free DNA sequencing and fragmentation analysis (highly desirable)
- Single-cell RNA sequencing analysis and/or Spatial transcriptomics
- Multi-omics integration
- Machine learning or statistical modelling of biological datasets
- Cancer genomics and tumor evolution

We offer you:

- A postdoctoral position within a newly established and rapidly growing Max Eder Research Group funded by the German Cancer Aid
- An outstanding translational research environment embedded within TUM Klinikum rechts der Isar, one of Europe’s leading academic medical centers
- Close collaboration with internationally renowned research groups at the Institute of Cancer Research (ICR), Sutton, UK, and Chalmers University of Technology, Gothenburg, Sweden, including opportunities for scientific exchange and short-term research stays at both partner institutions.
- Direct integration with prospective clinical trials and longitudinal patient cohorts
- Close collaboration with physicians, computational biologists and internationally recognized research partners
- Strong mentorship and excellent opportunities for scientific independence and career development
- Support for national and international conference attendance
- Competitive salary according to TV-L
- EGYM Wellpass, corporate benefits, company pension scheme (VBL), cafeteria, sports and cultural offers
- Modern workplace in the heart of Munich with excellent public transport connections

We look forward to your application!

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) for Auxiliary Systems (Fluid Systems) of our Gas Turbines, Steam Turbines, and Generators, you will be supporting Siemens Energies growing Power Plant Project Business and be a part of our global Supply Chain network. You are responsible to secure the best performing supply base in quality, reliability, and safety and work closely with Procurement and Engineering functions in a multicultural environment. The suppliers in your scope will be the Mechanical Auxiliary Systems suppliers in Europe supplying for projects worldwide. Typical equipment in scope includes turbine air inlet, exhaust duct, expansion joint, enclosures, exhaust stack, heat exchangers, and other large, welded steel fabrications.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Supplier Monitoring: Perform supplier oversight and product inspections for regular project execution to ensure compliance with specification. Inspection types include visual, dimensional, weld, coating, pressure, traceability, quality records.
* Supplier Qualification and Development: Perform routine audits according to supplier risk categorization and audit program. Support supplier evaluation and commodity strategy definition. Implement supplier quality improvement programs or risk mitigation measures.
* Nonconformance Management: Identify and initiate containment on any identified non-conformances. Follow-up with corrective and preventive action as necessary.
* Digitalization & Process Excellence: Utilize the various Supplier Quality & Development tools and databases. E.g. to create process transparency or periodically generate supplier quality performance reports. Your ideas on how to evolve our corporate digitalization landscape, for example by leveraging agentic AI, are highly welcome.

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical, industrial engineering, or a similar discipline. Equivalent combination of education, training, and experience will be considered.
* Multiyear professional experience in supplier quality management, quality management, engineering or another related technical role in the Power Generation Industry or comparable industry related to the equipment scope mentioned above.
* Knowledge and experience in auditing. ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 Lead Auditor certification preferred.
* Knowledge in the application of quality methods such as 5 Why, FMEA, 8D, RCA.
* Familiarity with the following technologies & standards (or equivalents) are an advantage:
- Design of steel fabrications (AISC 360, EN 1090‑2, ASME VIII, B31.1, PED, API 661)
- Welding (AISC 360, AWS D1.1/ D1.2/ D1.6, ASME IX, ISO 3834, ISO 15614, ISO 5817, ISO 9606)
- Coating & surface preparation (SSPC, ISO 12944, ISO 8501, ISO 8502)
- Inspection methods (Visual Inspection, Penetrant Testing, Magnetic Particle, Ultrasonic Testing, Radiographic Testing)
- Material cleaning & preservation (ASTM A380M)
- Certifications in respective technology fields (NDT Level II or III, AMPP/ NACE CIP, FROSIO, AWS CWI/ SCWI, CSWIP 3.1/ 3.2, IWE, AWS CWEng)
* Willingness to travel as required for the role (approximately 35%) as well as strong communication skills in English.

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits

* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder

By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers and businesses to grow, discover, and create.

IntelliJ IDEA revolutionized the Java development tool market back in 2001, becoming the first IDE to offer automated code refactoring. It continues to drive innovation in software development, making thousands of programmers more productive every day. In addition to Java, IntelliJ IDEA includes various development tools for other prominent languages such as Ruby, Groovy, Scala, Python, JavaScript, Objective-C, PHP, and Kotlin.

About the team

The IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate team is responsible for supporting a wide range of enterprise frameworks, data-access stacks, and application servers in IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate. This includes technologies such as Spring (including Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security, and others), Jakarta EE, Quarkus, Micronaut, various reactive and data-access libraries, and popular application servers like Tomcat, WildFly, and Jetty. We ensure that developers can easily create, configure, run, debug, and observe their backend applications directly from the IDE. As part of the Ultimate QA group, you’ll work across different areas of the product – frameworks, HTTP client, persistence tooling, and application servers – and collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and other QA teams to deliver a smooth end-to-end experience for JVM backend developers.

We’re now looking for a QA Automation Engineer to join the IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate QA team and help ensure the quality of a product that our customers and software engineers around the world rely on daily. You’ll work alongside QA engineers to design and set up our automation process for end-to-end tests, as well as implement and automate test scenarios that catch issues before they reach our users.

What you’ll do

- Design, develop, and maintain multi-platform and environmental (Linux, Windows, macOS, Docker, WSL) automated test scenarios.
- Expand test coverage for new and existing functionality.
- Debug and troubleshoot test failures.
- Improve existing automation based on team feedback and reduce test flakiness.
- Track quality metrics, including testing coverage, failure rate, and flakiness.

- Help the team monitor test execution results and investigate failures.
- Participate in release quality assessments.
- Collaborate with QA and developers to define test strategies.
- Do manual QA activities when needed.

- Improve domain-specific test infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines within your team’s scope.
- Share automation best practices with the team.

- Proven experience in test automation.
- Solid programming skills in Kotlin/Java.

- Familiarity with build tools, like Maven and Gradle.

- Version control experience (Git).

- Act as a technical role model for less experienced developers by sharing knowledge, reviewing designs and code, and helping the team continuously improve engineering practices. 
- Help shape the next generation of planning capabilities, including AI-assisted planning experiences, Joule-based contextual assistance, embedded analytics, and modern SAP Fiori user experiences. 
 
What you bring:

- Technical Proficiency:

- Strong command of Linux environments and system administration.
- Proven experience with various software/hardware architectures and network protocols.
- Expertise in defining system requirements and creating architectural models (e.g., UML, SysML).
- Analytical Skills: Demonstrated ability to analyze complex technical problems and develop innovative, scalable solutions.

jobs.occupation: Working Student for Engineering - Transformation and Change Management (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Engineering department, Airbus Helicopters is looking for a

Working Student for Engineering - Transformation and Change Management (d/f/m)

You are a full time student (d/f/m), looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of an Engineering Change Manager (d//f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Engineering department as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Donauwörth
- Start: as soon as possible
- Duration: 24 months

Join us as a working student (d/f/m) in Engineering to actively support our transformation and change towards the Engineering of tomorrow. This role offers an exciting opportunity to support the top management and prepare our engineering for the future by implementing the latest design tools (incl. AI) in an international environment, contributing to the continuous improvement and evolution of our exciting products. In your job you will be able to bring in your creative solutions. You will be coached by experienced experts and top management of our company.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

At our Donauwörth site, located on the banks of the river Danube, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the airworthy product. Watch them take off and touch down on our own on-site test airfield.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation.
- Partial mobile working after agreement with the department.
- Traveling within Europe (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Assist in Transformation and Change projects for an international engineering function.
- Assist in the creation, preparation, documentation of workshops, events and roadshows for the leadership team and the engineering teams.
- Support the communication to the teams with creative formats (e.g. podcasts,...).
- Contribute to analyzing the effectiveness of the transformation initatives and identify gaps.
- Support the creation of inspiring presentations.
- Support in operative and administrative tasks.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled as a full-time student (d/f/m) in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering and Management, Work & Organizational Psychology, Human Resource, or a comparable degree program.
- Knowledge of—and ideally experience with—G Suite applications and Artificial Intelligence.
- Ideally, knowledge of and experience with Change Management.
- Strong interest in digital technologies and their application.
- Ability to work independently.
- Language skills: Fluent in English (written and spoken); German language skills are a strong advantage.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

#MYCYM

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

The Physical Security Specialist responsible for Data Center Security Operations will support managing and executing daily physical security operations at assigned data centers, ensuring alignment with established policies and procedures. They will support routine site inspections, audits, and physical security system checks to maintain operational readiness and security risk assessments of locations as required.

The Physical Security Specialist will coordinate the activities of contracted security personnel (guard force/maintenance vendors), including scheduling, compliance, and performance monitoring in cooperation with Area Data Center Security Operations Lead, Data Center Management, Data Center Services, Lines of Business and market units. They will support projects of the installation, maintenance, and status of electronic security systems, report technical issues to vendors or IT team as needed. They will assist in case of physical security incidents on-site, including reporting, escalation, and coordination with law enforcement or emergency responders.

The Physical Security Specialist will maintain the highest level of professionalism in all activities to represent the organization internally and externally, while serving as a trusted advisor and ambassador for SAP and affiliated companies.

jobs.description:
Standort: ERL S SP 9

Fachabteilung: SE GT SV PFS FS MR SG

Eingruppierung: Germany ERA-EG 5

Art der Anstellung: Full-Time / Permanent

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join our dedicated Customer Service specialists as they independently carry out maintenance and modernization measures for energy transmission networks at our international clients. You will engage in service activities involving high-voltage switchgear and components of energy transmission, both domestically and abroad, including onshore and some offshore projects. Our specialists receive qualification and certification through our in-house training center on product-related topics, as well as from external partners (e.g., TÜV). This ensures you become highly specialized while having access to extensive documentation and valuable know-how from our back office.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Serve as the primary on-site contact for service operations at our clients’ locations, both domestically and internationally.
* Execute maintenance, inspections, fault analyses, and troubleshooting independently and systematically.
* Conduct measurements to assess the condition of components and derive necessary maintenance actions.
* Create documentation for service operations, including service reports and site logs.
* Lead your own teams as a supervisor as you gain experience.

What You Bring

* A successfully completed vocational training in electrical engineering (e.g., as a Mechatronics Technician, Industrial Electrician, or Electronics Technician).
* Initial professional experience in service activities related to energy transmission components is desirable.
* High willingness to travel (approximately 90%) for short- and medium-term assignments both domestically and internationally.
* Comfort working at heights and on scaffolding.
* Strong reliability, independence, commitment, teamwork, and a customer-oriented mindset.
* Proficient in German and good command of English, both spoken and written, along with a valid driver’s license (Class B).

About the Team

With the increasing share of renewable energy, growing energy demand, outdated infrastructure, and rising complexity, new connections are needed. Additionally, existing networks require upgrades and renewals to support the energy transition.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With over 100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world’s electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character—no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme

We also offer the opportunity to become a shareholder of Siemens Energy 

We offer a wide range of options for balancing family and career, such as flexible working time models, childcare facilities at many locations, the option of trial part-time work or a sabbatical

The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche, you can be yourself and are valued for your uniqueness. Our corporate culture fosters personal development, open dialogue, and authentic connections. As a pioneer in healthcare, we know: Every minute counts. When a diagnostic system in a laboratory stands still, patients are waiting for vital results. You ensure that our systems run smoothly, thus contributing directly to securing the healthcare of tomorrow. Become part of Roche, where every voice matters.

Your new team:

You will be part of our EMEA Customer Support Center Hub here in Mannheim. We are a team of technical and application experts supporting customers in the RCSC countries (Germany, Austria, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Belgium, Greece, and Turkey). Cohesion and working in intercultural teams are important to us; we work closely networked, including with 2nd-level support and our colleagues in the field.

Responsibilities | What awaits you

As a Junior Specialist (m/f/d), you are the technical interface to our customers and colleagues. Your goal is to find fast and sustainable solutions for complex inquiries. Your main tasks include:
* As the central point of contact, you process customer and employee inquiries digital or by phone.
* You use remote services for customer support and, if necessary, simulate customer situations in our laboratory to quickly identify and resolve errors.
* You document your solution approaches structured in our CRM system and handle advanced complaint management for medium-complexity issues.
* You work closely with 2nd-level support and escalate product quality problems to the next competence level. Occasionally, you also support the technical field service during on-site activities.

Qualifications | What you bring

In addition to successfully completed training as a Medical Technical Assistant (MTA), Technician (e.g., Mechatronics, Medical Technology, Electrical Engineering), or a Bachelor's degree (e.g., Natural Sciences, IT, Chemical or Electrical Engineering), you have initial professional experience in the medical technology field – be it in customer support, service, marketing, or directly in a service function in a laboratory. Furthermore, the following points round out your profile:
* You speak fluent Dutch/Flemish and German (C1). You also communicate confidently in English (min. B1/B2).
* You have good user knowledge of medical analysis systems or, alternatively, know-how in robotics, mechanics, or electrical engineering. Basic IT network knowledge and familiarity with CRM tools are familiar to you.
* You are strongly customer-oriented, a real team player in intercultural teams, and possess pronounced methodical competence in troubleshooting.

Your Application 

We ask you for the following documents:

* Current CV

Further documents are not mandatory at this time. Please note before submitting your application that no further documents can be added afterward.

Apply now – we look forward to it!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.

Do you need further support?

Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working student (d/f/m) in Strategic Procurement

Are you a full-time student (d/f/m) looking for a working student position and would like to familiarise yourself with the work of strategic procurement? Then apply now! We would be delighted if you could support us in Strategic Aerostructure Procurement as a working student (d/f/m) for approx. 15 - 18 hours per week!

- Location: Manching
- Start: Immediately
- Duration: Approx. 12 months

Around 60% of the value of the Airbus Products comes from our external supply chain, composed from thousands of suppliers all over the world. The Procurement function is therefore a key contributor to the sustainable profitability and to the technical innovation of Airbus.

Definition working student
Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.
This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.
Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location
Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- Traveling overseas or within Germany (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

Support our Procurement team with projects in Strategic Purchasing

- During tendering e.g. by setting up Non-Disclosure Agreements, request and evaluate offers and preparation of selection reports.
- During the set-up & management of contractual agreements with suppliers.

Opportunity to develop project management skills

- Generate project plans and set up adequate reporting schemes.
- Analyses of relevant KPIs.
- Active risk management of the relevant procurement perimeter.

Collaboration with strategic buyers and internal customers.

- Support the definition and update of the commodity strategy with market research, data analysis and supplier operational and strategic excellence evaluation
- Planning and executing small improvement projects

Required knowledge and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in the field of business administration, engineering or economics.
- Confident handling of MS Office or Google Suite.
- First practical experience desirable.
- Business fluent in English, German desirable, all other additional languages are welcome.
- You are a team player, communicative and have an independent way of working.

Please upload the following documents in English or German: cover letter, CV, relevant certificates, certificate of enrolment.

Not a 100% match? No need to worry! Airbus supports your personal development.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

#MYCYM

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

As our Structural Engineer – Material Testing & Structural Validation, you'll play a key role in developing the lightweight structural systems that make GlassPoint's technology reliable, safe, and scalable.

Working closely with Structural, Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Operations teams, you'll combine advanced engineering analysis with hands-on testing to validate innovative designs and ensure they perform under real-world conditions. From small-scale material characterization to full-scale component testing, your work will directly influence the next generation of technology.
 

Your Impact

The structures you validate will become part of some of the world's largest industrial solar thermal plants, helping heavy industry reduce emissions while improving energy security.

You'll combine engineering theory with practical experimentation, transforming test results into optimized designs and helping GlassPoint continuously improve the performance, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of its technology.

What You'll Do

Design & Improve Structural Systems

- Analyze and optimize lightweight structural systems, components, and structural connections.
- Evaluate the behavior of steel, aluminum, composite materials, and ETFE film systems.
- Support the development of innovative structural concepts for industrial solar thermal applications.
- Transform engineering insights into scalable, manufacturable design improvements.

Lead Material & Component Testing

- Plan, build, execute, and evaluate material and component tests.
- Design and instrument full-scale structural testing.
- Conduct small-specimen material testing to characterize material behavior.
- Analyze test results and translate findings into engineering recommendations.

Develop & Validate Engineering Models

- Develop, calibrate, and improve nonlinear finite element (FEA) models.
- Predict structural behavior using numerical simulations.
- Validate simulation results through physical testing.
- Continuously refine engineering models to improve design accuracy.

Collaborate Across Engineering

- Work closely with Structural, Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Operations teams.
- Support design decisions through data-driven engineering.
- Contribute to solving complex structural challenges across international projects.
- Share technical expertise and help drive continuous innovation.

Who You Are

You're someone who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges and turning analysis into practical solutions.

You combine analytical thinking with a hands-on mindset and enjoy moving between simulations, laboratory testing, and real-world engineering. You're curious, collaborative, and motivated by seeing your work become part of technologies that make a global impact.

Ideally, you'll bring:

- A degree in Structural Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline (ideally with a background in construction, civil engineering, or automotive engineering).
- Several years of experience in structural, material, or component testing.
- Experience working with nonlinear material behavior and structural analysis.
- Strong experience with numerical modelling and nonlinear FEA.
- Hands-on experience planning and executing engineering tests.
- Familiarity with sensors, instrumentation, and measurement systems.
- A structured, analytical, and independent working style.
- Confidence working in an international engineering environment.
- Excellent English communication skills; German is an advantage.
- Experience with foundation systems for solar structures, soil testing, rammed piles, ground screws, or percussion drilling is a plus.
What You'll Find at GlassPoint

- Real ownership and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact from day one.
- Exceptional colleagues from diverse disciplines who challenge, support, and learn from each other.
- Complex challenges that require curiosity, collaboration, and innovation.
- An international team united by a shared purpose and ambitious goals.

- Location: Taufkirchen / Ottobrunn, near Munich

Your tasks and responsibilities, Scope of Master’s Thesis

6G / 5G is giving the convergence of terrestrial and satellite-based networks a major boost. Under the keyword "Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN)", satellites are being consistently integrated into the mobile communications standard for the first time, subsequently paving the way for a global and dense communication network in the future 6G generation.

Due to the inherent conditions of wireless communication – and particularly with the deployment of open standards and vast coverage areas – the threat posed by jammers and spoofers is ubiquitous. Specifically at the physical layer, the detection and suppression of malicious signals constitute an enormous challenge that must be overcome to ensure the integrity of the network.

The Master’s Thesis position will support the ongoing R&D activities on on-board implementation and scaling of a jamming robust gNodeB. The successful candidate shall contribute to one or more of the following fields:

- Sequence Analysis: Investigating the mathematical and statistical properties of different sequence designs in the context of NTN-specific channel conditions.
- Attack Modeling: Developing simulation models for various pilot-spoofing and jamming scenarios to evaluate their impact on signal integrity.
- Robustness Characterization: Analyzing how different sequence properties react to malicious interference through various performance metrics.
- Feature Identification: Identifying unique "signal signatures" or features that can be used to distinguish between legitimate and spoofed signals.
- Benchmark Development: Providing a comparative evaluation of sequence-based robustness to support the development of on-board detection algorithms.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled as a full-time student in Telecommunication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
- Strong foundation in Digital Signal Processing (DSP) and Communication Theory
- Proficiency in scripting and simulation using MATLAB or Python
- Basic understanding of OFDM waveforms
- Familiarity with communication standards (e.g., 3GPP, 6G/5G, or CCSDS) is a plus
- Excellent written and spoken English for technical documentation and communication; German is a plus.

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Mission Systems Equipment Design Responsible (d/f/m)

Your Mission

As Equipment Design Responsible, you will be the technical authority for airborne equipment throughout its entire lifecycle, for various weapon systems. You will transform operational and system-level needs into robust, certifiable equipment solutions, working closely with international suppliers and multidisciplinary engineering teams. You will ensure that equipment designs meet demanding performance, qualification, and certification requirements while supporting integration, testing and in-service operations. This role offers a unique combination of design responsibility, technical depth and direct influence on the successful delivery of advanced airborne capabilities.

Your location (Manching)

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and special payments
- 30 days holidays and extra days-off for special occasions
- Excellent upskilling opportunities and great international, group wide development prospects
- Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, subsidies for public transport, employee benefits at cooperating companies
- On-site-facilities: Medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteen and cafeterias, kindergarten close to the site
- Compatibility of family & work (part-time models, flexible working hours, individual timeout)
- Networking and connection: Employee events, groups and initiatives
- Working in a diverse environment, with more than 140 nationalities, where every voice is heard

Your Tasks and Responsibilities

- Own the technical responsibility of airborne mission systems equipment throughout the full development lifecycle, including in-service support activities.
- Preparation and validation of Equipment technical specification and other contractual documents. Managing equipment requirements from higher-level system architecture and customer specifications down to equipment-level allocation.
- Technical management of suppliers of airborne equipment: technical evaluation, design and qualification follow up, milestones management, stages of involvement, validation and acceptance of deliverables, management of limitations and deviations, support to defect investigations and repairs, harmonization and control of supplier and program plans.
- Review technical solutions, challenge design decisions when necessary, and support issue resolution during development and integration phases.
- Ensure compliance with applicable aeronautical and contractual standards and certification requirements (e.g. DO-254) during the design and qualification, repair, obsolescence and re-design activities.
- Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering activities with internal specialists (safety, EMC, environmental qualification, RM&T, Quality, ILS, Airworthiness,…).
- Interface with customers, partner companies and certification authorities for technical matters related to equipment functionalities, design, qualification and problem resolution.
- Monitoring and support of the subsequent Equipment Integration including Sub-system, system verification and flight tests.
- Support requests concerning Equipment queries, in service occurrence reports and defect investigations.

Your Profile:

- (Master) Degree in electronics/electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, or equivalent
- At least 3-5 years of professional experience
- Strong technical background in electronic equipment development: embedded electronics (Microcontrollers, FPGAs, ASICs,... ), mission computers, high-speed digital interfaces, video or data processing systems, real-time embedded architecture,...
- Knowledge and practical expertise with airborne equipment:
- Qualification and certification
- Hardware development/design and verification (e.g. DO-254, ARP4754A, AMC 20-152A, DO-160, MIL-STD-810)
- Software development (DO-178) is considered a plus
- Ability to technically assess supplier solutions and support problem-solving activities during development
- Experience in technical supplier management is a plus
- Experience in requirements engineering and requirements management tools (DOORs) is a plus
- Comfortable taking ownership and making technical decisions
- Strong communication skills and ability to interact with suppliers, customers and authorities in an international environment
- Teamplayer and comfortable in international and multidisciplinary engineering environment: demonstrated skills to work independently and in a collaboratively manner within an international team, including the ability to coordinate and influence people
- Business-fluent English, German is a plus
- Willingness to travel internationally to supplier facilities and customer sites when required

jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

 

As a Data Governance Specialist with a focus on Data Governance Audit and Assurance, you are part of our growing Data Governance team within our Digital Core function, where we work together on supporting the wider needs and demands from the business, transforming the way we think of data and embedding data management in our key deliveries across all areas of the energy industry. In this fast-paced environment, you will assist your team in the formation and execution of the data governance framework, policy, standards; with particular focus on designing and implementing a modern data governance audit and assurance framework with controls, tools, enablers, and collaboration mechanisms to monitor and assess the data maturity of Siemens Energy domains and support continuous improvement. This role will also contribute to data governance enablement activities to make data accountability real; in this manner you will contribute to the execution of data governance framework, policy, standards. As a valued member of the Data Governance team, you will assist in the operationalisation of our enterprise data governance efforts to truly bring data governance alive at Siemens Energy.

 

 

How You’ll Make an Impact
* Design and implement a modern data governance audit and assurance framework with controls, tools, enablers and collaboration mechanisms to monitor and assess the data maturity of Siemens Energy domains and support continuous improvement
* Automate this framework making it user friendly so that it can be understood by our stakeholders and embraced into execution; leveraging our Data Governance tools, such as Data Catalog and Data Quality, and building upon our SE data governance processes  
* Communicate data governance concepts effectively and facilitate training to enable and operationalize the data management roles in the organization 
* Design, deliver and execute (baseline) data maturity assessments, along with other data governance controls or mechanisms, ensuring ongoing monitoring, alignment with targets (where applicable) and remediation actions  
* Create and refine policies, procedures, and guidelines to mature the concept of data governance and the practices around data management across Siemens Energy; and align them where applicable to the audit and assurance framework. 
* Engage with data stakeholders through the Data Governance forums and regular touch-points to formalize decisions and plans on data governance audit and assurance practices. including data maturity review cycles, gain their buy-in and follow-up on tracking and reporting of maturity improvements and targets
* Support the development and maintenance of an end-to-end data lifecycle management approach; leverage the Data Management Enterprise Process and Data FAIR process and make sure our framework for data governance audit and assurance builds upon the enterprise data management practices 
* Collaborate with the wider Data Governance team, Digital Core and the business; for the framework to be a successful collaboration endorsed and adopted by all; reinforcing the team efforts on establishing commons ways of working, adoption of the data governance metamodel, production of reusable governed data products and availability of AI-ready data

What You Bring
* University degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Information Technologies or a related field. Experience with the Collibra Data Intelligence Platform, Informatica Data Catalog, Collibra Data Quality and Observability platform or similar products. 
* Extensive proven experience in embedding Data Governance and Data Management in a large organization (preferably), particularly in designing, planning and executing audit and assurance controls in complex environments; therefore, guiding the business through the process, supporting them with recommendations and enabling them to act upon the findings. 
* Specialist in designing and implementing Data Governance; has experience or very good understanding of Master and Reference Data Management, Data Quality Management, Metadata Management, Enterprise Data architecture and Data security practices. 
* Proven facilitation skills to drive progress and resolve issues within large data governance programs, with expert understanding of existing data management frameworks, tools and best practices and ability to pragmatically apply these 
* Strong communication and change management skills: able to explain technical concepts to business colleagues in plain language and naturally incorporate change management activities in the rollout of any data governance capability. Fluent in both written and spoken English 
* Growth mindset: flexible to multiple, sometimes competing, demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change You are motivated to contribute to the transformation and decarbonization of energy generation globally

About the Team 

The Digital Core organization was created to streamline the lifecycle of software, data, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence solutions for Siemens Energy.  Within Digital Core, our Data Governance team is a center of excellence that enables the organization to discover, access and use harmonized, high quality data in service of the Siemen’s Energy mission. We partner with the business to support them as they build strong foundations using policy, process and technology provided by our team. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.00 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
