jobs.occupation: Principal Product Application Engineer (m/f/d) - SiC (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
About the role

As a Principal Product Application Engineer (m/f/d), you will work on developing and validating advanced SiC-based solutions, turning cutting-edge semiconductor technology into real-world applications. You will collaborate with global teams, support customers, and help drive new products to market, combining hands-on engineering with strong application insight.

What you will do

- Design power electronics platforms using SiC technologies
- Run and analyze testing and validation of power systems
- Build demo systems and present solutions to customers
- Support product go-to-market and customer design-in activities
- Create and deliver technical presentations, training, and webinars
- Help shape next-generation semiconductor performance through application insights
- Support device testing, characterization, and modelling
- Collaborate with internal teams, partners, and universities
- Work in a global, multicultural team

What you will bring

- M.Sc. Degree or higher in Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or similar
- 5+ years in the semiconductor industry (power applications focus; WBG preferred)
- Strong experience in hardware design for SiC, GaN, and IGBT applications
- Knowledge of thermal/mechanical design, gate driving, and inductance optimization
- Skilled in measurements, testing, and high-voltage lab environments
- Solid experience with PCB design, simulation, and power module design
- Able to connect device physics, converter design, and customer needs
- Good communication skills; fluent in English (German is a plus)
- Hands-on approach and willingness to travel occasionally

jobs.occupation: (Sr.) Product Manager (m/f/d) – ESD Protection & Filtering (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
About the job

As a Product Manager, you will own and drive the success of a defined product portfolio, combining strategic thinking with strong market and customer focus. Positioned between Regional Marketing and Product Group Leadership, you will translate market insights, customer needs, and business strategy into actionable product decisions. You will work closely with cross-functional teams - including R&D, Marketing, Sales, and Operations - to ensure that products are competitively positioned, financially successful, and aligned with long-term portfolio objectives.

What you will do

- Portfolio owner for automotive ESD/TVS and PowerTVS within the Product Group Protection & Filtering
- Define and execute product strategies across the full product lifecycle (from ideation to end-of-life) while monitoring product performance and support delivery of revenue and profitability targets
- Analyze markets, applications, customer needs, and competitors to identify growth opportunities
- Develop and maintain product roadmaps aligned with portfolio and business goals
- Build, evaluate, and drive business cases for new product opportunities including business case fulfillment
- Collaborate with R&D, Marketing, Sales, and Operations to ensure aligned execution
- Support New Product Introduction (NPI) with clear value propositions and go-to-market plans
- Drive product positioning, pricing, and portfolio optimization
- Contribute to marketing content and product communication materials

What you will need

- Minimum master’s degree in industrial engineering, electrical engineering or semiconductor device physics
- Minimum 5 years of experience in product management, product marketing, sales or business development (ideally in semiconductor or high-tech domain)
- Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills
- Ability to translate technical and market insights into actionable strategies
- Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder (internal/external) management skills
- Experience working in cross-functional and international teams
- Entrepreneurial mindset with strong customer and value focus
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
- Willingness to travel (low frequency)
- Fluent English (additional languages are a plus)

This is your new job

- Work closely with the business team on finance planning & budgeting data preparation & consolidation and conduct regular reviews together with relevant business stakeholders
- Financial process tasks support, incl. Month-End-Closing (MEC), Quarter-End-Closing (QEC) and Year-End-Closing (YEC)
- Financial controlling reporting, incl. forecast planning report, quarterly finance rolling forecast reporting, monthly/quarterly forecast vs. actual variance detailed analysis & reporting on findings
- Collaborate closely with key business stakeholders across Business Groups (BGs), managing R&D project budget and cost tracking, and supporting new project ROI analysis and fulfilment reviews
- Conduct business case validation with project, marketing, and controlling teams, including data-driven comparisons, IRR analysis, investment risk assessment, and presenting insights and recommendations to the management team.
- Support long-term strategic planning, including participation in business strategy discussions and finance data consolidation/reporting
- Support BG key projects in in-house CAPEX investment ROI evaluation, as well as fixed asset management, including budget control, cost tracking, and reporting
- Support Finance projects, particularly cross-BG standardization, reporting automation projects, government subsidy application support (including business case evaluation), and BG internal control process utilization projects.
- Assist with daily finance operations and other ad-hoc finance tasks

This is you

- University degree in Finance, Accounting or Economics, preferably with Accounting/Financial Management Major.
- Min 5 years of relevant working experience in an Accounting or Corporate Finance position in an international corporate environment.
- Experience in a Multinational Company within the semiconductor or related industry is highly preferred
- Fast learner, willing to take challenges and could handle pressure and complete work in timeline
- Skilled in Office tools, PowerPoint, SAP or other ERP platform experience, good excel/data analysis skill is preferred
- Strong communication skills and a collaborative team spirit, particularly in cross-functional and cross-regional environments
- Fluency in English is a must (written and spoken)
- Openness to occasional business travel (10%)

Job Description

About the job

As Business Product Manager you will maximize revenue and profitability of an existing family or families of products within a Product Group’s portfolio. You own the Pricing and Go to Market (G2M) strategy for running portfolios.

The role requires profound knowledge and experience in pricing strategies, channel management and negotiation. Furthermore, a strong ability to manage a complex network of internal and external stakeholders, including customers is required.

What you will do

- Drive revenue and profitability of the assigned product segment by being hungry and willing to win in a challenging and dynamic business environment
- Be the business partner for Business Group (BG) Marketing and Global Sales & Marketing (GSM) in the assigned product portfolio (manufacturing strategy, benefits, longevity etc.)
- Develop key customer & channel strategies together with Product Group Head, Business Marketing Managers, Product Marketing Managers and GSM
- Own the pricing tactics and quote policies for all sales channels for Commercial Marketing in alignment with Product Marketing Managers, Business Marketing Managers and in line with overall Product Group target settings
- Build & maintain G2M material
- Competitor analysis: consolidate input from regions about competitor behaviors, especially pricing strategy at Distribution and OEM channel, inputting (to Industrial) for required cost down roadmaps to reach Product Group margin targets
- Forecasting: align with Demand Management in line with forecast process
- Manage pricing strategy, price setting and special offers for business via Distribution partners
- Drive design-in/design-win success through organizing necessary support to BG Marketing and GSM
- Establish and maintain relationships with key customers and partners in alignment with BG Marketing and GSM.

What you will need

- University degree in electrical and electronic engineering or other related discipline
- Min. 5 years’ experience in Product Marketing or Product Management in the Semiconductor industry
- Proven track record of product (lifecycle) management, with strong understanding of market trends and customer needs, preferably with exposure to international customers
- Strong individual accountability, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
- Ability to establish lasting relationships and networks in a complex environment across different levels of hierarchies and various stakeholders in a multiple culture environment
- Direct work experience with Power semiconductors or previous experience in product line is preferred
- Knowledge of key business metrics and strong negotiation skills
- Business fluent in English (written and spoken), any other language is a plus
- Willingness to travel occasionally

jobs.occupation: Head of T&O Controlling (m/f/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule) - Rechnungswesen und Controlling)
jobs.description:
About the role

As Head of T&O Controlling, you will lead a global team of finance professionals and be responsible for all financial planning, reporting, forecasting, and governance activities across the T&O organization. Acting as a trusted business partner to the COO, CFO, and senior leadership team, you will provide strategic financial insights, drive investment and performance decisions, and ensure robust controls, compliance, and operational excellence across all T&O sites.

This is your new role

- Lead and develop the Global T&O Controlling team (40+FTEs), including performance management, coaching, and capability building.
- Own the delivery of central T&O financial reporting, ensuring timely, accurate and consistent reporting across all T&O Sites.
- Provide executive‑level financial insights, turning data into clear narratives and recommendations for the COO, CFO, and senior leadership.
- Own execution of the T&O planning calendar and governance, driving consistency, accuracy, and alignment across all financial cycles (Budget, RFF, Strategic Plan).
- Lead financial analysis and support strategic projects. Ensuring business cases assess opportunities available across different scenarios and drive effective decision making within the project teams.
- Drive the CAPEX process, ensuring effective and efficient processes and procedures in place to support the business making the right investment decisions, and projects are held accountable for post investment performance.
- Ensure accurate forecasting of Capex and Opex commitments for business planning.
- Ensure effective business controls and standardized processes are in place to cover all T&O cycles, drive compliance with Nexperia SOPs and ensure controls are robust, effective and efficient.
- Serve as a key member of the T&O management team, supporting the COO and Management Team drive improvements in all areas of T&O performance.

This is you

- University degree in Finance, Accounting, Controlling, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field
- Professional qualifications as an MBA, CPA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent are an advantage
- Minimum 8 years of progressive experience in Finance and related Business processes such as Manufacturing, Supply Chain Management etc.
- Proven track record of leading and developing high-performing global teams, driving performance management, talent development, and organizational capability building
- Excellent understanding of financial controls, governance frameworks, compliance requirements, and process standardization, ensuring robust and efficient operating practices across global organizations
- Proven stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships at executive level, challenge constructively, drive change, and support strategic decision-making in a fast-paced environment
- Fluent English communication skills (written and spoken) are essential, with the ability to present complex financial information clearly and confidently to international senior stakeholders; additional languages are considered a plus

As a (Senior) Process Development Engineer (m/f/d), you will play a key role in advancing competitive silicon-based discrete power technologies, driving innovation from process development to industrial manufacturing.

Working in a cross-functional environment with product, production and quality engineering teams, you will develop and industrialize robust wafer fabrication processes that enable cost-efficient, scalable and high-performance semiconductor products.

You will act as a process architect within development projects, translating product requirements into manufacturable process concepts and ensuring successful transfer into stable, automotive-qualified production.

This is your new job

- Define and integrate robust, scalable wafer fabrication flows by combining and optimizing unit processes
- Own and drive end-to-end process development from concept to stable high-volume manufacturing within cross-functional projects
- Ensure manufacturability and industrial readiness, including alignment with production, quality and automotive qualification requirements
- Optimize and balance process performance (yield, cost, quality, robustness) to meet competitive product and manufacturing targets
- Act as key technical interface between development and production, driving cross-functional alignment and sustainable solutions
- Benchmark competitor technologies and derive actionable insights for technology development
- Build and leverage expert networks to support technology development and continuously deepen process know-how

This is you

- Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics or a related field
- Several years of relevant experience in semiconductor process development are preferred
- Solid understanding of semiconductor devices and industrial wafer fabrication processes, preferably for discrete power devices
- Hands-on experience in wafer processing and related equipment
- Strong analytical skills and ability to solve complex technical problems in a structured and result-oriented way
- Ability to work effectively in cross-functional and international teams
- Strong sense of ownership and accountability for technical outcomes
- Good organizational and planning skills with a structured working style
- Fluent in English and German, both written and spoken

About the role

As a Procurement Specialist within Nexperia’s Global Procurement organisation, you will lead the Equipment Parts & Services (EPS) category for our Hamburg and Manchester manufacturing sites. This is a high‑impact role managing a diverse, global supplier base, ranging from daily‑touch strategic partners to niche suppliers engaged once every few years.

You will directly own and manage relationships around 100 key suppliers at an average annual spend of around $40m. You will also act as a primary commercial interface for up to 500 suppliers across all equipment parts and services for both manufacturing sites. The work is varied, fast‑paced, and strategically significant no two weeks look the same.

This role offers a great chance to develop your Procurement skillset within a fast paced, high tech global company with occasional international travel for collaboration purposes.

Key Responsibilities include

- Sourcing Strategy Leadership  - Drive and lead sourcing strategies that deliver competitive cost structures and long‑term value for EPS categories
- Stakeholder Collaboration -  Shape requirements with engineering, operations, and site teams, providing commercial insight and value‑creation opportunities
- Market & Spend Analysis -  Conduct market research, analyse spend categories, and apply insights to negotiation and sourcing strategies
- Global Negotiation Leadership - Lead complex commercial negotiations with cross‑functional, international teams; develop negotiation plans for high‑value global projects
- Supplier Performance Management - Manage supplier performance across quality, cost, delivery, technology, and service to maintain a best‑in‑class supply base
- Contract Ownership - Draft, negotiate, and manage supplier contracts to secure optimal terms and mitigate commercial risk
- Project Delivery -  Lead global sourcing projects, including scope creation, negotiation planning, and delivery of measurable results
- Operational Excellence-  Drive adoption of procurement tools, processes, and continuous improvement initiatives across EPS activities

This is you

Essential requirements:

- Bachelor’s degree level education or equivalent experience
- 3+ years of procurement experience in a manufacturing or engineering environment
- Experience of participation or leading cross site commodity and international procurement projects
- Strong Negotiation and Analytical Skills
- Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
- Team player and a hands-on worker
- Ability to prioritize and work on multiple activities at one time
- Ability to work independently and with autonomy
- SAP, Ariba, MS Excel, PowerPoint presentation and data analytical skills
- Strong teamwork and collaboration skills on an international level

The Nexperia European Purchasing team is seeking a driven and dedicated Procurement Specialist with a focus on Direct materials (Specialist chemicals and gases) used during the manufacturing process for sites based in the UK and Germany. This position will provide you with the opportunity to work with varying stakeholders in the Production, Engineering, Environmental and Quality teams across both sites whilst building effective relationships with global suppliers.

What you will do:

As a Procurement Specialist for Direct manufacturing materials, you will work on a Hybrid basis at one of our front-end manufacturing sites in either Manchester UK or Hamburg Germany. This position plays a critical role in ensuring that procurement processes, controls and supplier management activities operate effectively and efficiently. You will support both local and global sourcing initiatives, driving cost optimisation, supplier performance and overall strategic procurement execution. Being part of a global company, you will also get the chance to support Global Sourcing Managers in the implementation of commodity sourcing strategies on site, enhancing your development pathways at Nexperia.

Key Responsibilities Include:

Sourcing & Supplier Management

- Identify, assess, and onboard suppliers to support operational and development needs.
- Support Global Sourcing Managers with the negotiation and procurement of BOM materials, including metal commodities, and ensure effective implementation of POs, consignment, and contracts.
- Manage supplier performance across quality, cost, delivery, technology, and service to maintain a high‑performing, competitive supply base.
- Ensure continuous supply is maintained into the Sites

Strategic Procurement & Market Insight

- Contribute to the execution of commodity sourcing strategies at site level, ensuring alignment with global procurement objectives.
- Conduct market research and analyse spend categories to inform negotiation strategies and drive value creation.
- Provide commercial insights to stakeholders, ensuring requirements are met while maintaining a competitive sourcing environment.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration & Project Delivery

- Partner with Supply Chain, Engineering, and Production teams to deliver annual cost‑reduction and sourcing project targets.
- Support project management activities, including supplier onboarding, qualification sample coordination, and new development communication.
- Ensure effective alignment between suppliers and internal teams to support operational and development programmes.

Process Ownership & Continuous Improvement

- Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of efficient end‑to‑end procurement processes and strong internal controls.
- Benchmark procurement practices against industry leaders and drive strategic initiatives to achieve operational excellence.

What you will need

**Essential requirements:**

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Procurement, Supply Chain, or a related field
- Minimum 3 years’ procurement experience in a manufacturing or engineering environment with direct materials
- Strong negotiation, stakeholder management, and relationship‑building skills
- Confident analysing and presenting numerical data, with strong problem‑solving ability
- Effective communicator with excellent English skills and the ability to collaborate across countries and time zones
- Skilled in SAP, Excel, PowerPoint, and data analysis tools
- Able to prioritise, adapt quickly, and work with urgency in a fast‑paced environment
- Experience in process improvement, change management, and driving cross‑functional collaboration.

Desirable experience:

“The Martian Mindset - A scarcity-driven engineering paradigm” is a newly funded Cluster of Excellence and was established at the University of Bremen in 2026. In this context, a position is available as soon as possible, as a

Part-time work is generally possible and to be agreed with the respective project leaders.

The workplace and employment will be at the University of Bremen, Center of Applied Space Technology and Microgravity (ZARM) in the research group of Prof. Dr. Marc Avila. The University as an Employer:

With approximately 20,000 students and about 3,500 employees, the University of Bremen is a medium-sized university. It ranks among Germany’s leading universities in terms of external funding and research.

The Martian Mindset:

Our scientists are developing the “Martian Mindset” in order to rethink the production of materials and components from scratch. The scarcity of resources and extreme conditions on the red planet serve as a setting to develop a new paradigm of sustainability that will lay the foundations for a fossil-fuel-free production of materials and parts from scarce resources in a highly automated and resilient way. The Cluster of Excellence will thus contribute to the sustainable human exploration of space and power a green transition on Earth.

The challenging and interdisciplinary research in “The Martian Mindset” spans ten multifaceted foci across three areas, whereas this position is to be filled within the Research Area 1, Sourcing:

In this research area, we investigate how to produce high-added-value materials and chemicals from low-grade ores using atmospheric gases as the only source of carbon and nitrogen and without burning fossil fuels. The focus of this position falls under modelling and simulation of multiphase flows electrolysis systems.

This project aims at developing numerical models that faithfully describe the generation, detachment and interaction of bubbles in electrolytes. The initial focus is on the generation of oxygen in water electrolysis under terrestrial and Mars conditions, but the models developed will offer a robust framework extendable to molten salt electrolysis.

The gas dynamics in electrochemical cells spans multiple scales in space, from (sub)nanometer to cell size (mm), and similarly for time, which cannot be all resolved simultaneously. Accordingly, multiscale, multiphase models will be developed that parametrize the effect of the unresolved (small) scales. Results from other projects in the Cluster that focus on the nano and micro scales will be leveraged to inform parametrizations and/or train the models with machine-learning techniques. A central focus is the quantification of uncertainty in the multi-scale approach. The resulting model predictions will directly inform reactor design and optimization in collaboration with experimental groups in the Cluster.

This project enhances the “Martian Mindset” scarcity-driven engineering paradigm by paving the way for the accurate, robust design of electrochemical technologies on Earth and in space conditions.

More information on the other research foci, the project leaders and the Cluster of Excellence itself can be found on our website: www.mars.uni-bremen.de.

As a researcher in The Martian Mindset, working at one of the five participating institutions on the campus of the University of Bremen, you will join a vibrant and dynamic scientific community of internationally renowned researchers. You will be involved in innovative and challenging scientific projects and contribute to the advancement of the respective research field.

Your key tasks will include in particular:

• Develop mathematical multiscale, multiphase models of the gas dynamics in electrochemical cells

• Implement these models using python and CUDA based on our in-house codes

• Parametrize and train the models leveraging nano- and microscopic data from other numerical and in the Cluster

• Validate results with experiments performed in other projects in the Cluster

• Investigate the dependence of the gas dynamics on the parameters of the system (electrode material and surface roughness, potential, concentration of the electrolyte, etc.)

Requirements

We are looking for dynamic and open-minded personalities who enjoy conducting cutting-edge research in an interdisciplinary, international and diverse team. To succeed in this role, you should

• old a master’s degree in a relevant field such as Applied Mathematics, Physics, Aerospace/Mechanical/Chemical/Process Engineering or a related discipline.

A willing to engage in interdisciplinary work and collaborate with colleagues from different fields of expertise is expected.

The university will determine the individual pay grade assignment based on relevant prior professional experience upon an offer of employment. Additional benefits, such as the annual bonus (“Christmas bonus”) and any career advancement opportunities within the advertised pay grade, are also dependent on this assignment. This is based on the applicable legal provisions of the TV-L (specifically § 16 TV-L). For civil servants, remuneration is governed in particular by the provisions of the Bremen Civil Service Remuneration Act (further information can be found here).

Qualification concept

Together we will create an exceptional environment for research, education and innovation, where the Martian Mindset can flourish. jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

United As One for Patients, our purpose in Healthcare is to help create, improve and prolong lives. We develop medicines, intelligent devices and innovative technologies in therapeutic areas such as Oncology, Neurology and Fertility. Our teams work together across 6 continents with passion and relentless curiosity in order to help patients at every stage of life. Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe.

This position can be filled either in Switzerland (Eysins) or Germany (Darmstadt) in a hybrid format.

Your role

Real-world evidence is reshaping how medicines are developed, approved, and valued — and in this role, you will be at the forefront of that transformation. As a Director Real-World Evidence Scientist in Oncology, you will own and drive the end-to-end RWE strategy for one or more complex, high-priority oncology programs, operating as a recognized scientific authority across the organization and beyond.

You will define and lead the integration of RWE into clinical development and regulatory strategies, working directly with global program teams and cross-functional partners across clinical, regulatory, market access, and commercial functions. You will design, initiate, and oversee non-interventional studies — from protocol development through to study reporting — and ensure the selection of fit-for-purpose real-world data sources that address critical research questions. Your scientific judgment will directly inform decision-making at the most senior levels of the organization.

Beyond program delivery, you will represent the organization in interactions with health authorities, contribute to peer-reviewed publications, and present at international conferences — actively shaping the external scientific landscape. You will also champion methodological innovation, drive process improvements, and serve as a scientific mentor to colleagues within the function, contributing to a culture of rigor, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Who you are

- You hold a Master’s degree or PhD in Epidemiology, Public Health, Health Economics and Outcomes Research, Biostatistics, or a related discipline, and bring 8 or more years of RWE experience gained in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or contract research organization setting.
- You have deep expertise in studies based on secondary data use — including claims data, electronic medical records, and registries — across multiple healthcare environments (Europe, US, and/or Asia), as well as experience in primary data collection.
- You are proficient in working with federated data networks and familiar with data standards such as OMOP CDM or FHIR, and bring strong methodological skills spanning epidemiology, pharmacology, and pharmacovigilance.
- You have a proven track record of leading RWE strategy at a global program level, navigating complex, matrixed organizations and collaborating effectively across clinical development, regulatory affairs, and market access functions.
- You bring experience in regulatory and/or payer submissions and interactions, and a thorough understanding of the evolving regulatory environment for RWE.
- You communicate with clarity and confidence — translating complex scientific content for diverse audiences, including senior leadership and external stakeholders — and you are fluent in English.
- Ideally, you also bring experience with AI/ML applications in RWE (including NLP), patient-reported outcomes (PRO), health technology assessment, and a track record of thought leadership through publications, conference presentations, or advisory roles.

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d) to characterize young star-planet systems and their flaring activity (Astrophysiker/in, Astronom/in)
jobs.description:
The Max Planck Institute for Solar System Research (MPS) in Göttingen is one of the world's leading research institutions in the field of solar physics and planetary research with around 300 employees. The interdisciplinary research focus is the investigation of the development, diversity and dynamics of planets, moons, small bodies, the sun and solar-like stars. The MPS develops and operates scientific instruments for current and future space missions (e.g. ESA, NASA), and carries out cosmochemical laboratory investigations of meteorites as well as numerical modeling on state-of-the-art supercomputers.

The Department Solar & Stellar Interiors at MPS invites applications for the position of a

Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d) to characterize young star-planet systems and their flaring activity

In recent years, exoplanetary science has undergone a major shift -- moving from exoplanet detection towards understanding star-planet systems as a whole, including the host star, interplanetary medium and galactic context. Specifically, tidal and magnetic interactions between planets and their host stars have been recognized to be able to modulate the evolution of both, including the atmospheric evolution of the planet and its habitability. The newly established ERC StG project PLANETARE seeks a postdoctoral researcher with a background in stellar magnetism and/or exoplanetary science to develop novel ways of detecting and characterizing the mutual influence of stars and planets with a focus on the influence of planets in short orbits on the magnetism of their host stars. At the core of the project is a new way to find exoplanets: detecting them through their magnetic interaction with the host star. This position builds the observational foundation - the sample, the activity catalog, and the geometry of the systems - and confirms any transiting planets among the interacting systems.

Your Tasks

- Compile the most accurate and complete flaring activity catalog to date using space-borne photometry
- Search the sample of flaring stars for transiting planet candidates using space-borne photometry
- Constrain the orientation of the rotational and magnetic axes of interacting systems
- Measure stellar activity characteristics and their predictive power for interaction

The transit search, flaring catalog and geometry measurements will constrain some of the drivers of interaction and its observability, working towards a true occurrence rate of magnetic interaction in young star-planet systems. You will work closely with a second postdoc (https://karriere.mps.mpg.de/jobposting/ff58b9b82b6efc0b224bf8134f1471929fdc639c0) within a small, newly formed team of two postdocs and a PhD student, led by the PI (Ekaterina Ilin). Group members are supported to lead their own papers and proposals, and to present at international meetings in both the stellar and exoplanet communities.

Your Qualification

- A PhD in physics or astrophysics (PhD must be awarded by the start date)
- Previous experience in observational astronomy, ideally including space-borne optical photometry
- The ability to work in a team
- A good command of the English language

Our Offer

- Comprehensive onboarding, professional development and further training opportunities
- Diverse and varied tasks in an international work environment
- Renumeration according to TVöDBund, based on qualifications and experience, annual bonus and additional pension scheme (VBL)
- 30 days of vacation plus 4 additional days off
- Full-time and part-time employment; flexible working time and possibility of mobile work
- Cooperation with local bilingual Montessori child care center
- Good connection by public transport
- Corporate health management

Additional Information

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d) to detect exoplanets through magnetic star-planet interaction (Astrophysiker/in, Astronom/in)
jobs.description:
The Max Planck Institute for Solar System Research (MPS) in Göttingen is one of the world's leading research institutions in the field of solar physics and planetary research with around 300 employees. The interdisciplinary research focus is the investigation of the development, diversity and dynamics of planets, moons, small bodies, the sun and solar-like stars. The MPS develops and operates scientific instruments for current and future space missions (e.g. ESA, NASA), and carries out cosmochemical laboratory investigations of meteorites as well as numerical modeling on state-of-the-art supercomputers.

The Department Solar & Stellar Interiors at MPS invites applications for the position of a

Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d) to detect exoplanets through magnetic star-planet interaction

In recent years, exoplanetary science has undergone a major shift -- moving from exoplanet detection towards understanding star-planet systems as a whole, including the host star, interplanetary medium and galactic context. Specifically, tidal and magnetic interactions between planets and their host stars have been recognized to be able to modulate the evolution of both, including the atmospheric evolution of the planet and its habitability. The newly established ERC StG project PLANETARE seeks a postdoctoral researcher with a background in stellar magnetism and/or exoplanetary science to develop novel ways of detecting and characterizing the mutual influence of stars and planets with a focus on the influence of planets in short orbits on the magnetism of their host stars. At the core of the project is a new way to find exoplanets: detecting them through their magnetic interaction with the host star. This position develops the detection method itself, i.e., the statistics, the search, and the physical model behind it.

Your Tasks

- Develop new statistical techniques to identify signatures of planet-induced flaring
- Identify young stars and search them for planet-induced flaring using archival and upcoming Kepler, TESS, and PLATO observations
- Measure how the strength and frequency of planet-induced flaring change as systems age
- Develop a forward model of the magnetic feedback loop between planet and star

The derived occurrence rates of planet-induced flaring constrain the prevalence of interaction; the modeling of the evolution and mechanism will be built on the largest survey for planet-induced flaring to date. You will work closely with a second postdoc (https://karriere.mps.mpg.de/jobposting/0fc81c2b5d388be36c024bd054c4467ee1596e490) within a small, newly formed team of two postdocs and a PhD student, led by the PI (Ekaterina Ilin). Group members are supported to lead their own papers and proposals, and to present at international meetings in both the stellar and exoplanet communities.

Your Qualification

- A PhD in physics or astrophysics (PhD must be awarded by the start date)
- Experience with statistical inference and/or modelling of stellar magnetic fields
- The ability to work in a team
- A good command of the English language

Our Offer

- Comprehensive onboarding, professional development and further training opportunities
- Diverse and varied tasks in an international work environment
- Renumeration according to TVöDBund, based on qualifications and experience, annual bonus and additional pension scheme (VBL)
- 30 days of vacation plus 4 additional days off
- Full-time and part-time employment; flexible working time and possibility of mobile work
- Cooperation with local bilingual Montessori child care center
- Good connection by public transport
- Corporate health management

Are you a university graduate with the aspiration, enthusiasm, and talent to help us pioneer sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world? Every year, Airbus seeks bright minds from around the globe to fill critical roles that will shape our future.

We place a strong emphasis on developing your leadership potential from day one. You'll gain a unique perspective on the world of Airbus while contributing directly in a specific, impactful position.

During the two years, we will take you on a soft-skill development journey, covering such areas as inclusive leadership, our Values, resilience, communication and emotional intelligence, with various in-person and virtual workshops.

Beyond your daily responsibilities and this comprehensive schedule of training, you'll join your global graduate community annually for an in-person dedicated development week. This is your chance to connect with your peers, learn directly from our seasoned leaders, and gain insights from the best in the industry.

Throughout the programme, you will be developed into an established and valuable team member from day 1. You'll sharpen your skills in an area strategically important to Airbus, gaining a deep understanding of our business – its opportunities, challenges, and needs. Most importantly, you'll have learned more about yourself and what makes you truly great. You will have demonstrated your capability and readiness to take on future leadership challenges within Airbus.

Above all, you'll have the unparalleled opportunity to do your best work in an industry that is literally reshaping how we live in our world.

If you're ready to embark on this transformative journey and unlock your full potential, apply below.

As part of your application, PLEASE ATTACH A CV & COVER LETTER

- Plan and steer engineering customization activities within challenging projects to implement specific airline requests

- Contribute in shaping the future way of working while supporting digitalisation initiatives
- Unique possibility to get to know the aircraft customization from early definition up to certification and delivery, combining theory (processes and project management) and practice (manufacturing and delivery)
- gaining an insight in all the different areas involved in delivering a customised product with a focus on Cabin & Cargo

At the end of the 2 year development programme you will be fully equipped to be a key player as Engineering Planning & Data Manager.

- A degree level or equivalent within a relevant field of study

- A desire to work in a collaborative team environment, focused on driving future innovation
- The ability to be self aware and a wish to be in the driving seat of your Development.
- Specific experience or interests: project management, strong communication skills, interested in digital trends and data oriented

In addition, you will leverage your automation expertise and project management experience to introduce digital tools, AI-supported ways of working, and modern collaboration methods that enhance project performance and execution quality.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* End-to-end responsibility for Offshore Automation sub-projects, including project execution, cost, schedule, quality, risk, and customer satisfaction
* Coordination and stakeholder management across customers, engineering, commissioning, suppliers, consortium partners, and international project teams
* Management of contractual, technical, commercial, and project-specific requirements to ensure alignment, compliance, and successful delivery
* Proactive governance of project risks, opportunities, claims, changes, and deviations throughout the entire project lifecycle
* Implementation of standardized and modular automation solutions to enhance quality, efficiency, scalability, and project profitability
* Continuous improvement of project execution through digital tools, data-driven transparency, AI-supported methods, and standardized processes, governance, and collaboration models

What You Bring

* Technical degree or professional qualification in Automation, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related field; alternatively, substantial project management experience gained through vocational career paths
* Project Management Certification (e.g., PM@Siemens or IPMA) combined with extensive experience in managing complex technical projects in automation, energy, infrastructure, offshore, or comparable industries
* Expertise in international project management with multiple stakeholders, demanding customers, and complex execution interfaces
* Strong knowledge of automation and control systems, software-based solutions, engineering processes, testing, and commissioning activities
* Commercial and project governance competence, including budget management, cost forecasting, profitability control, as well as risk, claim, change, schedule, and resource management
* High international mobility, excellent English communication skills, and a collaborative, forward-thinking mindset with a strong interest in digitalization, AI, automation trends, and intercultural teamwork

jobs.occupation: Research Associate / Postdoc (m/f/d) in the field of Cryogenic Quantum Electronics (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
With around 15.000 students and 3.800 employees, the Technische Universität Braunschweig is one of Germany’s leading institutes of technology. It stands for strategic and performance-oriented thinking and acting, relevant research, committed teaching, and the successful transfer of knowledge and technologies to the economy and society. We consistently advocate for family friendliness and equal opportunities.

Our research focuses are mobility, engineering for health, metrology, and city of the future. Strong engineering and natural sciences are our core disciplines. These are closely interconnected with economics, social and educational sciences and humanities. Our campus is located in the midst of one of the most research-intensive regions in Europe. We work successfully together with over 20 research institutions in our neighborhood as we do with our international partner universities.

The Division of Cryogenic Quantum Electronics, led by Prof. Dr. Oleksandr Dobrovolskiy, investigates fascinating physical phenomena governing the dynamics of magnetic and superconducting systems and develops quantum electronic devices based on these principles. Its research bridges materials science, experimental physics, electrical measurement science, and metrology. To strengthen the research group and advance its cutting-edge research in cryogenic quantum electronics, we are seeking a

Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d)
(EG13 TV-L, full time - fixed term)

with demonstrated expertise in experimental low-temperature physics.
The position is to be filled on a fixed-term basis for an initial period of 2 years. The successful applicant will be given the opportunity to pursue a further scientific qualification (habilitation).

Your tasks

- You will carry out research in the area of cryogenic and quantum electronics, with a focus on experiments at mK temperatures.
- You will apply for and work on research projects.
- You will perform measurements in a dilution refrigerator and other cryogenic setups, develop, build and optimize cryogenic measurement platforms.
- You will publish research findings in leading international journals and participate in national and international conferences.
- You will be involved in teaching at the University (preparation and implementation of courses as well as supervision of students’ work).

Your Qualifications

- You hold a completed university degree at Master’s level or equivalent, as well as a completed PhD in a field relevant to the position (e.g. physics, electrical engineering, materials science, or a related field), and ideally have postdoctoral research experience.
- You have experience with low-temperature experiments, ideally involving dilution refrigerators in the fields of superconductivity and/or magnetism, as well as good programming skills (e.g., Python, LabVIEW).
- You have knowledge of superconducting and/or magnetic devices, high-frequency and microwave engineering, nanotechnology, and/or quantum measurement techniques, or you are willing and able to acquire this expertise quickly.
- You have excellent English language skills; knowledge of German is desirable.
- You are flexible, can perform under pressure and work well in a team.

We offer

- work on exciting future-oriented research topics in an inspiring work environment as part of the university community
- A vibrant campus life in an international atmosphere with lots of intercultural offers and international cooperations
- Pay in accordance with the collective agreement TV-L (a special payment at the end of the year as well as a supplementary benefit in the form of a company pension, comparable to a company pension in the private sector) including 30 days' vacation per year
- flexible working and part-time options and a family-friendly university culture, awarded the "Family-friendly university" audit since 2007
- special continuing education programs for young scientists, a postdoc program, as well as other offerings from the Central Personnel Development Department and sports activities.

Further notes
We welcome applicants of all nationalities. At the same time, we encourage people with severe disabilities to apply. Applications from severely disabled persons will be given preference if they are equally qualified. Please attach a proof of disability to your application. We are also working on the fulfilment of the Central Equality Plan based on the Lower Saxony Equal Rights Act (Niedersächsisches Gleichberechtigungsgesetz—NGG) and strive to reduce under-representation in all areas and positions as defined by the NGG. Therefore, applications from women are particularly welcome in this case.

The personal data will be stored for the purpose of processing the application. By submitting your application, you agree that your data may be stored and processed electronically for application purposes in compliance with the provisions of data protection law. Further information on data protection can be found in our data protection regulations at https://www.tu-braunschweig.de/datenschutzerklaerung-bewerbungen (https://www.tu-braunschweig.de/datenschutzerklaerung-bewerbungen) .

Application costs cannot be reimbursed.

Deadline for applications is 31.10.2026.

Please send your application via email to oleksandr.dobrovolskiy@tu-braunschweig.de (https://mailto:oleksandr.dobrovolskiy@tu-braunschweig.de) with the following documents in the PDF-format:

• Cover letter
• Curriculum vitae (CV)
• List of publications
• Brief summary of previous research / third-party projects (2 pages)
• Doctoral degree certificate
• Names of two references

and Fundamental Electrical Engineering

As a Regional Head (m,w,d) of Tax, Central and Eastern Europe, which include main entities notably in Germany, Switzerland, Austria and Poland, you will be in charge of all the tax aspects related to this perimeter that can evolve depending on the activity. You will be the key contact and stakeholder of local accounting, controlling, legal and finances teams, as well as the main interlocutor for local tax authorities. You will also work closely with the group tax team in order to ensure proper implementation of group tax policy and strategy.

Your key responsibilities include:

- Manage tax aspects of subsidiaries mainly in Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Poland (including country-specific tax structuring, transfer pricing compliance, limitation of interest deductibility, and local tax consolidation group) and compliance aspects, as CIT, VAT, local taxes returns and ensure compliance with local regulations.
- Support local finance teams for annual financial statements under IFRS and local accounting rules (German HGB, Austrian UGB, Swiss GAAP); ensure correct and optimal application of IFRS, translating IFRS and tax standards into practical processes used across administrations.

- Conduct tax monitoring across the Tax Cluster perimeter, build local tax manuals and guides that are user friendly and understandable to a larger audience; train local finance and tax teams when required
- Ensure management of tax audits and litigations as well as relationships with tax authorities in each jurisdiction: prepare, coordinate and validate responses (with support from external advisors if necessary).

- Support the group and local finance teams on reporting (budget/actuals/forecast), on the determination of tax results, current and deferred tax charges and VAT recovery ratio across all  Tax Cluster entities, coordinate the tax reporting and tax package process with local stakeholders, automate and improve processes, and harmonize local submissions as appropriate.
- Monitor tax legislation and case law developments and ensure proactive adaptation.

This list is non-exhaustive and is intended to evolve with the position and the person who joins the team.

Who are we looking for

We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow.

- Minimum 12 years of experience within international direct taxation at Big4, international law firm or at a multinational organization; pursued graduation from university (Tax Law or Tax Economics).
- Professional proficiency of English and German is required
- Expert in Excel and good knowledge of reporting tool (SAP)
- You demonstrate expertise in international Group tax matters, leveraging your previous experience.
- You are diligent, independent, proactive, with strong analytical and synthesis abilities, and excellent written communication skills. 
- You take initiative, bring forward strategic proposals, and have strong interpersonal capabilities.
- Knowledge of the payments, eCommerce or FinTech industry is a plus.

Perks & Benefits

At Worldline you’ll get the chance to be at the heart of the global payments technology industry and shape how the world pays and gets paid. On top of that, you will also:

- Be part of a company guided by a strong purpose to do good and recognized as top 1% of the most sustainable companies in all sectors worldwide
- Work with inspiring colleagues and be empowered to learn, grow and accelerate your career
- An exciting salary
- At Worldline our top priority is to engage, encourage and develop you to help you improve your potential. In fact, we have comprehensive training and development programs in place demonstrating our dedication to developing your career
- And many more...

#LI-AB1

Shape the evolution

We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. jobs.occupation: Scientific Programmer (mfd) High-Performance Computing and Software Engineering (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
The Max Planck Institute for Marine Microbiology is a research institute of the Max Planck Society. It was founded in 1992 in the State of Bremen and employs around 200 staff members. In close collaboration with numerous university and non-university research institutions, we explore the diversity and function of microorganisms in the ocean and their interactions with their environment. Scientists from all over the world, engineers, technicians and administrative staff together make an important contribution to global marine and environmental research.

In the Department of Ocean Biosphere Dynamics, we are looking to fill up a position as

Scientific Programmer (mfd)

High-Performance Computing and Software Engineering

The department investigates the dynamics of the ocean carbon cycle, its variability and predictability, and its role in the Earth system through climate–carbon cycle feedbacks operating across timescales from days to millennia. A central objective is to improve the representation of marine carbon, nutrient cycling and microbial processes in Earth System Models while increasing spatial model resolution to capture key physical and biogeochemical dynamics in the ocean.

To support this mission, we are seeking different Scientific Programmers (m/f/d) to drive the next generation of ocean biogeochemical modelling in Earth System Models. The successful candidates will contribute to the development, integration, and performance optimization of a state-of-the-art modelling framework, enabling increasingly sophisticated representations of marine biogeochemical processes and unprecedented high-resolution numerical experimentation. Together, they will help ensure that the modelling infrastructure combines scientific excellence with cutting-edge software engineering, delivering robust, efficient, and scalable performance on current and future exascale computing platforms.

The successful candidate will help ensure that the modelling framework of the HAMburg Ocean Carbon Cycle model (HAMOCC) which is part of the ICON Earth system modeling framework remains technologically advanced and capable of efficiently exploiting emerging HPC architectures. Emphasis will be placed on heterogeneous computing and the optimal use of CPU and GPU resources to maximize model performance, scalability, and portability.

A particular focus of the position will be a dedicated project to prepare, optimize, and benchmark the code for deployment on heterogeneous CPU/GPU systems, ensuring efficient performance and supporting the transition to next-generation HPC infrastructure.

The role involves close interactions with researchers, research students and model developers to translate scientific advances into reliable and maintainable model code. The successful candidate will also have the opportunity to contribute to peer-reviewed publications and present research outcomes at scientific conferences.

Key responsibilities:

- Develop and optimize model code of HAMOCC for modern supercomputing architectures
- Enable and improve heterogeneous execution across CPUs and GPUs
- Lead and contribute to software development, maintaining Git repositories, testing and debugging, code review, and Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) to ensure robust, maintainable, and reproducible code
- Implement performance analysis, profiling, and optimization strategies
- Support portability across current and future HPC platforms
- Collaborate with model developers to translate scientific requirements into efficient software solutions

Desired qualifications:

- Degree in computer science, computational science, applied mathematics, or a related field
- Experience with numerical modelling and analysis and handling of large simulation datasets
- Strong knowledge of HPC programming (Fortran and C/C++) and performance optimization
- Knowledge of parallel programming paradigms such as MPI, OpenMP, OpenACC or equivalent technologies
- Experience with large-scale scientific software projects, including software testing and debugging, code review workflows
- Strong knowledge of software engineering best practices, including Git
- Fluent in English, with solid scientific writing skills and a strong interest in working collaboratively within an international and interdisciplinary team

What we offer:

This position is initially offered for three years. Continuation beyond the initial term is intended, subject to satisfactory performance, applicable legal requirements, and the availability of funding.

We offer a position in an international science environment. You can expect a multifaceted job with challenging tasks in an exciting, academic work environment. You will have a high degree of autonomy and creative freedom, and we will promote your further education, e.g. within the framework of external courses and certifications. The compatibility of private life, family and career are important components of our personnel policy. You will be paid according to the collective agreement for the public service (TVöD Bund). Allowances are possible depending on qualifications and areas of responsibility.

Are you interested?

We look forward to receiving your full application via our online application portal. This should include a statement of interest, CV, publication list (when applicable) and a list of references (with contact information). Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. Applications received by 15 September 2026 will receive full consideration; applications received after that date may be considered until the position is filled.

The Max Planck Society is committed to employing more disabled individuals and especially encourages them to apply. The Max Planck Society strives for gender and diversity equality. We welcome applications from all backgrounds.

We are looking forward to your application!

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Bremen is a charming city full of history in the northwest of Germany. In addition to being one of the country’s greenest cities, it offers wonderful sights, a rich culture, urban flair and culinary delights. You start your day aligning with project teams and the central S4E program on rollout progress and priorities. * Execution and validation of functional testing activities including unit, integration, and user acceptance testing
* Ensuring correct integration between Project Systems, Sales & Distribution, and Finance within the S/4HANA environment

* Degree in business administration, information systems, engineering, or a comparable qualification

* Solid understanding of SAP integration concepts, particularly between Project Systems, Sales & Distribution, and Finance

* Strong analytical skills with ability to translate business requirements into system solutions and prior experience in training or coaching end users
* Good understanding of SAP Fiori and S/4HANA embedded analytics as well as fluent English language skills

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and 
decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, 
steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, 
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facilities Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some of these duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components). You provide daily assistance to senior technicians as you read blueprints/schematics, conduct tours of systems and assess their working order.

As an advocate for best practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly. In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.

As a Facilities Technician, you will operate, monitor, and support physical facilities conditions for our data centers.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Senior Risk Manager, you start the day reviewing the latest project risk dashboards and speaking with project managers to anticipate potential challenges before they arise. You facilitate a risk and opportunity workshop for a high-impact energy project, translating insights into concrete actions integrated into schedules and budgets. Throughout the day, you collaborate across engineering, commercial, and portfolio teams to ensure risks are transparently communicated and response strategies are executed. Your work directly improves project profitability, strengthens resilience, and advances Siemens Energy’s mission to deliver sustainable, reliable energy solutions. You’ll be part of an open, solution-focused team culture that values proactive thinking, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Early and comprehensive identification of project risks and opportunities throughout the entire lifecycle, from tendering to completion
* Embedding of risk management into daily project governance processes, ensuring alignment of actions, responsibilities, and timelines
* Translation of risk insights into clear, owned response strategies and their integration into project schedules, budgets, and forecasts
* Consolidation of individual project risks at portfolio level to enable the detection of broader trends and systemic exposures for decision makers
* Maintenance of transparent, fact-based risk communication to management and stakeholders to ensure trust and clarity
* Development of organizational capability through workshops, coaching, and lessons-learned processes to increase overall risk maturity

What You Bring

* University degree in Industrial Engineering or a comparable field
* Proven experience in project and portfolio risk management, ideally within complex, large‑scale energy or infrastructure environments
* Strong capability in identifying, assessing, and managing risks and opportunities with a proactive, value‑driven mindset
* Excellent communication skills enabling clear conveyance of risk insights and effective influence across all stakeholder levels
* Competence in integrating risk management into schedules, budgets, and governance routines, with strong analytical ability to recognize patterns and trends at portfolio level to support informed decision‑making
* A collaborative working approach and willingness to contribute to capability building within diverse, cross-functional teams as well as fluent English skills; German language skills are an advantage

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical 

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

We look forward to you supporting us in the Airframe Structure Team NextGeneration as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: 15.04.2026
- Duration: 12 months

You will receive a collectively agreed salary of at least €18.53 per hour, depending on the job. There are also special payments such as vacation pay.

Who are we

We as the Structure Team NextGen FAF (Forward and Aft Fuselage) / CAF (Center and Aft Fuselage) believe in emission free aviation. Sustainability is at our hearts and we want to be part of the journey towards clean aviation. We are innovation-driven and foster improvements together with our network. We are preparing the future of airframe engineering by creating the link between Research and Technology (R&T) projects & serial programs, delivering pre-study developments and working towards the Airbus vision of sustainable aviation! Our strategy is to act as ambassadors for new technologies (H2 (hydrogen), 3D printing /Rapid Prototyping, Bionics, ...), create business value for serial programs by integration of R&T technology bricks, set the Airframe Structure footprint in R&T projects and prepare the Structure Community to develop future aircraft programs.

You will be part of an innovation driven team taking care of technical Research&Technology projects together with our partners and customers, which is working on feasibility studies and identifying technologies which can be already implemented as incremental development steps in legacy aircraft programs.

You will focus on innovation management and describe how the as-is situation and how the to-be situation is. You will compare both situations and define together with the team potential actions. In addition you will support the Innovation dynamic project team and project leader.

Definition working student

* On-time provision of functional software and hardware solutions within quality, budget, and design requirements

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Gust Loads & Aeroelastics department, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Master student (d/f/m) in the field of Aerodynamics in the Gust Loads & Aeroelastics department

You are looking for a master thesis and want to get to know the work of a job title? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Gust Loads & Aeroelastics department as a master student (d/f/m)!

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: 01.06.2025
- Duration: 6 months

Your opportunity

- Are you passionate about aircraft physics?
- Are you keen to master the way we compute external loads acting on the vehicle due to maneuvers, flight in turbulence, landing impact, ground-handling?
- Do you like to work in an empowered manner?
- Do you enjoy connecting people and collaborating with many different interfaces?
- This job will give you the opportunity to work internationally with several internal flight physics departments and with teams located in Europe and India.

About us

We are a team of 16 multicultural and passionate engineers who perform the gust calculations for overall aircraft design for all aircraft types. Our team is involved from a very early design stage until certification and also in-service support. We are responsible for running build model activities such as finite element modeling, creating mass and aerodynamics models. We perform gust loads calculation, including failure cases, and deliver to internal interfaces. On top, we are deeply involved in research and technology aspects with new aircraft configuration assessments, model based system engineering, automation and machine learning.

Introduction

The current industry approaches of modeling unsteady aerodynamic flow for the prediction of gust loads typically assume linear flow conditions. Linearity greatly reduces the computational time required to evaluate all the flight points and gust conditions required by the certification specifications (CS-25). At the same time, disregarding non-linearities such as boundary layer separation arising from the high angles of attack induced by strong gusts can lead to an over-estimation of loads and thus to an increased structural weight of the aircraft.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Your benefits

- Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

During this six months Master thesis you will develop and evaluate an unsteady aerodynamic model that includes the effect of flow separation in a piecewise linear approach. The model will be built using linearized computational fluid dynamics (CFD) of a complete flexible aircraft and adapted using aerodynamic data obtained in the non-linear flow region at high angles of attack. You will evaluate the model by comparison against higher-fidelity models, such as obtained from non-linear time domain simulation, with respect to gust loads.

You will contribute to:

- Optimize the design of Airbus commercial aircraft in the frame of new wing technologies
- the development of new approaches to model unsteady aerodynamics considering non-linearities for gust loads and flutter computation
- Actively support us as a new member of our team on our journey

Desired skills and qualifications

- You are a fulltime enrolled master student (d/f/m) within Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
- You have good knowledge in aerodynamics, CFD and potential flows
- Ideally you already have first experience in CFD using TAU or CODA
- You have knowledge in coding using Python and/or Matlab
- You bring basic knowledge in overall aircraft design and basic competencies in flight loads calculation and flight mechanics
- You are passionate to understand physical aspects and to use your engineering judgement
- If you are familiar with tools like MSC.NASTRAN or ALTAIR HyperWorks, this is beneficial
- You are a highly motivated, proactive and open-minded person with a great sense of initiative
- You are keen to deepen your technical knowledge while enjoying to work in a multicultural team
- Your English is at negotiating level
